O(a) Digital Customer Success Manager é dono(a) do segmento digital da Atlas Governance: uma pessoa operando uma jornada escalável e orientada por dados, no lugar do modelo 1:1 de CSM.A posição fica na área de CSCX e reporta ao(à) Head of Customer Success.   • Testar, medir e iterar: testes A/B de mensagens e cadências, reportando o que move as métricas.

Customer Success (CS)

  • Levar feedback dos clientes e insights de uso para Produto e para a liderança de CS.

jobs.excerpt: Description et livrables de la prestationContexte :Dans le cadre d’un projet de décommissionnement de SAP BW, une organisation renforce son équipe Data Platform pour concevoir, industrialiser et optimiser ses pipelines de données sur Google Cloud.
jobs.description:
Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Dans le cadre d’un projet de décommissionnement de SAP BW, une organisation renforce son équipe Data Platform pour concevoir, industrialiser et optimiser ses pipelines de données sur Google Cloud.
Les données sources sont déposées sous forme brute dans BigQuery via SAP Datasphere. La mission porte principalement sur leur transformation en modèles analytiques fiables, performants et exploitables pour les usages décisionnels.

Livrables attendus :

  • Pipelines de transformation développés avec dbt dans BigQuery.
  • Modèles analytiques structurés et documentés.
  • Tests de qualité intégrés aux traitements.
  • Développements versionnés et intégrés au processus CI/CD.
  • Documentation technique et d’exploitation.

Missions principales :

  • Concevoir et développer les transformations de données sous BigQuery à l’aide de dbt.
  • Structurer les modèles selon une architecture en couches de type médaillon : données brutes, données nettoyées et harmonisées, puis modèles analytiques.
  • Traduire les règles de gestion définies avec les interlocuteurs métier et techniques en transformations SQL.
  • Optimiser les performances et les coûts des traitements BigQuery, notamment par le partitionnement, le clustering et les stratégies de chargement adaptées.
  • Mettre en place des tests et des contrôles de qualité des données.
  • Industrialiser les développements en appliquant les bonnes pratiques de versionnement, de revue de code et d’intégration et de déploiement continus.
  • Contribuer à la fiabilité des pipelines et à l’analyse des anomalies.
  • Documenter les modèles de données, les transformations et les procédures d’exploitation.
  • Selon les besoins, contribuer à l’exposition des données dans Looker à l’aide de LookML.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience significative en Data Engineering ou Analytics Engineering et savez intervenir de manière autonome au sein d’une équipe Data Platform.
Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans la conception, les tests et la documentation. Vous êtes capable de comprendre les besoins métier, de clarifier les règles de transformation et de collaborer avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles.

Compétences requises :

  • Maîtrise du SQL avancé et de la modélisation analytique.
  • Expérience confirmée de BigQuery : développement, optimisation des requêtes, partitionnement et clustering.
  • Expérience confirmée de dbt : modèles, dépendances, tests et documentation.
  • Maîtrise de Git et des pratiques CI/CD appliquées à la data.
  • Capacité à concevoir des traitements maintenables et fiables en production.

Compétences appréciées :

  • Premières connaissances de Looker / LookML.
  • Expérience de projets de migration d’entrepôts de données ou de refonte décisionnelle.
  • Familiarité avec les environnements SAP BW ou SAP Datasphere.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

jobs.description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Monitor federal and state legislative, regulatory, coding, payment, and coverage developments affecting clinical laboratories, molecular diagnostics, genomics, rare disease, and precision medicine; convert changes into clear enterprise implications and action plans.
  • Represent Baylor Genetics in health policy matters with trade associations, standards-setting organizations, public agencies, coalitions, payer policy forums, and other external stakeholders.
  • Lead end-to-end coding strategy for new and existing products, including applications for new or revised CPT codes through the American Medical Association and coordination of ICD-10-CM code proposals through the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and other appropriate federal processes.
  • Develop evidence, utilization, clinical-workflow, and economic rationales required to support coding, valuation, coverage, and reimbursement submissions.
  • Lead state health policy strategies that accelerate adoption and sustainable funding of rapid WGS for critically ill infants and children, including Medicaid, appropriations, coverage mandates, pilots, and implementation pathways.
  • Partner with authorized Government Affairs resources, external coalitions, and registered lobbyists to educate and engage state legislatures and members of the U.S. Congress on Baylor Genetics priorities in accordance with Legal and Compliance requirements.
  • Lead upstream pipeline reimbursement planning for new products, platform extensions, and tuck-in acquisitions, including coding, coverage, payment, evidence, channel, operational, and commercialization-readiness assessments.
  • Integrate reimbursement and policy diligence into business-development evaluations, identifying access risks, evidence gaps, investment requirements, and post-close integration priorities.
  • Guide responses to proposed federal and state rules, payer policies, fee schedules, laboratory payment reforms, and other public-comment opportunities.
  • Build executive-ready policy briefs, scenario analyses, risk assessments, and recommendations for senior leadership and the Board, as appropriate.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle and Finance to assess payment adequacy, coding performance, denial patterns, fee-schedule changes, and financial impact.
  • Maintain governance, documentation, and compliance controls for policy engagement, coding submissions, coalition activity, and external representation.

People Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, develop, and retain a team responsible for health policy, coding, reimbursement strategy, and government-affairs coordination.
  • Establish measurable objectives, operating rhythms, decision rights, and accountability aligned to enterprise priorities.
  • Conduct regular portfolio, policy, and pipeline reviews; remove barriers and ensure timely execution of critical submissions and advocacy initiatives.
  • Develop succession plans and expand organizational capability in laboratory policy, coding, payment, and state-government engagement.
  • Promote a culture of integrity, evidence-based advocacy, cross-functional partnership, and execution excellence.

Core Deliverables

  • Annual federal and state health policy strategy with prioritized issues, stakeholders, risks, and action plans.
  • CPT and ICD-10-CM coding roadmaps, applications, evidence packages, and milestone plans for priority products.
  • State rWGS adoption strategy, including legislative, Medicaid, appropriations, coalition, and implementation pathways.
  • Congressional and state policy engagement plans executed with authorized Government Affairs and Compliance partners.
  • Pipeline and acquisition reimbursement-readiness assessments with clear go/no-go considerations and investment requirements.
  • Executive dashboards covering policy developments, coding milestones, reimbursement risks, advocacy progress, and expected business impact.

Key Success Metrics

  • Achievement of coding milestones and favorable outcomes for priority CPT and ICD-10-CM initiatives.
  • Number and quality of state policies, Medicaid pathways, appropriations, or programs advancing rWGS adoption.
  • Progress against federal and state policy priorities, including compliant engagement with members of Congress and legislative stakeholders.
  • Pipeline products and tuck-in acquisitions entering commercialization with complete coding, coverage, payment, and evidence strategies.
  • Timely identification and mitigation of material legislative, regulatory, coding, and reimbursement risks.
  • Improvement in payment adequacy, coding clarity, reimbursement predictability, and access for Baylor Genetics products.
  • Team performance, retention, succession readiness, and achievement of annual objectives.
  • Quality, timeliness, and executive usefulness of policy intelligence, scenario planning, and recommendations.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Health Policy, Public Health, Life Sciences, Business, Healthcare Administration, Health Economics, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of leading teams in health policy and reimbursement
  • 12+ years in progressive experience, combination with the following experience;

o8+ years of progressive experience in health policy, reimbursement, coding, government affairs, market access, or related healthcare leadership roles.

o8+ years of direct laboratory health policy and reimbursement experience, preferably in molecular diagnostics, genomics, or precision medicine.

  • Demonstrated experience leading CPT coding strategy and familiarity with ICD-10-CM coordination and federal coding processes.
  • Demonstrated success influencing state or federal health policy, reimbursement, Medicaid, or legislative initiatives through compliant advocacy and coalition engagement.
  • Experience leading and developing teams responsible for policy, coding, reimbursement, or government affairs.
  • Ability to interpret legislation, regulations, coding guidance, payment policy, and payer requirements and translate them into business strategy.
  • Executive-level communication, deductive storytelling, negotiation, and cross-functional influence skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 40–50% domestically.
    •

Preferred:

  • MBA, MPH, MHA, JD, MS, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent advanced degree.
  • Experience with rWGS, WGS, WES, NGS, rare disease, oncology genomics, reproductive genetics, or pediatric critical care.
  • Experience with AMA CPT processes, CMS payment systems, state Medicaid programs, and CDC ICD-10-CM coordination processes.
  • Established relationships with laboratory trade associations, patient-advocacy organizations, state policy coalitions, federal agencies, and legislative stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting product pipeline strategy, licensing, mergers and acquisitions, or post-acquisition integration.
  • Experience developing public-comment letters, legislative language, fiscal-impact analyses, or reimbursement evidence packages.
    •

COMPETENCIES

✓ Enterprise Health Policy Leadership ✓ Laboratory Coding & Reimbursement

✓ Government Affairs & Advocacy ✓ State Policy Strategy

✓ Pipeline & Acquisition Planning ✓ Executive Presence & Influence

✓ Evidence-Based Communication ✓ Cross-Functional Collaboration

✓ People Leadership & Talent Development ✓ Compliance & Execution Excellence

ROLE IMPACT

This role shapes the policy, coding, and reimbursement environment required to accelerate rWGS adoption, support product innovation, enable strategic growth, and expand patient access to Baylor Genetics testing.

jobs.excerpt: Field Sales RepresentativeLocation: Sheffield, covering Sheffield or surrounding areas such as Rotherham or Chesterfield (fully field-based) £50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package Hello.
jobs.description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Sheffield, covering Sheffield or surrounding areas such as Rotherham or Chesterfield (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

jobs.description:
Hello, our name is Customertimes, but you can call us CT. We are a global digital engineering, product development, and technology consulting company. Headquartered in New York, we have a team of 1000+ experts working across 65+ countries.

About this job:

The Salesforce Solution Architect is responsible for end-to-end solution design and delivery across the Salesforce platform, primarily supporting Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft-driven integrations. This role leads discovery and requirements gathering with client stakeholders, produces solution documentation, supports presales solutioning and scoping, and drives implementation teams through delivery. This is a senior, client-facing individual contributor role. No travel. Fully remote.

Location: India (Remote)

How you'll make an impact:

  • Implement and govern end-to-end solution architecture aligned to approved business outcomes, platform standards, and security/compliance requirements;
  • Lead client-facing discovery, requirements workshops, and design sessions; translate requirements into clear functional and technical designs;
  • Own solution documentation including solution design documents, architecture diagrams, data flows, integration specs, and configuration/workflow decisions;
  • Define and review Salesforce data models, security model (profiles/permission sets/sharing), automation strategy (Flows), and programmatic approach (Apex/LWC);
  • Architect Service Cloud capabilities (case management, Omni-Channel routing, knowledge, entitlements, email-to-case) and Life Sciences/Health Cloud patterns as applicable;
  • Define integration architecture and patterns across Salesforce and external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven patterns such as Platform Events and Change Data Capture);
  • Partner with MuleSoft and integration teams to design API-led connectivity, error handling, retries, and monitoring; provide architectural oversight even when not building MuleSoft flows directly;
  • Support presales solutioning and scoping, including high-level estimates, delivery approach, assumptions, risks, and implementation roadmap;
  • Provide technical leadership across onshore and offshore delivery teams through design reviews, build guidance, and quality gates;
  • Support regulated life sciences delivery needs (validation readiness, auditability, change control, and release governance);
  • Drive environment strategy, CI/CD governance, and deployment readiness (Git, SFDX, Copado/Gearset/Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions or equivalent).

What makes you a great fit:

  • 8+ years of Salesforce platform experience with 3+ years in a Solution Architect, Technical Lead, or Architecture role;
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, including data modeling, security architecture, and automation (Flows);
  • Working knowledge of programmatic development on Salesforce (Apex and Lightning Web Components) sufficient to make design tradeoffs and guide developers;
  • Experience delivering solutions across multiple Salesforce clouds, including Service Cloud and at least one Life Sciences Cloud or Health Cloud;
  • Strong experience designing integrations (APIs and event-driven patterns) and coordinating with middleware teams (MuleSoft or equivalent);
  • Experience producing and maintaining solution documentation used by technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Experience supporting Agile delivery teams and driving implementation through requirements, build, test, and release;
  • Strong client-facing skills: facilitation, clear written communication, executive-ready storytelling, and the ability to manage ambiguity without formal authority.

Required Salesforce certifications:

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator (Administrator credential);
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer (Platform Developer I credential);
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II.

If you're looking to contribute to global projects, grow your skills, shape the way you work, and be part of a connected international community — Customertimes is the place to build your next career chapter. Are you ready to spark the tech with us?

jobs.title: LEAD ANALYST, GLOBAL OPERATIONS (ITAM SAM & CMDB Lead Administrator)
jobs.excerpt: Responsibilities1) ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB & Discovery Platform Administration• Administer Freshservice, Device42, or equivalent ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and asset data platforms.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

1) ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB & Discovery Platform Administration

  • Administer Freshservice, Device42, or equivalent ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and asset data platforms.
  • Configure platforms from scratch or redesign existing configurations, including modules, asset types, software models, license types, CI classes, fields, forms, workflows, automation rules, notifications, dashboards, roles, permissions, and governance settings.
  • Set up and maintain discovery sources, scan ranges, schedules, credentials, collectors, agents, probes, API connections, synchronization jobs, software recognition rules, and reconciliation rules in accordance with security and change management requirements.
  • Configure request, approval, assignment, reclamation, retirement, and exception workflows for hardware assets, software assets, and CMDB updates.
  • Troubleshoot platform configuration, integration, discovery, synchronization, data import, software normalization, and data quality issues.
  • Maintain platform administration documentation, configuration standards, data dictionaries, CI class definitions, software model standards, license data standards, discovery runbooks, and operating procedures.

2) CMDB Architecture, Data Model & Governance

  • Design, configure, and maintain the CMDB structure, including CI classes, asset attributes, software and application records, lifecycle states, ownership fields, relationship types, business service mapping, and dependency structures.
  • Define and enforce CMDB standards for naming, classification, required fields, ownership, support groups, relationship mapping, lifecycle status, environment, criticality, and authoritative data sources.
  • Establish reconciliation processes between discovery tools, endpoint management systems, software inventory sources, procurement records, identity systems, ITSM records, ITAM repositories, and SAM records.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, stale, orphaned, incorrectly classified, or conflicting asset, software, and CI records.
  • Ensure CMDB data supports incident, request, change, problem, security, audit, vulnerability, software compliance, and service management processes.
  • Maintain CMDB governance documentation, data ownership rules, exception-handling processes, and quality metrics.

3) Discovery & Application Dependency Mapping

  • Configure and maintain discovery capabilities for endpoints, servers, network devices, virtual infrastructure, cloud resources, databases, application components, and discovered software installations.
  • Set up or support ADM and service dependency mapping by enabling discovery methods, validating discovered relationships, and coordinating with application and infrastructure owners.
  • Coordinate discovery prerequisites such as service accounts, credentials, network access, firewall allowlisting, agents, probes, collectors, and access approvals with Infrastructure and Security teams.
  • Monitor discovery coverage, credential failures, scan errors, synchronization status, relationship completeness, software recognition gaps, and unmapped or unknown assets.
  • Continuously tune discovery settings, mapping rules, software normalization logic, reconciliation logic, and dependency rules to improve CMDB accuracy, ADM coverage, and SAM visibility.

4) Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Inventory Management

  • Oversee hardware and infrastructure asset lifecycle data from request, receiving, deployment, assignment, transfer, return, decommissioning, disposal, and retirement.
  • Ensure lifecycle updates are accurately reflected in ITAM, ITSM, CMDB, discovery, endpoint inventory, and reporting platforms.
  • Reconcile purchased, deployed, discovered, retired, and disposed hardware assets across procurement records, endpoint tools, discovery platforms, and ITSM/ITAM systems.
  • Maintain accurate inventory data including owner or custodian, location, serial number, model, status, environment, support group, business purpose, warranty or support status, and related CIs or services.
  • Coordinate inventory audits, physical verification, exception handling, discrepancy investigations, disposal evidence, and asset record cleanup.

5) Software Asset Management (SAM) & License Governance

  • Establish, administer, and maintain software asset records, software models, publishers, versions, editions, categories, license records, entitlement data, subscription records, renewal dates, approved software status, and software lifecycle status within ITAM, SAM, CMDB, and ITSM platforms.
  • Reconcile discovered software installations, SaaS usage, endpoint inventory, purchase records, subscriptions, entitlements, and approved software records to support license accuracy and compliance visibility.
  • Track software assignments, usage, ownership, business justification, license position, approval status, renewal risk, retirement status, and compliance status.
  • Identify unused, underused, duplicate, unauthorized, unsupported, end-of-life, or potentially non-compliant software and coordinate remediation, reclamation, renewal, or retirement actions with the appropriate owners.
  • Support software request, approval, assignment, deployment, reclamation, renewal, retirement, and decommissioning workflows in coordination with IT Support, Security, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Application Owners.
  • Maintain software-related CIs and relationships in the CMDB, including links between applications, software products, users, devices, servers, business services, application owners, support groups, and dependency records.
  • Prepare dashboards and reports for software compliance, license utilization, renewal risk, unauthorized software, software lifecycle status, SaaS/application inventory, reclamation opportunities, and cost optimization opportunities.
  • Support software audits, true-ups, renewals, vendor reviews, and internal compliance reviews by providing accurate asset, entitlement, deployment, and usage data. Contract negotiation and legal interpretation remain owned by Procurement, Finance, and Legal.

6) Integrations, Automation & Reporting

  • Configure and maintain integrations between ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery platforms, endpoint management tools, procurement sources, identity systems, SaaS sources, and reporting tools.
  • Build workflows, automation rules, validation rules, notifications, exception reports, and data quality controls to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  • Create and maintain dashboards and reports for inventory health, lifecycle status, CMDB completeness, discovery coverage, ADM coverage, software compliance, license utilization, renewal exposure, aging assets, reconciliation exceptions, and audit readiness.
  • Analyze data quality metrics, discovery gaps, synchronization failures, software normalization issues, license gaps, and process issues to identify corrective actions and improvement opportunities.
  • Support automation, API, import/export, bulk update, and low-code workflow activities where appropriate and approved.

7) Stakeholder Coordination, Governance & Process Ownership

  • Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and related ITSM configurations.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Compliance, vendors, and application teams to align asset, software, license, CI, and service data with operational, audit, compliance, and business requirements.
  • Document and improve processes for asset intake, software intake, CI creation, discovery onboarding, license record maintenance, ownership validation, dependency mapping, lifecycle updates, reclamation, and decommissioning.
  • Provide guidance and training to IT teams on asset, software, license, CMDB, discovery, and platform update requirements.
  • Support audit, compliance, risk, security, and governance activities related to hardware assets, software assets, software licensing, CMDB reliability, discovery coverage, and administrative access controls.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3-5+ years of experience in ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB administration, IT operations, systems administration, infrastructure support, software asset management, or a related technical platform administration role.
  • Hands-on administration experience with ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, endpoint inventory, or asset data platforms such as Freshservice, Device42, SCCM/MECM, Intune, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience configuring asset models, software models, CI data models, fields, forms, workflows, automations, dashboards, relationships, discovery settings, synchronization rules, data imports, or system integrations.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Fraud Strategist is responsible for developing, testing, and optimizing fraud strategies, policies, rules, thresholds, treatment paths, and decision logic within assigned onboarding and monitoring workflows in RealPage’s payments ecosystem. This role will focus on development of policies and rules across new account onboarding, tenant payments, vendor payments, owner draws, funding instrument verifications, limit management, transaction monitoring, and payer anomalies. The successful candidate will take part in building RealPage’s next generation of fraud controls. This is a hands-on strategy role for someone who can independently identify the right data, write and troubleshoot SQL, connect fraud signals across systems, and translate analysis into practical decisions. They will test hypotheses, quantify fraud exposure and customer impact, evaluate strategy performance, and recommend policies, rules, thresholds, and controls that reduce fraud while protecting the customer experience and enabling business growth.

Responsibilities

Fraud Strategy, Policy & Controls

  • Responsible for the development, maintenance, and optimization of fraud risk policies, strategies, rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, and control documentation across onboarding and monitoring workflows.
  • Develop data-backed recommendations for auto-approval criteria, manual-review routing, payment holds, restrictions, limit treatments, step-up verification, account monitoring, and escalation thresholds.
  • Document strategy rationale, rule logic, data sources, expected impact, monitoring plans, policy considerations, change history, and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Design and optimize controls for payment fraud, onboarding risk, account takeover, business email compromise, counterparty fraud, tenant payment fraud, synthetic identity, first-party misuse, bust-out behavior, stolen payment instruments, refund or dispute abuse, and emerging typologies.
  • Monitor launched strategies and recommend tuning on an ongoing basis.

Analytics, Data Science & Rule Performance

  • Independently source, query, and analyze data using SQL to validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives and false negatives, and evaluate loss exposure, operational impact, and customer friction.
  • Write and troubleshoot SQL queries using multi-table joins, aggregations, date windows, common table expressions, window functions, and segmentation logic to investigate fraud patterns and measure strategy performance.
  • Apply analytical and data science methods to support feature exploration, cohort analysis, segmentation, model output evaluation, threshold setting, experimentation, champion/challenger comparisons, back-testing, and post-launch performance monitoring.
  • Partner with Risk Data Science & Analytics to translate dashboards, models, features, risk scores, and analytical insights into practical fraud decision strategies and operational controls; assess and provide feedback on whether those outputs are effective for fraud strategy use cases, with guidance on complex cases.

Operational Feedback & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with Onboarding Risk Operations and Risk Monitoring Operations to incorporate case outcomes, queue trends, investigator feedback, alert quality, and operational pain points into strategy improvements.
  • Review themes from Trust and Safety escalations to identify control gaps, recurring fraud signals, product or process vulnerabilities, or policy needs requiring durable remediation.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Payment Operations, Compliance/AML, Legal, and Operational Excellence on tooling, workflow, data availability, rule implementation, and control monitoring.
  • Provide concise updates on fraud trends, strategy performance, emerging risks, rule effectiveness, false positive impact, and recommended actions to fraud leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Share fraud findings and trends with fraud operations, monitoring, and escalation teams to inform how case learnings translate into policies, rules, thresholds, or monitoring improvements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of full-time experience in fraud strategy, fraud analytics, payments risk, data science, financial crime, risk operations strategy, or a related technical risk function.
  • Advanced, hands-on SQL experience is mandatory. Candidates must be able to independently write, troubleshoot, and explain SQL queries used to source data, validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives, and evaluate rule or control performance; dashboard-only experience is not sufficient for this role.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or optimizing fraud rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, controls, or monitoring strategies based on independently sourced and analyzed data.
  • Exposure to data science, statistics, experimentation, model evaluation, Python/R, feature development, segmentation, or analytical methods used in fraud or risk decisioning.
  • Experience working with fraud operations, risk analytics, data science, product, engineering, compliance, or payment operations stakeholders.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

Required:

  • Advanced analytical curiosity and ability to connect fraud signals across disconnected tools, imperfect data, evolving processes, and multiple product or payment workflows.
  • Strong ability to translate independently sourced data findings into clear fraud strategy recommendations, rule changes, threshold adjustments, control improvements, monitoring plans, and policy considerations.
  • Strong working knowledge of fraud typologies such as synthetic identity, first-party misuse, counterparty fraud, business email compromise, onboarding fraud, stolen payment instruments, tenant payment fraud, account takeover, refund or dispute abuse, or bust-out behavior.
  • Ability to evaluate fraud strategies using metrics such as loss exposure, fraud capture, precision, false positives, customer friction, queue impact, and post-launch performance trends.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize technical findings for fraud, product, operations, data science, and leadership audiences.
  • High ownership, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to balance fraud mitigation with customer experience, operational capacity, compliance considerations, and business growth.
  • Preferred experience with property management, rent payments, real estate technology, B2B payments, vendor payments, bill pay, embedded payments, merchant acquiring, fraud platforms, payment processor portals, device/identity signals, or decisioning platforms such as Oscilar.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; talk or hear. The employee must have the ability to operate a personal computer and express or exchange ideas by means of the spoken word. May be required to sit and/or stand for long periods of time. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. May be required to lift or move 10+ pounds.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.

Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. jobs.excerpt: OverviewCPI Card Group is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a DevSecOps focus and hands-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS Security Services, infrastructure automation, to join the Infrastructure Cloud Engineering team.
jobs.description:
Overview

CPI Card Group is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a DevSecOps focus and hands-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS Security Services, infrastructure automation, to join the Infrastructure Cloud Engineering team. This role implements, automates, and operates secure, resilient infrastructure capabilities across a hybrid environment that includes on-premises environments, AWS Infrastructure as a Service, and relevant SaaS integrations.

The position strengthens the Cloud Engineering organization with a focus on AWS Cloud Security, and associated security services, infrastructure delivery pipelines, threat-detection integration, vulnerability and configuration remediation, data-protection controls, incident response, and compliance-control implementation. The engineer contributes to reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, guardrails, and automated controls that integrate security throughout the platform engineering and CloudOps lifecycle.

Working closely with Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and other technology teams, this role translates security and compliance requirements into implementable infrastructure capabilities. This role is accountable for incorporating AWS Cloud Security controls within the scope of Infrastructure Cloud Engineering and associated infrastructure cloud platforms. Enterprise cybersecurity architecture, security policy, and cyber-risk governance remain with Cybersecurity.

Responsibilities

  • AWS infrastructure security: Engineer and operate security capabilities supporting multi-account AWS environments, including logging, configuration compliance, threat detection, vulnerability visibility, network protection, encryption, and data protection. This work leverages AWS-native services such as AWS CloudTrail, AWS Config, Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, AWS Shield Advanced, and AWS KMS.
  • Infrastructure as Code and automated controls: Develop and maintain Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, scripts, modules, policies, and automated workflows that provision secure infrastructures and platforms while continuously validating required security controls.
  • Secure delivery pipelines: Implement and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines, including security testing, policy checks, approval controls, separation-of-duties requirements, artifact integrity, and controlled promotion across environments.
  • Secure infrastructure patterns and standards: Implement and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure patterns across AWS and hybrid integrations using approved architectures, standards, and guardrails.
  • Threat, vulnerability, and risk reduction: Automate the identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities, insecure configurations, and control gaps. Provide technical evidence and remediation support for risk-management activities.
  • Hybrid infrastructure protection: Integrate security controls across on-premises environments, AWS infrastructure, and relevant SaaS services. Support network segmentation, security groups, firewall integration, DDoS-resilient designs, secure connectivity, and infrastructure protection patterns.
  • Security monitoring and response: Improve infrastructure telemetry, alerting, and operational response through AWS and enterprise monitoring platforms. Participate in security and infrastructure incidents, root-cause analysis, containment, recovery, and corrective-action automation.
  • Compliance implementation and evidence: Partner with Cybersecurity to translate PCI DSS and other applicable control requirements into technical controls, validation methods, documentation, and repeatable audit evidence. CloudOps and platform operations: Monitor infrastructure health, security posture, reliability, and control effectiveness. Participate in lifecycle management, change management, problem management, operational readiness, and the team's 7x24 on-call rotation.
  • Collaboration and documentation: Contribute to design reviews, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing. Communicate options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical, non-technical, and leadership audiences.
  • Continuous improvement: Evaluate relevant AWS services and industry practices, pilot improvements within approved guardrails, and reduce manual work through safe, measurable automation.

Qualifications

  • Builds for operations: Designs infrastructure with day-two operations in mind. Monitoring, alerting, patching, backup, and recovery are part of "done," not added later.
  • Builds security in: Treats security controls as engineering requirements that are coded, tested, and validated in the pipeline, not as reviews applied after deployment.
  • Automates first: Prefers code over console changes. Spots repeated manual work and turns it into automation that is versioned, reviewed, and repeatable.
  • Troubleshoots across layers: Diagnoses issues that span AWS, networking, identity, on-premises systems, and SaaS integrations. Uses logs, metrics, and security findings to find the root cause, not just the symptom.
  • Works with operational discipline: Follows change management and approved standards. Leaves systems and runbooks in a state another engineer can support during an on-call event.
  • Respects ownership boundaries: Understands what Cloud Engineering owns and what belongs to Cybersecurity and Technology Governance, Risk and Compliance, and knows how to engage those teams effectively.
  • Exercises risk-aware judgment: Recognizes when a design, request, or shortcut creates unacceptable risk. Raises it with evidence and a recommended option, explained in plain terms for engineers, auditors, and leaders.
  • Keeps learning: Keeps AWS, security, and automation skills current and applies what they learn to improve team patterns and practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or comparable professional experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud security engineering, or comparable technical roles.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, securing, and operating AWS infrastructure in production or regulated hybrid environments.
  • Experience implementing or improving security controls within production cloud or hybrid infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, with experience developing reusable modules, automated testing, policy validation, and controlled deployment practices.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms and source control, such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS-native delivery services.
  • Strong scripting or software automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or a comparable language.
  • Experience with multi-account AWS environments, identity and access controls, logging and monitoring, configuration compliance, vulnerability management, encryption, data protection, and network security.
  • Experience participating in infrastructure or security incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action implementation.
  • Working knowledge of regulated-industry security and compliance practices. Experience with PCI DSS is preferred.

Preferred Certification and Qualification Paths:

Candidates may demonstrate readiness through one or more of the following paths. AWS certifications are preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered: Preferred path: An equivalent combination of AWS architecture, operations, security, automation, and production engineering experience aligned to the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate

Additional desired qualifications: AWS certifications or equivalent experience aligned to: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional AWS Certified AI Practitioner

jobs.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

RTI’s Center for Data Interoperability is seeking dynamic and detail-orientated candidates for a full-time Programmer/Analyst with Python or SQL analytic programming experience. The Programmer/Analyst will work with researcher teams to analyze and synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative administrative health data from multiple sources into meaningful results. Individuals in this role will provide analytic development and statistical programming knowledge to project teams conducting research using healthcare data, especially large and complex health insurance claims and survey data, in a fast-paced environment.

This position is based in Research Triangle Park, NC or any other U.S. location as a telecommuter.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

Approximately 85% of working time will require:

  • Developing coding expertise and best practices to query, merge, and analyze complex healthcare data from large relational databases
  • Leveraging a variety of quantitative methods to standardize, blend, and distill data from multiple disparate sources, transforming them into analytic insights for use in client reports, journal manuscripts, abstracts, or posters for professional meetings
  • Iteratively developing and maintaining Python code while adopting best practices for increasing efficiency, minimizing computational errors, implementing process improvements, and other approaches that add value to business processes and analytic results
  • Participating in thorough code review and documentation, as well as parallel coding efforts for other programmers to maintain quality standards and ensure that code may be efficiently transferred among team members as needed
  • Constructing analytic datasets and databases to support deliverables for various public health and healthcare financing engagements
  • Collaborating with project team members to review, critically evaluate, and refine business requirements, and then translate those requirements into programming logic
  • Adopting and refining technical skills on projects, including working independently, proactively resolving day-to-day issues of small complexity, and leveraging coding best practices and standards

Approximately 15% of working time will require:

  • Participating in continuing education courses on healthcare-related and/or technical coding topics (including learning new coding languages) as applicable to the role and evolving business needs
  • Sharing insights gained from the above activities with fellow programmers, leaders, and other division staff through activities such as presentations at staff meetings, contributions to collective codebase utilities, and training early career staff

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS/BA or advanced degree in data science, computer science, statistics, social sciences, health policy or related field with at least 3 years of programming experience OR the equivalent combination of education and experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience is defined as a Master’s degree in the same areas mentioned above and at least 1 year of relevant experience
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Python or SQL analytical coding with demonstrated familiarity with the linkage of various types of data files
  • Programming experience using data stored in relational databases such as Teradata, Snowflake, DB2, Oracle, and SQL Server
  • Experience designing and implementing flexible, reusable, scalable, programming code
  • Commitment to analytic programming quality and best practices, including experience with QA/QC procedures (e.g., peer review of code, parallel programming)
  • Familiarity with all phases of the Analytic Development Life Cycle and demonstrated experience in working with at least 1 of these phases
  • Organizational and planning skills that enable independent work while contributing to a team effort
  • Analytic thinker with exceptional attention to quality and detail
  • Good interpersonal skills, including written and oral English-language skills, the ability to effectively manage competing deadlines, and the ability to work independently on a day-to-day basis while regularly collaborating with project teams
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, have lived in the United States for at least 3 of the last 5 years, and should not require now, or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least 1 year of experience using SAS for analytic programming
  • Demonstrated understanding of relational database management concepts
  • Healthcare industry experience, analytic experience in work with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and/or knowledge of healthcare terminology and taxonomy/classification systems (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS)
  • Programming experience within CMS data systems such as the Integrated Data Repository (IDRC), Chronic Conditions Warehouse (CCW), or Centralized Data Repository (CDR)
  • Understanding and use of issue tracking and code versioning tools such as Jira or Git
  • Ability to thoroughly review and adjust code, ultimately providing quality programming output while developing the ability to identify overall enhancements to programming or project team processes

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Administration
jobs.excerpt: OverviewWorking at AtlassianAtlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two.
jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian Administration is the control centre for every organisation running on Atlassian's System of Work. Admins use it to set up their organisation, get the right people onto the right apps, keep their data secure and compliant, and grow their Atlassian investment over time.

As Atlassian becomes AI-first, Administration is changing from a place where admins dig for information into one that tells them what to act on, explains how and why, and acts on their behalf. It's built on trusted data, flexible org structures and visibility into everything connected to a customer's Atlassian portfolio, and powered by Rovo and agents. The result is enterprise-grade governance with far less effort.

Your Future Team

You'll join Admin Experience, the team behind the operating system for Atlassian admins. Admins use it to set up and manage their organisation, get people onto the right apps, and grow their Atlassian investment over time. Our vision is an Atlassian Admin that tells admins what to act on, advises them on how and why, and acts on their behalf. To get there, we're rebuilding trusted foundations: accurate license data, reliable org structure through Units, and visibility into what's connected to a customer's Atlassian portfolio. At the same time we're launching AI-powered experiences such as Rovo in Admin Hub and a reimagined Overview. You'll be part of a small, high-conviction design team working on problems at enterprise scale, for some of the world's largest and most regulated organisations.

Responsibilities

What you will do

  • Design the high-stakes foundation every Atlassian customer runs on. Every organisation depends on Administration to set up, secure and scale how it works, one decision can affect every user, app and site. Admin actions are often irreversible and hard to see, so you’ll make changes clear, safe and auditable at the scale of the world’s largest, most regulated enterprises.

  • Own whole admin journeys, not just screens. Define complete journeys end to end — setting up an organisation, structuring it with Units, managing licences, governing connected apps, including the edge cases, errors and bulk actions that only show up at scale.

  • Shape AI-powered administration. Help turn Administration from a place where admins dig for answers into one that tells them what to act on, explains how and why, and acts on their behalf through Rovo and agents, designing the transparency, controls and governance that make admins comfortable trusting AI.

  • Make Administration feel like one product. Many teams build admin experiences; you’ll create the patterns, information architecture and Admin UI Kit components that make them feel consistent and cohesive for admins.

  • Turn trust into a design outcome and champion admins. Partner with Engineering and Data so licence counts, user activity and connected-app data are accurate and easy to understand. Represent IT admins, security teams and org owners, learning from customer calls, escalations and usage data, and measuring your work against leading enterprise admin tools.

What your day to day looks like

  • Designing end-to-end admin experiences for complex, data-heavy and permission-sensitive workflows, such as licensing, org hierarchies, identity and access, and app governance.

  • Designing AI-native and agentic experiences, including recommendations, approvals, audit trails and rollback, that earn the trust enterprise admins need.

  • Building functional, AI-enabled prototypes to explore options, de-risk complex flows and test ideas with customers.

  • Contributing patterns to the Admin UI Kit and the Atlassian Design System so the admin experience stays cohesive across contributing teams.

  • Partnering with your PM and Engineering partners to define goals, reduce ambiguity and own outcomes as priorities change.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications

What You Bring

We'd love to see a portfolio that demonstrates:

  • Enterprise and admin SaaS experience. 5+ years of product design experience with complex B2B, SaaS or enterprise software, including time spent on administration, settings or other data-heavy, permission-sensitive surfaces.

  • Strong craft in visual and interaction design. A high level of craft across interaction design, information architecture and visual design, backed by strong systems thinking and experience contributing to design systems.

  • Excellent prototyping. Strong prototyping skills that show behaviour, options and trade-offs, not just screens, to de-risk complex flows and test ideas with customers.

  • End-to-end problem solver, grounded in evidence. Experience owning end-to-end UX, solving complex problems with clear, practical solutions, running generative and evaluative research, and measuring success through qualitative and quantitative methods.

  • A great team player. Clear, evidence-based communication, the ability to influence cross-functional partners and stakeholders, and sound judgement balancing customer needs with business goals and technical feasibility.

What sets you apart

  • Deep enterprise admin domain knowledge. Hands-on familiarity with concepts like SSO/SCIM, licensing, org hierarchies, and OAuth and API governance, you understand how large organisations are actually run and secured.

  • Proven AI-native and agentic design. Recent, hands-on experience designing AI-powered features, workflows or agentic tooling, including the recommendations, approvals, audit trails and rollback that earn enterprise trust.

  • Prototyping in code. Comfort building functional prototypes in code to bring behaviour and trade-offs to life for partners and customers.

  • Scale and regulation. A track record designing for some of the largest, most regulated enterprises, where edge cases, bulk actions and auditability are the norm, and comfort collaborating across time zones.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

jobs.title: Tabular AI Solution Architect
jobs.excerpt: The roleYou are the technical voice of Probabl in front of US data science teams: the person who takes a first conversation to a technical discovery, a demo on their own problem and a scoped proof of concept, alongside the sales team.
jobs.description:
The role

You are the technical voice of Probabl in front of US data science teams: the person who takes a first conversation to a technical discovery, a demo on their own problem and a scoped proof of concept, alongside the sales team. Services owns technical pre-sales and delivery; you bring that field engineering expertise to the sales team on every US opportunity.

Probabl is the Tabular AI company founded by the creators of scikit-learn. Skore, our platform, builds, validates and tracks predictive models on tabular data with the methodology of the scikit-learn maintainers built in. Data science is being rewritten by agents faster than the discipline can absorb it; our job is to keep the science guarding the speed.

This is our first Solution Architect in the US. You join the Services team, Probabl's applied AI team of field engineers and solution architects, and work day to day with our US sales lead. Our pre-sales practice already runs in France, with a Solution Architect, a reference demo, a demo kit and a PoC playbook. You run it for the American market and feed back what you learn, so the whole team's practice gets better.

What you'll do

  • Run the demo.Own the reference Skore demo for the US and adapt it to a prospect's use case in days, with the demo kit, on your own.

  • Run technical discovery. With data science leads and their platform teams: current stack and tooling, how models are built and validated today, where reliability leaks, what a first project would look like.

  • Scope the PoC.Turn a qualified opportunity into one scoped question on the customer's data, with a clear go/no-go, then hand it to our field engineers to deliver.

  • Run workshops and hackathons. Hands-on sessions with a prospect's data science team on their own data, and the occasional hackathon with partners or schools: the fastest way to show what Skore does and to qualify a team.

  • Answer the hard questions. Architecture, security, deployment options (on-prem, BYOC, cloud), how Skore fits an existing stack. You bring Engineering in when needed, not by default.

  • Work the deal with Sales.Technical qualification, RFPs and evaluation workshops, alongside our US sales lead.

  • Bring the field back to Product. What US customers ask for, what blocks a deal, what wins it: written up, sized, and fed into the roadmap every week.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in data science or ML engineering, then pre-sales or solutions work for a data or AI product. You have built models in production and you have sold the idea of building them better.

  • You master tabular data work end to end, whatever the framework: scikit-learn of course, but just as much gradient boosting, PyTorch, time series and the like, with the evaluation and validation that go with them. You can read a prospect's pipeline, spot the leakage, and show them in a notebook what a sound evaluation looks like.

  • You run a room. A live demo to 20 data scientists, a whiteboard with a platform team, a discovery call with a VP: you adjust and you land the point.

  • You are comfortable with enterprise buying groups: data science, IT and security, procurement, and the economic buyer, each with their own question.

  • Based in the US, remote, with travel to customers and periodic trips to Paris.

  • Strong plus: experience with agentic or LLM-based data science tooling, and a healthy skepticism about its outputs.

  • Nice to have: Kubernetes and cloud basics, tabular and time series foundation models (TabICL and others), an open-source footprint in the Python data ecosystem.

Why Probabl

  • Credibility you don't have to build. scikit-learn is downloaded over 200 million times a month. You walk into every room with the stewards of the library behind you.

  • A category, not a feature. We are defining Tabular AI: AI on the structured business data that runs companies, with the scientific method built in. You help define what it means in the US.

  • A team that builds its playbook together.We have a first version of our demos, PoC playbook and processes, and they still have a lot of room to evolve. You use them with US customers and improve them with the rest of the team.

  • Short distance to the product. Solution Architects and field engineers sit in a weekly Product–Services sync. What you hear from customers changes the roadmap, visibly.

Practical

  • Reports to the VP Services (Paris). Day to day with our US sales lead, who is fully involved in the hiring.

  • Location: United States, remote. Preferred time zone: East Coast (to confirm). Travel to customers as needed; two to three trips a year to Paris, including onboarding.

  • Compensation:fixed + variable tied to pipeline and closed deals; band to confirm.

  • Start:as soon as possible.

  • Process, three weeks from first call to offer:

  1. 30-minute call with the VP Services.

  2. 30-minute call with our US sales lead.

  3. Practical evaluation

  4. 30-minute call with a co-founder.

  5. Offer.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Data Analyst II is a capable analytical contributor who independently designs, executes, and delivers data analysis and visualization work across RS21's client engagements. This role is designed for a practitioner who can take an analytical question from problem definition to client-ready findings without day-to-day direction, make sound methodological choices within established frameworks, and communicate results clearly to a range of audiences, technical and non-technical alike.

This person works confidently across RS21's analytical toolchain, produces high-quality reporting and dashboards, applies statistical methods appropriately, and adapts rapidly to the needs of each client context. They are able to provide constructive feedback to junior analysts, contribute to RS21's analytical documentation, and are actively deepening their expertise in the areas that will define their senior-level contribution.

This role is embedded in real client delivery and expected to take full ownership of assigned analytical workstreams. The Data Analyst II does not wait for scope to be handed down; they clarify requirements, propose analytical approaches, flag methodological risks, and keep delivery moving. They understand that the best analysis is the one that is used long after the engagement ends, and they design their work accordingly.

Critically, the Data Analyst II is developing into the kind of analyst RS21 depends on across engagements: someone who delivers accurate, timely, and persuasive analytical work, communicates with genuine client-centricity, and brings enough self-awareness to know when a question requires a methodology or domain expertise that they need to develop.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Insight Delivery

  • Independently design and execute analytical projects across multi-source datasets; manage data extraction, transformation, quality assessment, and exploratory analysis without requiring direction on approach.
  • Write clean, functional Python or R code for data analysis, automation, and reporting tasks; apply software discipline including version control, notebook documentation, and reproducibility practices.
  • Write complex SQL queries independently; optimize performance, choose appropriate query patterns by workload, and communicate query logic clearly in documentation and code review.
  • Apply statistical techniques including regression, significance testing, sampling methodology, and descriptive analysis to produce findings that are both technically sound and interpretively honest about uncertainty.
  • Independently design and publish production dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent; connect to multiple data sources, apply sound visualization and UX principles, and govern data model and access design.
  • Independently produce compelling data narratives using storytelling tools and visualization frameworks for diverse client and stakeholder audiences; adapt depth, format, and framing to the audience.

AI-Augmented Analytics

  • Use AI productivity tools independently to meaningfully accelerate research, analysis, and reporting tasks; apply sound judgment about when AI assistance improves work and when it introduces risk.
  • Apply AI-assisted data preparation and pattern detection within established analytical workflows; validate AI-generated outputs critically before incorporating them into client deliverables.
  • Stay current on emerging AI-augmented analytical tools and share relevant learnings with the analytics team; help the practice understand where these tools add genuine value.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Manage stakeholder relationships independently for assigned engagements; facilitate analytical meetings, communicate findings clearly, navigate competing interpretations, and keep stakeholders aligned on scope and timeline.
  • Produce high-quality client reports, analytical briefings, and status communications; tailor content to audience and ensure clients have the information they need to act on analytical findings.
  • Apply established data governance frameworks in client environments, including documenting ownership, lineage, and metadata, under the direction of an engagement lead.
  • Anticipate evolving client analytical needs and proactively communicate concerns about scope, data quality, or methodological limitations before they become delivery risks.

Data Quality and Documentation

  • Independently validate analytical outputs for accuracy, reproducibility, and appropriate handling of data limitations; document assumptions, caveats, and quality decisions clearly so reviewers and downstream users can trust and build on your work.
  • Maintain high-quality analytical documentation in Confluence or equivalent; structure documentation so teammates unfamiliar with an engagement can understand what was analyzed, how, and what it means.
  • Contribute to reusable analytical templates, code libraries, and accelerators that help the team move faster on common problem types.

Collaboration and Mentorship

  • Provide structured support to junior analysts through hands-on coaching, code review, documentation, and pairing; help them develop the technical and communication habits that will carry them toward independent contribution.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to ensure analytical work connects to the right data assets and model outputs; understand the full data flow well enough to design analysis around it.
  • Partner with project managers to keep analytical delivery aligned with client expectations and contractual constraints; surface scope and timeline risks early with enough context for leadership to act.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Public Policy, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3 to 5 years of progressive experience in data analysis or business intelligence, including independent delivery of analytical projects from problem definition through client presentation.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language (Python or R), including libraries for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and visualization.
  • Advanced proficiency with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent BI platforms; able to design, publish, and govern production dashboards independently.
  • Strong grounding in applied statistics including regression, hypothesis testing, sampling methodology, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including written reports and live presentations.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships and delivering analytical work independently across client engagements.

Preferred

  • Experience with geospatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS, QGIS, or Python-based spatial libraries.
  • Background in advanced analytics, program evaluation, or government data environments.
  • Familiarity with longitudinal data, panel data methods, or quasi-experimental evaluation designs.
  • Basic understanding of cloud data platforms such as AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery, or Snowflake.
  • Background in consulting or multi-client delivery environments where analytical standards and client communication expectations are high.
  • Familiarity with AI-augmented analytics tooling and responsible approaches to integrating generative AI into analytical workflows.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is building a focused, integrated go-to-market engine to accelerate growth across our digital and performance marketing services. Maintain Reporting and Improve Execution

  • Support A/B tests by configuring approved variants, checking setup, and compiling results.
  • Identify ways to improve campaign accuracy, repeatability, and turnaround time.

What You Will Need

You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.
