Industry: Investment Management / Alternative Investments

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for investors, financial advisory firms, and multi-family offices.

The company operates a sophisticated investment platform that includes its own investment funds as well as customized fund-of-funds solutions for financial partners. With assets under management growing rapidly and additional investment products in development, the firm is expanding its operational infrastructure to support its next stage of growth.

The organization combines the innovation and agility of a technology-driven company with the rigor, controls, and sophistication of institutional investment management.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Fund Operations Manager to take hands-on ownership of the operational processes that keep a growing investment fund platform running accurately and efficiently.

This is a specialized fund operations role with responsibility across the monthly NAV cycle, fund accounting, investor transactions, KYC/AML, capital activity, investor reporting, management-company accounting, fund launches, and external provider coordination.

You will work closely with the Head of Operations and serve as a trusted operational partner capable of independently managing critical fund processes from beginning to end.

This is not a traditional back-office role. You will have significant ownership, direct exposure to investors and leadership, and the opportunity to improve and automate fund operations as the platform scales.

What You'll Do

NAV & Fund Accounting

  • Own the monthly NAV process and drive the close through final review and sign-off.

  • Coordinate month-end activities with fund administrators and other external providers.

  • Prepare and review monthly NAVs, identifying and resolving discrepancies before leadership review.

  • Reconcile positions and cash across internal calculations, shadow records, and official administrator records.

  • Manage outstanding manager NAVs and help maintain an efficient and timely close process.

  • Maintain accurate fund performance records, including returns, positions, and expenses.

  • Ensure fund accounting records remain complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Investor Operations

  • Process investor subscriptions, redemptions, and transfers accurately and on time.

  • Own KYC/AML onboarding processes and maintain an accurate investor register.

  • Coordinate capital calls, distributions, fee calculations, payments, and wire approvals.

  • Serve as a front-line point of contact for investors, handling operational questions with accuracy, professionalism, and discretion.

  • Coordinate directly with external administrators, managers, and service providers to resolve investor-related requests.

Investor Reporting

  • Produce quarterly fact sheets and investor performance reporting using fund control-book data.

  • Support quarterly fund-of-funds reporting and commentary processes.

  • Maintain complete and organized shadow and official NAV records.

  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and data processes.

Management Company Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Manage the management company's books, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, and month-end close.

  • Prepare recurring management financial reporting, including KPIs, management-fee tracking, and expense reporting.

  • Coordinate invoices, payments, expense management, and financial records.

  • Help bring recurring bookkeeping and reporting processes in-house while improving and automating them wherever possible.

Fund Formation & Launch

  • Support the operational setup and launch of new funds.

  • Coordinate account openings, documentation, and required registrations.

  • Help establish the operational infrastructure for new funds and feeder structures.

  • Ensure new fund launches are executed accurately without disrupting existing fund operations.

Providers, Controls & Operational Infrastructure

  • Manage day-to-day coordination with fund administrators, transfer agents, prime brokers, and banks.

  • Maintain strong controls around operating accounts, fund accounts, and wire approvals.

  • Document fund operations procedures and build scalable operational playbooks.

  • Create reliable processes that provide operational continuity and reduce dependency on any single team member.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and automate fund operations.

Required Qualifications

  • C2 / Near-native English proficiency, written and spoken.

  • 5+ years of hands-on fund operations experience within a fund administrator, hedge fund, private markets manager, fund-of-funds, asset manager, or similar investment environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience managing the NAV cycle, investor transactions, and capital activity.

  • Strong fund accounting foundation, including NAV review, position and cash reconciliation, P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow.

  • Ability to independently identify and resolve errors in monthly NAVs before final approval.

  • Hands-on experience with subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, KYC/AML, capital calls, distributions, and fee calculations.

  • Experience coordinating with fund administrators, transfer agents, prime brokers, and banks.

  • Hands-on accounting experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, month-end close, and financial reporting.

  • Experience communicating directly with investors or external financial partners.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong controls mindset.

  • High level of ownership, judgment, discretion, and follow-through.

  • Ability to work independently and manage critical financial processes from beginning to end.

  • Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within alternative investments or asset management.

  • Fund-of-funds or multi-strategy investment experience.

  • Experience working with multiple funds simultaneously.

  • Experience with feeder funds, holding-company structures, or onshore/offshore investment structures.

  • Experience supporting new fund launches and fund formation.

  • Experience working directly with founders, investors, and external financial service providers.

  • Experience using AI and automation to improve reconciliation, reporting, or recurring fund operations processes.

Tools & Systems

Experience with every platform is not required, but candidates should be comfortable learning sophisticated financial and operational systems quickly.

Relevant tools may include:

  • Fund administration and NAV platforms

  • Fund performance tracking systems

  • Prime brokerage platforms

  • Accounting and expense-management systems

  • SharePoint

  • Google Workspace

  • Slack

  • Notion

  • Linear

  • Claude, Codex, and AI automation tools

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate combines deep fund operations expertise with exceptional precision and ownership.

You are someone who:

  • Owns the close: You manage the monthly NAV cycle end to end, proactively resolve issues, and keep the close on schedule.

  • Operates with precision: You reconcile before approving, identify discrepancies others may miss, and build controls that prevent errors.

  • Can be trusted with investor capital: You handle sensitive financial and investor information with exceptional judgment and discretion.

  • Takes complete ownership: Once a responsibility is handed to you, leadership can trust that it will be completed accurately and on time.

  • Improves the system: You continuously look for opportunities to streamline, document, and automate recurring fund operations.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive compensation paid in USD.

  • Fully remote opportunity.

  • Work directly with senior leadership at a growing U.S. investment management firm.

  • Significant ownership over critical fund operations.

  • Exposure to sophisticated alternative investment and fund-of-funds structures.

  • Opportunity to help build and scale the operational infrastructure behind a growing investment platform.

  • Technology-forward environment with opportunities to automate and improve traditional fund operations.

Important Notes

Please submit your CV in English.

Candidates should have direct, hands-on experience in fund operations and fund accounting. General business operations or accounting experience without meaningful exposure to investment fund operations will not be sufficient for this position.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Financial Operations & Accounting Specialist – QuickBooks, Reconciliation & Multi-Entity

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Financial Operations & Accounting Specialist to manage financial records, reconciliations, and reporting across multiple entities.

This is a hands-on financial operations role — not basic bookkeeping. You’ll ensure financial data stays accurate, organized, and reliable, while identifying discrepancies and improving reporting workflows.

If you’re strong with QuickBooks, reconciliations, and Google Sheets/Excel and naturally spot inconsistencies in financial data, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Accounting & Reconciliations

  • Maintain and reconcile financial records across multiple entities
  • Ensure transactions are accurately recorded in QuickBooks
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies
  • Maintain clean, organized, and audit-ready financial records

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare monthly financial reports and summaries
  • Build and maintain financial trackers in Google Sheets / Excel
  • Ensure consistency between accounting systems and reports
  • Organize financial data for clear leadership visibility

Expense & Transaction Tracking

  • Track property-level expenses, CapEx, interest, and other financial activity
  • Ensure transactions are properly categorized
  • Maintain accurate supporting documentation
  • Identify missing entries, errors, or inconsistencies

Bank & Vendor Coordination

  • Follow up with banks and vendors when needed
  • Verify transactions, balances, and supporting information
  • Ensure external records align with internal financial data

Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficient or repetitive financial workflows
  • Improve trackers, reporting systems, and documentation
  • Build repeatable processes that improve accuracy and scalability

Requirements

  • Experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial operations
  • Hands-on QuickBooks experience; multi-entity experience strongly preferred
  • Advanced Google Sheets / Excel skills, including formulas and complex trackers
  • Strong reconciliation and financial data analysis skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Clear written and verbal English communication
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Multi-entity or property-based accounting experience
  • Experience tracking CapEx and property-level expenses
  • Financial reporting experience
  • Familiarity with Google Drive and Slack
  • Experience improving accounting processes or financial systems

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate financial records and reconciliations
  • Monthly reporting completed on time
  • Discrepancies identified and resolved proactively
  • Clean and structured multi-entity financial data
  • Reliable financial tracking systems
  • Continuous improvement in reporting and accounting workflows
  • Leadership confidence in financial data accuracy

Tools You’ll Use

QuickBooks | Google Sheets | Excel | Google Drive | Slack

Why Join

  • Fully remote opportunity
  • High ownership across financial operations
  • Exposure to multi-entity accounting and reporting
  • Opportunity to improve financial systems and processes
  • Direct impact on financial accuracy and leadership visibility
  • Growth opportunities into Senior Accounting or Financial Operations roles

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Pavago Recruiter Interview
  4. Final Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re experienced with QuickBooks, reconciliations, multi-entity financial records, and advanced spreadsheets, we’d love to hear from you.

Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison – Mortgage Operations | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Availability: 30+ Hours per Week

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison to manage active loan files and ensure they move efficiently from submission through closing.

You’ll serve as the primary coordination point between lenders, underwriters, and internal teams, maintaining clear visibility across every active loan while ensuring documentation, conditions, follow-ups, approvals, and deadlines remain on track.

This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience in mortgage operations, loan processing, lender coordination, or real estate financing who understands how to keep deadline-sensitive transactions moving.

If you’re highly organized, proactive with follow-ups, and comfortable managing multiple loan files simultaneously, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Lender & Underwriter Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with lending partners
  • Maintain consistent communication throughout the loan lifecycle
  • Follow up on:
    • Outstanding documentation
    • Underwriting conditions
    • Lender requests
    • Pending approvals
  • Communicate loan updates clearly to internal stakeholders
  • Respond promptly to lender and underwriter requests
  • Escalate issues proactively to prevent funding or closing delays
  • Maintain professional relationships with lending partners

Loan Pipeline Management

  • Track active loan files from submission through closing
  • Review loan reports and lender updates daily
  • Maintain accurate visibility into:
    • Current loan status
    • Outstanding conditions
    • Required documentation
    • Upcoming deadlines
    • Next steps
  • Identify bottlenecks before they impact closing timelines
  • Ensure every active loan has clear ownership and follow-up
  • Prioritize files based on deadlines and closing requirements
  • Keep loan statuses accurate and current across internal systems

Internal Team Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal teams to gather required documentation
  • Manage responses to lender and underwriting requests
  • Support timely submission of loan packages and updates
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding internal items
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on deadlines, requirements, and closing timelines
  • Ensure requested documentation reaches lenders promptly
  • Maintain clear ownership of outstanding action items

Documentation & File Management

  • Maintain complete and organized loan files
  • Ensure lender correspondence and documentation are properly recorded
  • Keep CRM and loan management systems accurate and current
  • Verify file completeness before important milestones
  • Maintain clear records throughout the lending process
  • Track documentation requirements and outstanding conditions
  • Ensure critical information can be quickly located when needed

Closing Coordination

  • Closely monitor loans approaching closing
  • Confirm outstanding conditions are addressed on time
  • Coordinate final requirements between lenders and internal stakeholders
  • Maintain visibility into expected closing and funding timelines
  • Follow up on last-mile documentation and approvals
  • Help prevent last-minute delays caused by missing information or communication gaps
  • Escalate potential closing risks early

Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies in loan processing and lender communication
  • Recommend improvements that reduce:
    • Processing delays
    • Communication gaps
    • Missed follow-ups
    • Loan cycle times
  • Help develop standardized workflows for pipeline management and lender coordination
  • Improve visibility and accountability across active loan files

Requirements

  • Proven experience in:
    • Loan Coordination
    • Loan Processing
    • Mortgage Operations
    • Lender Liaison roles
    • Similar lending positions
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. mortgage or lending process
  • Experience managing loan files from submission through closing
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple active loans simultaneously
  • Experience with:
    • CRM systems
    • Google Docs
    • Google Sheets
    • Google Calendar
  • Strong attention to detail and deadline management
  • Ability to proactively manage lender and underwriting follow-ups
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Availability for 30+ hours per week

Nice to Have

  • Experience with:
    • DSCR loans
    • Non-QM loans
    • Investment-property financing
  • Experience supporting real estate investors or investment-property transactions
  • Familiarity with:
    • Encompass
    • LendingPad
    • Jungo
    • Salesforce
    • Other loan management systems
  • Background in real estate acquisitions, dispositions, or operations
  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based:
    • Mortgage lenders
    • Mortgage brokers
    • Real estate investment firms

Tools & Technology

Encompass | LendingPad | Jungo | Salesforce | CRM Systems | Google Docs | Google Sheets | Google Calendar | Loan Management Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have successfully managed loans from submission through closing
  • Understand lender and underwriting workflows
  • Proactively follow up rather than waiting for reminders
  • Can manage multiple active files without losing accuracy
  • Stay organized when priorities and deadlines change quickly
  • Communicate confidently with lenders, underwriters, and internal stakeholders
  • Notice missing documentation and potential delays early
  • Take ownership of keeping every loan moving forward
  • Are comfortable escalating risks before they impact closing
  • Maintain accurate records throughout the entire loan lifecycle

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day by reviewing every active loan to identify new lender updates, outstanding conditions, missing documentation, and approaching deadlines.

Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with lenders and underwriters, follow up on outstanding conditions, coordinate documentation with internal teams, update loan statuses and CRM records, and track upcoming closing milestones.

You’ll also resolve or escalate potential bottlenecks and ensure loans approaching closing have their outstanding requirements completed.

In short: you keep every loan organized, every stakeholder informed, and every deadline moving toward a successful closing.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Loans progressing through the pipeline on schedule
  • Reduced delays caused by missing documentation or follow-ups
  • Accurate and up-to-date loan status tracking
  • Fast turnaround on lender and underwriting requests
  • Zero missed critical loan deadlines
  • Complete and organized loan documentation
  • Consistent stakeholder communication
  • Reduced number of stalled loan files
  • Improved loan cycle times and closing efficiency

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct ownership of active loan pipelines
  • High visibility across lending and real estate operations
  • Opportunity to work directly with lenders, underwriters, and internal stakeholders
  • Hands-on exposure to the complete loan lifecycle
  • Opportunity to develop expertise in:
    • Mortgage Operations
    • Investment-Property Lending
    • DSCR / Non-QM Financing
    • Real Estate Operations
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Loan Coordinator
    • Loan Processor
    • Mortgage Operations Manager
    • Lending Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer Stage

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in loan processing, mortgage operations, lender coordination, or real estate financing and know how to keep multiple loan files moving from submission through closing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of the lender communication, documentation, pipeline tracking, and closing coordination that keeps loans progressing efficiently.

jobs.description:
Job titleSenior Foundation Relations ManagerReports toSenior Director, Foundation RelationsFLSA StatusNon-ExemptPosition
Alliance for Justice (AFJ) is a national association of over 140 organizations representing a broad array of groups committed to progressive values and the creation of an equitable, just, and free society. AFJ’s programs comprisefour core pillars:
  • Our Bolder Advocacy program builds progressive power by providing nonprofit advocates with the training, technical assistance, and resources they need to comply with the federal and state laws associated with nonprofit advocacy. Bolder Advocacy is the nation’s leading resource for foundations and nonprofits who want to engage more actively and knowledgeably in the policymaking process.
  • AFJ Law deepens our support of nonprofits’ advocacy, strengthen the progressive movement’s ability to advocate within the bounds of IRS restrictions on tax-exempt organizations, and ensure compliance to keep their organizations safe. AFJ Law goes beyond providing technical assistance to providing legal advice on nonprofit clients’ activities.
  • Our Justice Program works to ensure that our state and federal courts protect our democracy and our core rights and values, preserve human rights, and provide access to justice for all. We research federal judicial nominees, educate the public and elected leaders about them, and advocate for demographically and professionally diverse nominees, who will protect our rights.
  • Our Outreach & Membership team deepens and expands the engagement of AFJ’s core constituencies, including supporting our member organizations with Bolder Advocacy, judicial nominations, and capacity building resources to advance their missions. We also educate and mobilize members, partners, and advocates with the tools and AFJ resources they need to advocate for courts that protect the rights of all us and defend nonprofits’ role in protecting our democracy.

AFJAction promotes a national conversation about the importance of the courts and other key AFJ issues through advocacy, research, and mobilizing progressive advocates and voters. It also serves as the leading expert on the legal framework for 501(c)(4) nonprofit advocacy efforts because we believe it will take all of us to defend our democracy.

Job Description


AFJ's Senior Foundation Relations Manager works closely with Senior Director, Foundation Relations to ensure AFJ meets its grant revenue goals through the timely submission of proposals and reports, a focus on growing and deepening relationships with AFJ's foundations and developing a prospective foundation pipeline. This role isalso responsible for many of the administrative management tasks for AFJ's foundation relationships. This role will report directly to the Senior Director, Foundation Relations.

Duties and ResponsibilitiesGrant Writing:

  • Support Senior Director, Foundation Relations in the completion of LOI, report and proposal deadlines. Build templates of LOI, reports, and proposals for entire foundation relations portfolio; create first drafts for Senior Director, Foundation Relations as directed; provide proofing and formatting for final drafts priorto submission; and submit as requested.
  • Manage a portfolio of funders $75k/per year and below to maximize the relationship with support from theSenior Director, Foundation Relations as needed. Present ideas for relationship building and grant growth.Responsible for management of this portfolio.
  • Along with the Senior Director, Foundation Relations liaise with Finance to receive the required budgets for reports and proposals.
  • Pull data on grant deliverables working with program teams as needed for reports and internal grant check-ins.
  • Research and prepare briefing memos on foundations as requested - prior to meetings and/or to develop pipeline of prospects.
  • Through ClickUp, manage grant deadlines working with the Senior Director, Foundation Relations to map out project plan timelines.
  • Utilize ClickUp to project manage other work as needed - stewardship plans, templates for funder outreach, semi-annual review of materials etc.
  • Manage quarterly internal grant check ins for grants with project deliverables to ensure progress remains on track.
  • Oversee quarterly updates of grant boilerplate language and maintain library of standard templates and language

Grants Management:
  • Maintain EveryAction (EA) database records for our Foundations grants ensuring accurate and up todate information including relationships, contacts, deadlines, follow ups and miscellaneous information.
  • Maintain Grants Module in EveryAction to track grants including amount, status, purpose, grant period and date received.
  • Enter all grants details into the database to be contained in the Grants Module (note: does not input gifts but the balance of information) ensuring deadlines, grant periods, pledge payment dates etc. are complete.
  • Create grant acknowledgment letters and track in EA.
  • Support processing and routing of foundation grant agreements.
  • Serve as secondary support for foundation contacts.

Other:

  • Support individual giving and other development team members as needed.
  • Additional tasks as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years' experience in foundation fundraising or 5+ years in development with a foundation relations focus
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ClickUp (Project Management Software).
  • Comfortable working with database software programs such as EveryAction.
  • Excellentwrittencommunicationskills
  • Outstanding attention to detail and deadlines
  • Resourcefulness and ability to think independently
  • Ability to take ownership of a process and use problem-solving skills to resolve issues
  • Strong professionalism with the ability to function efficiently in a busy, fast paced environment
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with minimal supervision

Compensation and Benefits

This is a union position covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with the Washington-Baltimore News Guild, CWA Local 32035, which includes salary minimums based on job position category. This position is in job group 5 and has a starting annual salary range of $93,425-$103,582.

We offer a comprehensive and generous benefits program, including:

Insurance
We offer medical, dental, vision benefits, as well as an employee assistance program for physical and mental well-being.

Retirement
Save for retirement with our 401K plan with a 5% employer contribution. Other insurances include life and disability.

Time Off
  • Year 1 (0-12 months): Eleven (11) days of vacation each year (3.66 hours per pay period), with a maximum accrual cap of 17 days
  • Year 2-4: Sixteen (16) days of vacation each year (5.33 hours per pay period), with a maximum accrual cap of 24 days
  • Year 4+: Twenty-One (21 days) of vacation each year (7.0 hours per pay period), with a maximum accrual cap of 32 days

Parental Leave
Eligible employees may take up to sixteen (16) total weeks of leave in connection with the birth of the employee’s child, placement of a child with the employee for adoption, or gaining of a foster child. AFJ will provide eligible employees with twelve (12) weeks of fully paid parental leave for purposes of bonding with a new baby following a birth or placement of a child for adoption or gaining of a foster child.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer and communicate with others while doing so. On occasion, travel by car, train, and/or airplane may be required. Ability to work long hours when needed (though rare). All employees are required to satisfactorily perform the essential duties and responsibilities of their positions. The essential duties and responsibilities listed above are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the job.

Work Environment

This is a full-time position that can be fully remote.

For employees located outside of Washington, DC or working remotely in the DC area, travel to events such as staff retreats and other work meetings will be requiredapproximately one to four times per year.

Direct Reports

This position does not currently haveany direct supervisory responsibilities but may in the future as the team grows.

jobs.excerpt: THE OPPORTUNITYJoin a team that’s changing financial services Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors.
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a team that’s changing financial services

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

We're a venture-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.


WHO YOU ARE

The SHARC in the room

At Zocks, we hire for SHARC - five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.

S - Sharp

You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution - you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.

H - Hungry

You're a self-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.

A - Adaptable

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.

R - Resilient

Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

C - Curious

You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work - and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

What You'll Do

The Account Manager is responsible for owning the full post-sale lifecycle for a set of customers from the moment they sign through their renewal. This role blends onboarding ownership with long-term account management. You will guide customers through setup, launch, early adoption, and ongoing success, ensuring they achieve fast time-to-value and remain successful and retained customers.

You will run structured onboarding for the first 60 days, then continue as the primary relationship manager responsible for adoption, sentiment, value realization, renewal readiness, and churn prevention. You will identify risks early, build multi-threaded relationships, run health reviews, and execute a consistent renewal playbook. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves helping customers win, shaping process, and driving measurable retention outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Onboarding Ownership (First 60 Days)

  • Act as the single-threaded owner for every new customer during onboarding.
  • Run kickoff calls, define success criteria, align on use cases, and ensure a clean sales-to-onboarding handoff.
  • Guide customers through setup, integrations, configuration, and go-live.
  • Manage timelines, remove blockers, and keep customers moving to activation.
  • Teach users how to use Zocks with live trainings, walkthroughs, and simple enablement content.
  • Ensure a smooth post-onboarding transition while staying on as the ongoing account owner.

Adoption and Value Realization

  • Drive user activation and usage across key product features.
  • Monitor customer engagement signals including meeting volume, utilization, integration completion, and workflow setup.
  • Run scheduled check-ins to reinforce value, highlight wins, and review progress.
  • Build repeatable playbooks for increasing adoption and correcting early usage gaps.
  • Partner with Product and RevOps to share insights on customer needs and feature impact.

Churn Prevention and Account Health

  • Own Gross ARR Retention and renewal outcomes for your book of business.
  • Maintain clear visibility into account health using dashboards, health scores, and engagement metrics.
  • Identify churn risks early and execute save plays including sentiment resets, retraining, and workflow redesign.
  • Document risks and escalate where necessary with clear recommended actions.
  • Ensure ongoing alignment with customer goals and continuously reinforce ROI.
Renewal Management (120 days leading up to renewal)
  • Own renewal preparation, forecasting accuracy, and timely execution.
  • Run structured renewal processes including usage reviews, performance summaries, and value recap meetings.
  • Confirm contract terms, seat counts, and pricing ahead of renewal cycles.
  • Manage renewal negotiations directly with customers and ensure renewal approval happens on time.
  • Maintain renewal documentation in Salesforce with clean, complete data.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Partner with Sales to ensure a smooth handoff at contract signature and clarity on success outcomes.
  • Work with Product on implementation feedback, customer asks, and adoption blockers.
  • Collaborate with RevOps to improve onboarding and retention reporting, health scoring, and automation.
  • Work with Support for escalations and ensure customers understand engagement paths after onboarding.

Operational Excellence

  • Document customer configurations, onboarding progress, known risks, and adoption milestones.

jobs.description:
About Nimbus

Nimbus is a leading independent mediation platform powering monetization for some of the most sophisticated mobile publishers globally.

Our platform enables publishers to access brand and performance demand across SDK and server-side partnership integrations, delivering transparency, control, and measurable revenue outcomes in an increasingly complex ecosystem.

As the industry shifts toward auction-based monetization and supply path optimization (SPO), Nimbus is positioned as a neutral, high-performance alternative to legacy and vertically integrated platforms.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for an all-star Senior Publisher Partnerships Manager, in Gaming to help expand Nimbus’ relationships across leading mobile gaming publishers. This role will focus on identifying strategic partnership opportunities, growing publisher revenue, managing commercial discussions, and helping gaming publishers maximize monetization performance through Nimbus’ mediation and exchange platform.

How will you help us achieve it?

As a strategic member of the Publisher Partnerships team, you will own and grow relationships across a portfolio of mobile gaming publishers. Your primary objectives are to generate new business opportunities, expand existing publisher relationships, and help publishers maximize monetization outcomes across the Nimbus platform.

You value building trusted relationships and understand how to position Nimbus as a sophisticated, publisher-first monetization platform. You communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders and are comfortable navigating conversations around gaming monetization strategy, mediation, user acquisition dynamics, and mobile app growth.

You understand the complexities of the gaming monetization ecosystem and know how to identify opportunities across a wide range of gaming genres and publisher profiles. You are highly knowledgeable in the mobile gaming advertising landscape and understand the importance of balancing monetization performance, user experience, retention, and LTV optimization.

Internally, you are highly collaborative and work cross-functionally with Account Management, Demand Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, Product, Auction Science, and Executive Leadership to help deliver outstanding outcomes for publishers. Your teammates would describe you as relationship-oriented, proactive, analytical, entrepreneurial, and commercially driven.

The responsibilities of the role

Identify, develop, and close strategic partnerships with mobile gaming publishers across a variety of gaming verticals and app categories.

Manage and grow relationships with publisher accounts by understanding business objectives, identifying monetization opportunities, and positioning Nimbus as a long-term strategic partner.

Maintain strong understanding of and Lead publisher-facing conversations across:

  • Gaming monetization strategy
  • Mediation strategy
  • Programmatic monetization
  • SDK onboarding
  • Auction performance
  • Demand partner strategy
  • Yield optimization opportunities
  • Product adoption
  • Strategic growth initiatives

Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of gaming publisher opportunities through outbound prospecting, referrals, conferences, networking, and strategic relationship development.

Collaborate closely with Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Demand teams to ensure successful onboarding, operational alignment, and long-term publisher success.

Monitor publisher performance trends and work cross-functionally to identify opportunities that improve monetization outcomes and overall publisher satisfaction.

Represent Nimbus externally across industry conferences, client meetings, networking events, and strategic ecosystem conversations.

Assist with strategic GTM initiatives including:

  • Publisher presentations
  • Monetization recommendations
  • Case studies
  • Conference initiatives
  • Market intelligence
  • Ecosystem positioning

Support internal operational initiatives including pipeline management, forecasting, CRM updates, publisher onboarding coordination, and strategic account planning.

What you bring to the role

5+ years of ad tech experience with a strong understanding of the mobile gaming programmatic ecosystem, including gaming publishers, SSPs, DSPs, mediation platforms, and in-app monetization infrastructure.

Deep familiarity with gaming monetization, SDK-based advertising, user acquisition economics, and programmatic advertising across iOS and Android ecosystems.

Proven track record of developing and growing strategic gaming publisher relationships while driving measurable revenue growth and long-term account expansion.

Familiarity with major gaming monetization platforms and ecosystems including:

  • AppLovin MAX
  • LevelPlay
  • AdMob
  • Unity
  • Rewarded and interstitial monetization strategies

A passion for identifying growth opportunities and solving complex monetization challenges through strategic thinking, relationship building, and data-driven recommendations.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance trends, identify monetization opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations to publishers.

Experience working cross-functionally with:

  • publishers,
  • account management,
  • product teams,
  • engineering,
  • solutions engineering,
  • and demand teams

while effectively communicating complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills with experience managing executive-level publisher conversations and long-term strategic partnerships.

Highly self-motivated and comfortable operating independently in a lean, fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

Effective time management skills with the ability to prioritize opportunities, manage multiple strategic relationships, and maintain strong attention to detail.

Professional demeanor and excellent verbal/written communication skills across in-person meetings, conferences, video calls, email, and Slack.

Existing relationships across the mobile gaming publisher ecosystem are strongly preferred.

BS or BA is desirable.

Nimbus offers a rare combination of sophisticated technology, a high-caliber team, and a premium, publisher-aligned platform operating independently in the market. With a strong demand footprint across both brand and performance, competitive compensation, and a balanced work-life dynamic, the company is positioned for sustained high growth with real momentum. As a profitable business, Nimbus provides not only stability but also a clear opportunity to make a meaningful, measurable impact on its trajectory.

Nimbus provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Bengali
Type:Contract
Compensation:$13/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: find a publicly accessible Bengali PDF in an assigned document type, containing at least one multimodal element (images, tables, diagrams, or handwriting), and record where you obtained it.
  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.

Must-Have

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.
  • Systematic application of a taxonomy across hundreds of pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts: multi-column newspapers, exam papers, handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Regional-language AI data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation for training datasets.
  • Transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction or post-editing.
  • Document production: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Bengali-language material.
  • Script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Bengali input methods, numeral-form and character-form accuracy.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why South Africa

South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is a good deal closer to home than it is for our teams elsewhere.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in South Africa.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

jobs.excerpt: In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money.
jobs.description:
In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem.

Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard.

Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Key responsibilities:

  • Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it
  • Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the future, lending
  • Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate
  • Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better
  • Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
  • Grow the business: own acquisition, activation, retention, and the loops that compound, including how personal banking connects to the businesses Mercury already serves
  • Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
  • Align the ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy

Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:

  • A consumer product leader with taste: you have built products millions of people chose to use, and can point to the decisions that made them work
  • You have shipped AI-led products to real consumers and have opinions about what AI makes possible and where it fails
  • An exceptionally high bar for craft, and a customer-centered, data-driven, and experimentation-oriented approach
  • 10+ years building consumer products, including time owning a product's growth and economics, not only its roadmap

  • Experience launching and scaling 0-1 products, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it

  • Nice to have: banking, payments, or fintech experience. We can teach you the rails; we cannot teach product judgment

Description

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to help grow our B2B business by building pipeline and winning new enterprise customers. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys outbound prospecting, navigating complex enterprise deals, and working in a fast-moving environment where you can directly influence how we approach and win new business.

What you will do

Key Responsibilities:

  • Spend 80%+ of your time prospecting and building your own pipeline, targeting Mid-Market and Enterprise companies with $1B+ in annual revenue.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of new opportunities through cold outbound across email, LinkedIn, calls, events, referrals, and creative prospecting channels.
  • Research and map target accounts, identify the right entry points, and multi-thread across 3+ stakeholders rather than relying on a single contact.
  • Own the full sales cycle from first outbound touch to closed-won, including discovery, business case development, negotiation, procurement, and contracting.
  • Identify and develop internal champions, equipping them with the business case, ROI narrative, and materials they need to sell Nebius Academy internally.
  • Navigate complex Enterprise buying processes by identifying champions, economic buyers, decision-makers, and potential blockers early in the cycle.
  • Take ownership of stalled opportunities: understand why deals stop moving and actively create a path forward, rather than relying on standard follow-ups.
  • Work closely with SDRs on account selection, messaging, prospecting tactics, and handoffs, sharing feedback on what converts into real opportunities.
  • Bring senior leadership and founders into strategic opportunities when their involvement can materially increase the likelihood of closing the deal.
  • Test new messaging, channels, and outbound approaches and use response rates, meetings booked, pipeline generated, and conversion data to continuously improve your sales motion.
  • Bring market and customer insights back to the team to help refine our ICP, positioning, messaging, and Enterprise GTM strategy.
  • Own an annual revenue quota and be accountable for both pipeline creation and closed revenue.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience, including 2+ years in an SDR/BDR role and at least 1 year as an Account Executive.
  • Proven experience working with both Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts, including companies with $1B+ in annual revenue.
  • Experience selling deals with $40K+ annual ACV, with clear ownership of pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Strong outbound background is mandatory — you should be comfortable generating pipeline yourself through cold calls, email, LinkedIn, events, referrals, and other channels.
  • Experience working in a sales organization with a dedicated SDR function and a clear understanding of effective SDR–AE collaboration and handoffs.
  • Proven ability to manage multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles, including champions, decision-makers, economic buyers, procurement, and blockers.
  • Clear evidence of professional growth and increasing responsibility — promotions, expanded territories, larger accounts, higher quotas, leadership responsibilities, or becoming a top performer in a specific area.
  • Proven top performance, supported by quota attainment, revenue/pipeline results, or top-performer recognition.
  • Experience in early- or mid-stage B2B companies; exposure to larger organizations (200+ employees) is a plus.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and hands-on, comfortable working with evolving processes and taking ownership without waiting for perfect structure.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 5000-6000 USD base per month + commissions
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • A diverse team across Europe, the US, Latin America and more.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

Job title:Senior Product Manager - PCE Platform & APIs

Reports to:Principal Product Manager

Department:Product Management

Location:Remote (US/ CAN)

Grade:20

About Priority Commerce:

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Priority Commerce Engine (PCE) Platform & APIs, setting product direction, leading the roadmap, and shaping how Priority’s financial capabilities are exposed consistently across products, partners, and developer experiences. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You will turn complex platform problems into clear product requirements, API behavior, lifecycle models, and roadmap decisions. You will work across payments, onboarding, transactions, accounts, banking, treasury, and financial operations, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture. The ideal candidate combines strong API and platform product experience with deep banking or payments expertise, strong product judgment, and the ability to lead through influence across multiple teams.

Domain Areas You'll Own

This role spans a broad set of Platform and API responsibilities. We’re looking for someone with hands-on experience across most of the following, and the appetite to go deep on the rest:

  • Platform APIs and Product Contracts: Shape the business concepts, lifecycle semantics, events, and API behavior exposed through PCE.

  • Financial Capability APIs: Lead product direction across transactions, money movement, onboarding, entities, accounts, banking, treasury, balances, and financial operations.

  • Platform Capability Expansion: Assess new and evolving capabilities and determine their implications for PCE Platform & APIs.

  • API Lifecycle and Evolution: Own compatibility, versioning, migration, coexistence, and deprecation across the API portfolio.

  • Cross-Product Platform Strategy: Identify recurring needs across products, partners, and developer experiences and determine which warrant common Platform capabilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve the product strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for PCE Platform &

  • APIs, tied to measurable customer, developer, and business outcomes.

  • Shape the business concepts, lifecycle semantics, events, integration behavior, and

  • requirements exposed through PCE APIs, partnering with Engineering and Architecture

  • on technical design.

  • Lead Platform and API initiatives spanning transactions, money movement, onboarding,

  • entities, accounts, banking, treasury, and financial operations.

  • Take ambiguous, cross-functional Platform problems and drive them to clear

  • requirements, trade-offs, and product decisions.

  • Maintain visibility into new and evolving capabilities and determine their implications for

  • the Platform roadmap.

  • Identify recurring integration needs and determine when they warrant common Platform

  • capabilities versus product-specific solutions.

  • Own the Product direction for API compatibility, versioning, migration, coexistence, and deprecation.

  • Partner with Developer Enablement and Embedded Product teams to ensure Platform capabilities are ready for adoption across developer and embedded experiences.

  • Define and track Platform outcomes such as API adoption, cross-product usage, migration progress, and integration consistency.

  • Stay hands-on through execution, using AI and modern product tools to accelerate analysis, requirements, stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation, and working closely with Engineering and Program or Project Management to move initiatives through delivery.

  • Communicate Platform strategy, priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to Product, Engineering, Architecture, and executive stakeholders.

  • Prioritize Platform investments based on customer value, business impact, cross-product

  • leverage, dependencies, risk, and long-term Platform value.

What Success Looks Like:

  • First 90 days: You understand PCE’s major API domains, consumers, current roadmap, and Platform opportunities, and have developed a clear point of view on priorities and gaps.

  • 6 months: The Platform roadmap is executing predictably, API product definitions and lifecycle decisions are clearer, and alignment across Product, Engineering, and Architecture has improved.

  • 12 months: PCE APIs are increasingly adopted across products and integrations, Platform decisions are being made proactively, and new capabilities can be introduced with greater consistency and less one-off integration work.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Roughly 7 to 10 years of relevant Product Management experience, including meaningful ownership of platform, API, integration, or technically complex products. This is a guide, not a gate. We hire on demonstrated impact.

  • Deep banking and/or payments expertise, with practical understanding of transactions, money movement, accounts, balances, settlement, onboarding, and financial operations.

  • Hands-on experience owning API or platform products that support multiple applications, partners, or external integrations.

  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, events, asynchronous workflows, lifecycle modeling, versioning, backward compatibility, and integration patterns.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial capabilities into clear product requirements and API behavior.

  • Strong product judgment and experience independently taking ambiguous, cross-functional problems from discovery through delivery.

  • Experience evolving APIs over time, including migration, compatibility, modernization, and adoption.

  • Fluency working with Engineering and Architecture on technical trade-offs and influencing teams without direct authority.

  • Strong roadmap, prioritization, communication, and executive stakeholder-management skills.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted Product workflows and a hands-on approach to requirements, stories, acceptance criteria, analysis, and documentation when needed.

Nice to Have

  • Experience across multiple financial domains such as merchant acquiring, banking, treasury, payables, onboarding or underwriting, ledgering, reconciliation, or money movement.

  • Experience with payment rails such as ACH, RTP/FedNow, cards, wires, or checks.

  • Experience building API platforms that support multiple processors, financial institutions, providers, or business domains.

  • Experience with OpenAPI, webhooks, API gateways, idempotency, SDK ecosystems, developer platforms, or API observability.

  • Experience managing API migrations or deprecations across multiple consumers.

  • Experience working in regulated financial environments.

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:$116k - $167k USD/ $100k - $137k CAD

Compensation range:

We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

Health & Well-being

PPD is revolutionizing patient recruitment. As the clinical research business of Thermo Fisher Scientific, PPD has launched Patient First, a group dedicated to enhancing the patient experience from the first click to the final visit. Using human-centered, digitally enabled solutions, Patient First optimizes patient recruitment and engagement, site operations, and quality data collection.

PPD is seeking a Senior Patient Recruitment and Engagement Lead (PREL) to join our global Patient Recruitment team. This team is made up of functional leads dedicated to recruitment on clinical studies, owning the entire process and overseeing implementation and effectiveness of the global recruitment strategy.

This is a home-based position for candidates in the USA with global recruitment strategy and trial management experience. The successful candidate will have functional Lead experience within a team setting and customer management skills, including heavy data analysis experience to create reporting and insights into recruitment successes and challenges for presentation to client.

Functional Lead:

  • Acts as a Functional Lead for global recruitment and retention strategies and associated initiatives.
  • Integrate with larger PPD study team throughout start-up and enrollment period, communicating updates with Clinical Team Managers and CRA's.
  • Work with local teams to understand patient pathways on a country level and that region-appropriate methods are used and requirements met.
  • Works to identify potential risks, develops contingency plans and escalates issues as appropriate.
  • Acts as Subject Matter Authority for patient recruitment and retention topics in all client communications.
  • Tracks metrics and builds progress reports on enrollment targets.

Strategy:

  • Develops and owns the study recruitment and retention plan, implements patient recruitment and retention strategies globally.
  • Identifies potential barriers to recruitment and retention and develops risk mitigation plans.
  • Works closely with the Central Recruitment campaign team to identify strategic solutions for specific patient populations.
  • Provides support for proposals and bid defenses around recruitment lead activities.

Third Party-Vendor Collaboration:

  • Coordinates the quality and performance of third-party providers and addresses issues.
  • Works with PPD Finance contact to manage financial matters, ensures invoices are accurate and timely. Oversight for vendor budget.
  • Coordinates communication between providers, clients, and the internal study team.

Patient Diversity:

  • Collaborates with the Patient Population Science team to ensure that the Diversity Plan is reflected within the greater Study Recruitment and Retention Plan.
  • Ensures all client diversity requirements are considered during strategy design and monitored throughout enrollment.
  • Monitors patient diversity metrics throughout the study and reports progress to clients.
  • Gathers feedback from study teams and clients to review vendor performance and provides feedback to the Vendor Relationship Lead.

  • Previous patient recruitment management experience, including creation and management of global trial strategies, that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years)
  • In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of appropriate education, training, and/or directly related experience will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Quality Assurance Department does at Worldwide

The Quality Assurance department sets the bar high when it comes to quality. We are committed to exceeding the quality standards required by our sponsors, study participants, and regulatory authorities. Our QA culture is based on an environment where staff are trained, energized, and empowered to deliver high-quality products to our employees and customers.

What you will do

  • Partner with the EVP, Global Quality to develop and execute the global quality and compliance strategy.

  • Provide leadership for quality management activities across all clinical research services, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and regulatory expectations.

  • Serve as a senior member of the Quality Leadership Team and contribute to enterprise quality governance initiatives.

  • Lead quality transformation and quality maturity initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, inspection readiness, and client confidence.

This role manages high-value supplier relationships and negotiates enterprise-wide agreements while participating in acquisition strategy for pozzolanic materials and supporting global supply chain efforts for these materials. The position shifts purchasing from a reactive activity to a proactive, data-driven strategy. This work directly impacts Graymont’s profitability by lowering the total cost of LCCS production while maintaining quality standards and ensuring a stable, reliable supply of pozzolanic materials to Graymont’s operations.

Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

  • Develop Plans: Create multi-year sourcing plans for critical pozzolanic categories.

  • Analyze Data: Review company spending data to identify cost-saving consolidation opportunities.

  • Assist Acquisition Strategy: Work with corporate teams to assess and evaluate potential pozzolanic material acquisitions and participate in due diligence activities.

Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)

  • Evaluate Vendors: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop improvement criteria. This will include product quality, supply, and related performance metrics.

  • Lead Business Reviews: Host periodic business reviews with critical partners (internal and external) to drive continuous improvement and keep critical information flowing.

  • Resolve Issues: Act as the main point of escalation for major supplier performance failures in the pozzolanic material category while working with regional procurement, supply chain, and operations teams to support day-to-day ordering and product flow.

  • Foster Innovation: Partner with vendors and responsible Graymont teams to assess and gain early access to new pozzolanic technologies and processes.

Contract & Price Negotiation

  • Lead Supply Negotiations: Draft and manage complex Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and Requests for Quotes (RFQs), and coordinate with the Graymont teams responsible for these processes.

  • Lead Price Negotiations: Secure optimal pricing, payment terms, and service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Manage Contracts: Partner with legal and procurement teams to draft, review, and renew master service agreements (MSAs).

Qualifications

Founded in 1948, Graymont is a trusted global leader in essential calcium-based solutions. Professionally managed and family-owned, we proudly serve a wide range of markets, customers, and communities in North America and Asia Pacific. Graymont is also the strategic partner of Grupo Calidra, the largest lime producer in Latin America.
