ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is an independent, female-founded and led New Zealand wellness brand established, inspired by her background in health science and nutrition.

The company develops science-led nutritional supplements and modern wellness essentials using high-quality, carefully selected ingredients, including superfoods, functional herbs, and bioavailable micronutrients. Its product range includes hydration powders, protein supplements, marine collagen, gut health products, and other targeted wellness solutions. The company is committed to transparency, quality, and evidence-based formulations, with products formulated in New Zealand and independently tested and verified to support overall health and long-term wellbeing.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The Offshore Bookkeeper / Accounting Assistant manages daily transnational transactional accounting, inventory-linked payables, receivables, and platform reconciliations across New Zealand and Australia. The role serves as the operational engine for day-to-day financial controls, directly supporting executive leadership and an external accounting partner. It begins as a remote part-time engagement (20-30 hours per week) with a clear roadmap to expand into full month-end ownership and commercial reporting.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Accounts payable

  • Process non-stock invoices and bills, coding them correctly across NZ and AU
  • Process stock invoices and receipt purchase orders against supplier invoices and process related stock adjustments
  • Reconcile supplier statements and follow up discrepancies
  • Prepare weekly payment batches for approval (the role will not have authority to release payments)

Bank reconciliations and inbox

  • Reconcile NZ and AU bank accounts [daily / at least twice weekly]
  • Clear Shopify clearing accounts and resolve unreconciled lines
  • Manage the shared accounts inbox, file documents and respond to or escalate queries

Accounts receivable and credit control

  • Raise wholesale customer invoices and send monthly customer statements for NZ and AU wholesale accounts
  • Follow up overdue accounts in line with our credit terms and escalate as needed
  • Respond to customer invoice queries

Payroll and cash flow support

  • Prepare payroll inputs and process pay runs for approval [system; iPayroll and fortnightly frequency]

• Update the weekly cash flow report

Month-end and accounting support (desirable)

  • Prepare monthly reporting workpapers and complete balance sheet reconciliations
  • Post monthly journals for prepayments, accruals, depreciation and annual leave liabilities, and maintain the fixed asset register
  • Manage intercompany invoicing, recharges and reconciliations between NZ and AU, including Australian wholesale and The Memo transactions
  • Review inventory and cost of sales, including stock adjustments, sales and COGS checks, and samples and giveaways

• Prepare NZ GST returns

• Prepare AU BAS for review

  • Prepare the monthly management reporting pack for review
  • Write and maintain process documentation for each finance task

Process improvement and analysis (nice to have)

  • Find ways to automate the Shopify, PayPal and payment platform reconciliations and cut down manual month-end work
  • Spot gaps, errors and cost-saving opportunities in suppliers, subscriptions and processes, and raise them proactively
  • Update the monthly actuals in the 3+9 forecast model and prepare variance commentary for review
  • Build and improve reporting templates and dashboards

Requirements

Essential

  • At least 3-5 years of bookkeeping experience, ideally in e-commerce, FMCG or another inventory-based business
  • Strong working knowledge of Xero including bank feeds, bills, journals and multi-currency
  • Experience reconciling Shopify and integrations with Xero
  • Experience with inventory, purchase orders and cost of goods and systems experience e.g. Unleashed (but open to other systems as we could consider changing)
  • Understanding of NZ GST, AU GST and BAS
  • Clear written English and a habit of asking questions early
  • High attention to detail and good judgement about when to escalate
    •

Desirable

  • Accounting qualification, either completed or in progress (CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent)
  • Experience with multi-entity or intercompany accounting
  • Experience with Xero, Shopify, Unleashed or similar tools
  • Strong Excel skills, including working with forecast models
  • Interest in automating work and improving processes

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.
  • A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures.
  • A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed.
  • A project you managed or a team you led or mentored.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About L & E Research, Inc.  L&E Research has connected companies with people since 1984.
jobs.description:
About L & E Research, Inc.

L&E Research has connected companies with people since 1984. Market research agencies, brands, healthcare and life sciences teams, and law firms rely on us to recruit the right participants for qualitative and quantitative research, then host their sessions in our focus group facilities and sensory labs or online.

We run facilities in Chicago, Cincinnati, Columbus, Denver, New York City, Orlando, Raleigh and Tampa, and serve clients through three practices: L&E Health, L&E Consumer and L&E Legal (mock trial and jury research). We’re dual ISO-certified (ISO 20252 and ISO 27001), and 99% of our clients say they’d recommend us.

Digital Marketing Manager

Full-Time | US Remote | EST or MST

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager to own L&E’s marketing day to day. This is a doer’s job. You’ll plan, write, build, launch and measure most of what we put into the market yourself, with freelance help, where it makes sense, not a full-time agency doing the work for you. This role reports to the Chief Marketing Officer.

Our buyers are researchers: agency project directors, insights leads at brands, clinical research teams and trial consultants. They’re skeptical of fluff. They buy on trust, speed and quality. We need someone who can take what our sales and recruiting teams know and turn it into content those buyers actually use, then show us with numbers what’s working.

The foundation is already in place: a new Webflow site, HubSpot, product analytics and automated lead routing. What we need now is a marketer who uses all of it every week.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Create content (the biggest part of the job)

  • Plan and produce a steady stream of content: blog posts, case studies, guides, email newsletters, webinars, sales collateral, LinkedIn posts and landing pages.
  • Interview our recruiters, project managers and sales team to get their expertise out of their heads and onto the page.
  • Refresh our library of older ebooks and white papers and relaunch them as gated HubSpot offers.
  • Build content for each of our core segments: Healthcare/Clinical, Consumer/Brand, Legal/Mock Jury and research agencies.

Own HubSpot and marketing operations

  • Run HubSpot Marketing Hub: lists, workflows, nurture sequences, forms, lead scoring and attribution reporting.
  • Keep the database clean. Work with Sales on lifecycle stages, MQL definitions and handoff rules.
  • Manage the company’s three websites on Webflow: publishing, landing pages and on-page SEO/AEO.

Work side by side with Sales

  • Lead a weekly sales and marketing meeting: what’s landing with prospects, where deals stall, what Sales needs from marketing.
  • Build the collateral Sales asks for: one-pagers, battlecards, proposal inserts and email templates.
  • Turn win/loss feedback into messaging changes.

Measure everything

  • Report monthly on marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion by channel and page, and content performance.
  • Use HubSpot and web analytics to find where visitors drop off before requesting a bid and fix it.
  • Stop doing what the numbers say isn’t working.

Run demand generation

  • Email, LinkedIn, SEO, and paid search or social where it earns its keep.
  • Support industry conferences and events.
  • Manage the marketing budget and any freelancers or vendors.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • First 30 days: Learn the business. Sit in on sales calls and with the recruiting team. Audit HubSpot and the company’s three websites. Ship your first piece of content.
  • First 60 days: A regular publishing cadence is running. The weekly sales and marketing meeting is established. A reporting dashboard is live.
  • First 90 days: A content calendar for the next two quarters, and early, measurable movement in leads and bid requests.
  • First year: Marketing is a reliable source of qualified pipeline targets, and the sales team will tell you marketing helps them win.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

  • 4–7 years of hands-on B2B digital marketing as a generalist: content, email, SEO, social, paid and marketing ops.
  • Real HubSpot experience. You’ve built workflows, lists and reports yourself, not just used them.
  • A track record of tying marketing to pipeline and revenue, with numbers you can talk through.
  • Nice to have: Agency experience, especially 2+ years working across multiple clients, problems and tech stacks.
  • Nice to have: Exposure to market research, B2B services, healthcare/life sciences or legal. Not required; we’ll teach you the industry.
  • Nice to have: Webflow or another modern CMS, GA4 or product analytics, basic HTML.
  • Nice to have: Webinar or video production.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong writing. You’ll share samples you wrote.
  • Smart use of AI tools to speed up research and drafting without lowering quality.

TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS

A Windows-based PC will be provided to all full-time employees. You'll also need:

  • Reliable high-speed internet/broadband connection.
  • Consistent and dependable phone service.

WHO YOU ARE

Beyond the technical skills, the right person for this role brings these qualities to the work every day:

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, virtual setting. You stay focused and productive working remotely, even when priorities shift quickly.
  • Works well independently and with a team. You are self-motivated and know when to take the lead and when to collaborate.
  • Communicates clearly. You write and speak well, and you are confident talking directly with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Stays organized. You set priorities, build a work schedule, track progress toward goals, and keep details, data, and activities in order.
  • Acts with integrity. You use sound business practices and hold yourself to standards that match our values.
  • Builds strong working relationships. You work cooperatively with others to set goals, solve problems, and make decisions that help the whole organization.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Occasional travel for trade shows and team meetings (about 10%).
  • Complete all training course assignments issued by HR/IT.
  • Adhere to the ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 20252 standards.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

CLICK APPLY NOW TO GET STARTED

We read every application, and we want to know you read this post all the way through.

Key Phrase - Webflow.

This job summary outlines primary responsibilities but is not intended to be all-inclusive. Duties may be modified or expanded to reflect business needs and the natural progression of the role.

L&E Research, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

As the Sales Operations Analyst, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the commercial operations of USGBC and GBCI. In this role, you'll transform commercial data and business needs into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and effective Salesforce workflows that support sales efficiency and effectiveness.

You'll support Market Leads, Account Management teams, and leadership with pipeline, forecasting, account coverage, customer retention, expansion, and partner performance reporting. You'll also perform business analysis to define Salesforce requirements, test workflows, and support the adoption of approved commercial processes.

You will support global sales operations across all regions by helping establish consistent reporting practices, improving data quality, and providing accurate commercial insights that enable informed decision-making across markets.

You'll report to the director of sales operations and work closely with regional directors, market leads, account management, client solutions, sales enablement, technology, and finance to support sales success across all global regions and markets.

As an individual contributor within the global sales operations team, you will help standardize commercial data, reporting, and business processes while supporting regional teams with their operational and analytical needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Global commercial reporting and analytics:build and maintain approved reports and dashboards covering sales pipeline, conversion rates, opportunity stage aging, win/loss trends, account coverage, customer retention, expansion, and channel partner contributions. Coordinate with marketing and communications on campaign performance, lead routing, and return-on-investment reporting. Analyze material trends, identify data limitations, and recommend follow-up actions. Support consistent global reporting standards while providing regional and consolidated performance insights to commercial leadership.
  • Sales forecasting and commercial planning:prepare forecasting inputs, assumptions, scenarios, and variance analyses to support commercial planning and decision-making. Identify incomplete information, inconsistent opportunity values, and reporting discrepancies. Support territory planning, account coverage, quota and KPI distribution, and workload analysis while maintaining traceability and preserving opportunity owners' accountability for their forecasts. Help consolidate and analyze forecast data across global regions to improve reporting consistency, visibility, and accuracy.
  • Data quality, governance, and commercial attribution:monitor and improve data accuracy across salesforce accounts, contacts, opportunities, account hierarchies, required fields, customer and partner relationships, and commercial records. Identify duplicate or incomplete records, coordinate corrections with record owners, and reconcile approved commercial measures with finance to prevent duplicate attribution. Support the implementation and consistent application of global data quality standards, reporting definitions, and commercial attribution practices.
  • Salesforce business analysis and requirements documentation:gather and document business requirements, current and proposed workflows, user needs, field definitions, reporting logic, process handoffs, and acceptance criteria. Maintain a prioritized salesforce business-improvement backlog in partnership with the director of sales operations and technology. Collaborate with global stakeholders to identify regional business requirements and support scalable system improvements that align with approved global commercial processes.
  • System testing and change implementation:prepare and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate business testers, document defects, track testing results, and validate whether approved business requirements have been met. Support change readiness and coordinate with authorized technology teams for technical remediation and production deployment. Support cross-regional user testing and implementation readiness to ensure system changes are effective for global commercial teams.
  • Salesforce adoption and user support:develop process documentation, job aids, and user guidance to support the effective use of salesforce and approved commercial workflows. Provide targeted system demonstrations, troubleshoot business-process questions, and collaborate with sales enablement on training and reinforcement. Escalate access, security, integration, and technical issues to the appropriate technology teams. Support consistent CRM adoption and user understanding across regions, including teams operating in different time zones.
  • Commercial process improvement and standardization:maintain reporting schedules, metric definitions, process documentation, and audit trails. Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual work, and strengthen commercial processes through practical automation and process improvements. Protect confidential customer and partner information and operate within approved system permissions. Help develop and maintain standardized global reporting procedures, workflows, and documentation that support consistent commercial operations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and regional support:partner with regional directors, market leads, account managers, finance, technology, marketing, product, client solutions, and sales enablement to resolve reporting issues, clarify commercial workflows, and support operational improvements. Act as a central analytical and business-process resource for global commercial teams, supporting consistent data interpretation, knowledge sharing, and coordination across regions.
  • Analytical ownership and quality assurance:independently manage assigned reports, dashboards, data quality checks, business requirements, and testing activities. Select appropriate analytical methods, document findings and limitations, and recommend corrective actions within approved reporting definitions and system permissions. Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, consistent, well-documented, and appropriate for global commercial reporting.
  • Issue resolution, recommendations, and escalation:recommend improvements to commercial metrics, salesforce workflows, reporting processes, and system release readiness based on evidence. Escalate unresolved data disputes, system defects, sensitive information concerns, and competing workload priorities. Preserve established decision-making authority, with business owners approving material requirements and authorized technology owners approving system releases. Provide timely analysis and recommendations to support global sales operations leadership in addressing operational challenges and improving performance.

Assessment Notice

  • Candidates who advance in the interview process will be required to complete an assessment, more details will be provided as the time approaches.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • A minimum of three years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, or business analysis supporting customer-facing teams, including at least two years of hands-on experience with salesforce reporting and commercial workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience developing reports and dashboards, improving data quality, conducting user acceptance testing, and supporting business-process adoption.
  • Experience independently producing sales or business performance analysis and communicating findings to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Working experience with Salesforce reporting and commercial workflows, including accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, required fields, and process handoffs.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, mapping processes, defining acceptance criteria, conducting user acceptance testing, and tracking defects or issues.
  • Experience supporting sales operations, commercial reporting, or business analysis for teams operating across multiple regions or business units.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and consolidate data from multiple sources to support accurate performance reporting and business decisions.
  • Experience supporting commercial reporting or sales operations in a global or multinational organization.
  • Familiarity with SQL or other data querying methods used for business reporting and analysis.
  • Experience developing reporting dashboards, improving CRM data quality, or supporting process automation initiatives.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, business analytics, information systems, statistics, or a related field required.
  • Advanced degree in business analytics, information systems, business administration, or a related discipline preferred.

Technology/System(s)

  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM, including reporting, dashboards, account and contact management, lead and opportunity workflows, and data quality monitoring.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, Lookup functions, data validation, data reconciliation, and reporting analysis.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and data visualization tools.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including word, PowerPoint, Outlook, teams, and SharePoint, or comparable business productivity and collaboration platforms.
  • Experience with business requirements documentation, workflow mapping, user acceptance testing, and issue-tracking tools.

Skills

  • Strong spreadsheet analysis, data preparation, reconciliation, reporting, and quality-control skills, with the ability to document metric definitions and investigate inconsistencies.

ABOUT OUR TOTAL REWARDS PACKAGE

Final compensation and benefits will be confirmed at the time of offer and may vary based on factors such as internal equity, relevant experience, qualifications, and employment status. Please note that salary negotiations will not extend beyond the top of the internal salary range.

Benefits

USGBC covers 100% of the premiums and an HRA that will assist you and your dependents in reaching the in-network medical deductible. You will only be responsible for the $300 individual / $600 family up front deductible for medical services before the employer funded HRA will process payments for your in-network claims

jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries. But what really makes us SoftwareOne is our people: curious minds, different perspectives, and talented teams working together to solve real challenges and create meaningful impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology.


The role

  • Interested in building a greenfield, modern and forward-looking risk function where data, technology, and independent insight inform strategic decision-making?
  • Looking for a role with meaningful influence across executive leadership, the Board, and the wider business?

Practical Information

Location:Europe | Reports to: Global Head of Internal Audit, with direct access to the Audit Committee and Executive Board | Team:Group Risk Function of 3 FTE initially, will grow to 6 FTE | Language requirements: Fluent English, written and verbal | Learn more: softwareone.com

The Role

We are looking to appoint a Chief Risk Officer to lead SoftwareOne’s second-line Group Risk function and further develop our enterprise-wide approach to risk management. This is a newly established leadership role with a broad global mandate. You will bring an independent, enterprise-wide perspective on risk, ensuring that risk insight is embedded in strategic and commercial decision-making and supports SoftwareOne as the business continues to evolve. A central part of the role is to shape the next stage of SoftwareOne’s risk maturity, building a forward-looking, data-led and technology-enabled function that combines effective governance with practical business partnership and strengthens risk ownership across the organization. You will work closely with executive leadership and the Audit Committee, while collaborating across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Data Protection, and Internal Audit. This is a hands-on, high-energy role for a leader who wants to be judged on measurable impact: you will personally shape the models, challenge the numbers, and tell the risk story to the Board.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously evolve SoftwareOne's enterprise risk management framework, risk appetite, tolerances and taxonomy, maintaining a consolidated view of strategic, operational, financial, technology, regulatory and emerging risks
  • Provide independent oversight and constructive challenge across the Group, monitoring risk exposure against appetite and ensuring timely escalation of material risks and breaches to executive and Board-level stakeholders
  • Strengthen forward-looking risk management through quantitative risk assessment (including financial quantification of principal risks and loss ranges, e.g., Monte Carlo simulation), scenario analysis, stress testing, key risk indicators and horizon scanning, bringing risk insight into strategic decisions, major transformations and significant commercial initiatives
  • Oversee the Group’s ICFR program end-to-end, including reporting on overall ICFR effectiveness to the Executive Board and Audit Committee, and provide second-line oversight of internal control and financial compliance frameworks, working closely with Finance and other control functions
  • Develop and mature SoftwareOne’s business continuity, crisis management, and operational resilience capability, while actively applying risk technology, analytics, automation, and AI to improve risk insight and decision-making
  • Lead and develop the Group Risk function and establish effective risk governance, including the Management Risk Committee, executive and Audit Committee reporting, and collaboration across key business functions

What we need to see from you

  • Significant senior leadership experience in enterprise risk management, including leading a second-line risk function within a complex multinational or similarly governed organization
  • A proven track record of designing, building, or significantly maturing ERM frameworks, risk appetite, governance, and executive and Board-level risk reporting, with specific, quantified examples of impact delivered
  • Strong quantitative and analytical risk capabilities, with hands-on experience in risk modelling, scenario analysis, stress testing, key risk indicators, and data-led decision support
  • Strong knowledge of internal control and financial compliance frameworks, including hands-on experience building, overseeing, or assessing ICFR, SOX, or equivalent programs
  • Sound independent judgement and credibility when engaging and constructively challenging senior executives, Audit or Risk Committees, and Boards, combined with a pragmatic and commercially minded approach to risk
  • An energetic, hands-on and technology-forward approach, with a bias for action and the ability to personally build risk models, drive new capabilities, and apply GRC technology, analytics, automation, and AI to strengthen risk management and decision-making
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex quantitative, operational, and financial risks into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences

What's On Offer

  • The opportunity to shape and mature SoftwareOne’s Group Risk function with a mandate covering ERM, risk appetite, financial control oversight, resilience, risk data, and reporting
  • Direct engagement with the Executive Board and Audit Committee, with the independence to provide objective challenge and escalate material risks where required
  • The opportunity to develop a more quantitative and forward-looking approach to risk, incorporating scenario modelling, continuous monitoring, analytics, and risk-sensing capabilities
  • Influence across strategic decisions including M&A and integration, major transformation, new products and markets, large deals, and technology and AI adoption
  • The mandate to advance SoftwareOne’s risk technology environment, including an integrated risk platform, automated KRI feeds, dashboards, continuous monitoring, and responsible use of AI
  • The opportunity to build and develop a multidisciplinary Group Risk team spanning enterprise risk, financial compliance, risk data and reporting, with business continuity and resilience capability planned as the function develops to be added as the functions develops, subject to confirmation

Review this Doc first!

Our client is hiring an AI Automation Engineer to bring all technical development, deployment, and fulfillment fully in-house, replacing a third-party agency that currently handles it. You'll build and own the custom middleware that connects AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to field service management systems like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro, so live phone conversations turn into accurate, booked jobs on a contractor's dispatch board. Beyond the build, your mission is reliability: proactively testing and monitoring voice agents so contractors get zero downtime and high booking accuracy, documenting the systems in clear SOPs, and laying the technical groundwork for upcoming enterprise industry partnerships in 2027. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you'll work directly with the founder and grow into technical leadership as the team expands.

If you're a proactive, code-first engineer who loves building voice agents and integrations that actually work in the real world, and you take pride in systems that never miss a call—this role could be a great fit for you. ✨

✅ Qualifications:

Must-Haves:

  • 🎙️ Voice AI Agent Experience– Hands-on experience building and deploying production voice agents with Vapi, Retell, Assistable, and/or ElevenLabs, including prompt tuning, latency optimization, and knowledge base design.
  • 💻 Real Coding Skills– Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript; you write, review, and debug your own code (no "vibe coding"). Comfort reading .NET / C# / C++ environments is a big plus.
  • 🔌 APIs, Middleware & Integrations– Proven experience building middleware and integrations using REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and SDKs.
  • ⚙️ GoHighLevel Expertise– Solid experience building workflows, automations, and sub-account setups in GoHighLevel (GHL).
  • 🤖 Automation & Agent Frameworks– Experience with n8n, Hermes Agents, Composio, OpenClaw, or similar automation and agentic AI platforms.
  • 🔐 Security-Minded– Solid grasp of API security, data privacy, credential vaults, VPNs, and VPS hosting.
  • 💬 Clear Communication & Ownership– Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable supporting clients directly, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • 🏠 Field Service Management Experience– Direct experience with ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro, or with home service trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical).
  • 🧠 Advanced AI Concepts– Familiarity with RAG, MCP, and vector databases.
  • 🌐 Web & Marketing Tech– Website builders, hosting, landing pages, Google Business Profile, and AEO/SEO automation.
  • 🧑‍💻 Software Engineering Background– Software engineers or full-stack developers who have moved into AI automation and voice agents are an ideal match.

Responsibilities of the AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration):

Your responsibilities include:

🔌 Middleware & Field Service Platform Integrations

  • Build and maintain custom middleware connecting AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to Field Service Management (FSM) systems
  • Integrate with platforms like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro using REST APIs and OAuth
  • Write integration logic that interfaces with .NET / C# / C++ backend environments
  • Program and verify end-to-end booking workflows that move live voice conversations straight into contractor dispatch schedules
  • Monitor, diagnose, and resolve sync issues such as duplicate bookings, dropped data payloads, or failed scheduling attempts
  • Code, review, and debug custom application logic in JavaScript and/or TypeScript

🎙️ Voice AI Agent Engineering & Tuning

  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II.     Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. We are hiring for this position to be based in Dubai (UAE) or Eastern Europe.

Praktika is an AI-native education company on a mission to deliver efficient, engaging language learning to billions of people worldwide. We're bridging the gap between traditional learning apps and human tutors through a fully automated tutorship experience powered by generative AI avatars.

Since launching our mobile apps in 2023, we've reached over 30 million learners and grown to over 2 million monthly active users, become one of the world's top-4 learning apps, and recently closed a $30M Series A to accelerate our roadmap. We're a fully distributed team of ~50 people across 4 continents and 15+ countries, working asynchronously to ship fast and operate at a high bar.

We're hiring a Lead DevOps Engineer to own all of Praktika's infrastructure and all access to it. This is a hands-on role with real leadership: you'll set the direction for our infrastructure, build it, run it, and keep it secure, reliable, cost-efficient and fast as we grow.

You'll work with every engineering team and with non-engineering teams too. We are rebuilding how the company works around AI, and infrastructure is where that has to be made safe.

What you'll do

  • Own the infrastructure end to end: design, build and run our AWS-based infrastructure, and be the owner when it fails.

  • Own identity and access for the whole company: cloud accounts, vendors, internal tools, onboarding and offboarding.

  • Own infrastructure security (IAM, networks, secrets, audit logs) and the technical part of compliance: ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR.

  • Keep costs visible and under control across clouds and AI vendors.

  • Run the hosting and inference infrastructure for our ML and LLM models.

  • Close repeated operational requests with automation and self-service, not with tickets and manual console changes.

  • Build the place where internal tools and apps, built with AI by engineers and non-engineers, are deployed safely, reviewed and monitored. Build your own tools with AI too.

  • Give delivery teams golden paths (service templates, CI/CD, safe deploys, alerts) that make the standard way the easy way, without blocking teams.

What we're looking for

We're looking for outstanding engineers who thrive in a challenging environment, bring a growth mindset, and operate with a high degree of agency, devotion, and autonomy.

Required

  • Ownership mindset: you make decisions and finish work without supervision.

  • Deep hands-on AWS experience in production, including containers on ECS.

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform) as your normal way of working.

  • You have already built working tools with AI coding agents, and you use AI in your daily work.

  • You have set a technical direction and split large projects into deliverable parts.

Bonus

  • DevSecOps experience and an understanding of how attacks work.

  • Hands-on work on SOC 2, ISO 27001 or GDPR.

  • Experience with clouds other than AWS.

  • Experience with infrastructure for ML / LLM inference.

  • Prior experience at an early-stage or high-growth consumer product company.

Our stack

AWS (containers, serverless, managed databases, CDN), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, SQL and NoSQL databases, event streaming, a data warehouse, hosted ML / LLM inference, and others.

How we work

  • Mission-driven: we're building the #1 language learning app and competing to win.

  • AI-native: AI isn't a feature; it's how we think, build, and scale.

  • Extreme ownership: every project has a clear owner who drives it to success.

  • Less meetings, more outputs: async first; meetings are a last resort.

  • Speed & excellence: move fast without compromising quality.

  • Truly all-in: impactful work, full commitment, real rewards.

  • Data-driven: decisions are based on evidence, not opinion.

  • User-obsessed: if it doesn't improve the learner experience, it doesn't matter.

Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Un grand groupe du secteur des services à l’environnement engage une refonte de son système d’information métier dédié à la gestion des réseaux. Cette transformation couvre les applications métier, le socle SIG et le modèle de données, avec une composante centrale autour d’ArcGIS Utility Network.
Dans ce cadre, le groupe recherche un Product Owner senior pour porter les priorités métier et coordonner leur mise en œuvre avec un intégrateur partenaire.

Votre rôle :

Au sein de l’équipe programme, vous faites le lien entre les métiers, les équipes SI et l’intégrateur. Vous challengez les demandes, décidez des priorités du backlog et veillez à la cohérence fonctionnelle des évolutions.
Votre expertise d’ArcGIS Utility Network vous permet d’évaluer les conséquences des besoins exprimés et de dialoguer avec l’intégrateur sur les choix de mise en œuvre.

Vos principales missions :

1. Cadrer et prioriser les besoins

  • Recueillir et clarifier les besoins des utilisateurs et des parties prenantes.
  • Challenger les demandes au regard des objectifs du programme et des usages opérationnels.
  • Construire, maintenir et prioriser le backlog en tenant compte de la valeur métier, des contraintes techniques et des dépendances.
  • Formaliser les exigences fonctionnelles, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation.

2. Apporter une expertise technico-fonctionnelle

  • Analyser les conséquences des évolutions sur les applications, le socle SIG et le modèle de données.
  • Éclairer les choix entre fonctionnalités standard, configuration et développements spécifiques.
  • Challenger les propositions de l’intégrateur au regard des besoins métier et des capacités d’ArcGIS Utility Network.
  • Contribuer aux travaux de migration et d’intégration sur le plan fonctionnel, en lien avec les experts concernés.

3. Coordonner la réalisation et la validation

  • Assurer l’interface quotidienne entre les métiers, les équipes SI et l’intégrateur.
  • Suivre l’avancement du backlog, identifier les blocages et coordonner leur résolution.
  • Préparer les arbitrages qui dépassent le périmètre de décision du PO.
  • Organiser la validation métier des fonctionnalités livrées et suivre les corrections.
  • Contribuer à la préparation du déploiement et à l’appropriation des nouvelles applications.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée de Product Owner ou de responsable fonctionnel sur des projets de transformation SI intégrant une forte composante SIG et réseaux.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Expertise technico-fonctionnelle d’ArcGIS Utility Network.
  • Expérience concrète d’au moins une mise en œuvre ou migration vers ArcGIS Utility Network, avec un rôle opérationnel clairement identifiable.
  • Compréhension des métiers de gestion et d’exploitation des réseaux.
  • Maîtrise de la priorisation d’un backlog et de la formalisation des besoins.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec un intégrateur et des équipes métier et techniques.

Compétences appréciées :

  • Connaissance des réseaux d’eau et/ou d’assainissement.
  • Expérience de refonte d’applications métier connectées à un SIG.
  • Compréhension des enjeux de qualité des données, de migration et d’interfaces entre applications.
  • Expérience de projets impliquant plusieurs métiers et systèmes interdépendants.

Qualités attendues :

  • Capacité à décider des priorités et à expliquer les arbitrages.
  • Aptitude à challenger les demandes et les solutions de manière constructive.
  • Aisance pour traduire des sujets techniques en conséquences métier.
  • Rigueur, sens de la coordination et capacité de synthèse.

Non renseigné

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a confident, persuasive and emotionally intelligent Healthcare Sales & Intake Consultant to join a growing healthcare lead management and intake operation.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a confident, persuasive and emotionally intelligent Healthcare Sales & Intake Consultant to join a growing healthcare lead management and intake operation.

Our client is a US-based marketing agency specialising in generating enquiries for Applied Behaviour Analysis (ABA) therapy providers through Google and Facebook advertising. They are expanding their services to help ABA therapy providers manage incoming enquiries, connect with prospective families and convert leads into completed patient intakes.

In this role, you will be the first point of contact for parents enquiring about therapy services for their children. Your responsibility will be to respond to incoming leads promptly, understand each family's needs, explain the relevant provider's services, address questions and concerns, and guide parents through the intake process.

This is a sales-driven position that requires more than simply answering calls. You will need to build trust, demonstrate empathy, handle objections confidently and consistently follow up with prospective families to improve lead conversion.

You will work across multiple healthcare providers, managing enquiries through separate CRM systems and phone numbers for each client.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in inbound sales, insurance sales, healthcare sales or consultative telesales, with the ability to turn enquiries into meaningful conversations and successful conversions.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Inbound Lead Management & Response

  • Monitor incoming leads from Google, Facebook and other digital advertising channels.
  • Contact prospective families promptly after receiving an enquiry.
  • Make outbound calls to parents who have submitted enquiries but have not yet responded.
  • Manage incoming calls and respond to questions about the provider's services.
  • Prioritise new enquiries to ensure quick response times and minimise missed opportunities.

2. Sales & Lead Conversion

  • Build rapport and establish trust with parents and prospective families.
  • Understand the family's needs and determine whether the provider's services are suitable.
  • Clearly explain the relevant ABA provider's services and intake process.
  • Confidently handle questions, concerns and objections.
  • Use persuasive but empathetic communication to encourage parents to move forward.
  • Guide prospective families through the intake forms and encourage completion.
  • Consistently follow up with interested families to improve conversion rates.
  • Identify qualified leads and hand them over to the relevant provider for the next stage.

3. Follow-Up & Relationship Management

  • Maintain regular contact with prospective families who have not completed their intake.
  • Schedule follow-up calls and ensure no promising enquiries are overlooked.
  • Adapt communication based on each family's circumstances and level of interest.
  • Maintain a professional, patient and supportive approach throughout the process.

4. CRM Administration & Documentation

  • Manage leads across multiple client-specific CRM systems.
  • Use separate calling systems and phone numbers for each ABA provider.
  • Accurately document conversations, enquiries, outcomes and follow-up activities.
  • Update lead statuses and maintain organised records.
  • Ensure all relevant information is captured before transferring qualified leads to the provider.
  • Maintain accurate and consistent reporting across assigned accounts.

5. Performance & Reporting

  • Meet expected response times and daily call activity targets.
  • Monitor lead engagement, contact rates and conversion progress.
  • Maintain accurate records of qualified leads and completed intakes.
  • Participate in call reviews, coaching and performance calibration sessions.
  • Use feedback and call assessments to continuously improve communication and conversion results.

Minimum Requirements

  • Approximately 5 years of experience in sales, telesales, inbound sales or lead conversion is preferred.
  • Strong experience handling inbound enquiries and outbound follow-up calls.
  • Proven ability to convert enquiries into sales, appointments or completed applications.
  • Excellent verbal English communication skills with a confident and professional telephone manner.
  • Strong objection-handling, negotiation and persuasive communication skills.
  • Ability to build rapport and establish trust quickly over the phone.
  • Emotionally intelligent, patient and empathetic when dealing with parents and families.
  • Comfortable following sales scripts while keeping conversations natural and engaging.
  • Strong follow-up, organisational and time-management skills.
  • Good computer literacy and experience working with CRM systems.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple client accounts.
  • Comfortable working towards measurable sales and conversion targets.

Advantageous Experience

  • Medical aid or health insurance sales.
  • Life insurance or other consultative insurance sales.
  • Healthcare or medical call centre experience.
  • Patient admissions, medical intake or appointment conversion.
  • Experience selling services rather than purely transactional products.
  • Previous experience working with US-based clients.
  • Exposure to ABA therapy, behavioural health or paediatric healthcare.

A formal college degree is not essential. Relevant sales experience, communication ability and proven conversion skills are more important.

Software & Systems

  • Client-provided CRM platforms.
  • Client-provided calling and telephone systems.
  • Call recording and quality monitoring tools.
  • Multiple CRM environments and client-specific phone numbers.

Training will be provided on the relevant systems, scripts, services and intake procedures.

Working Hours & Coverage

This is a remote position supporting US-based healthcare providers.

Coverage is required during the following US business hours:

Weekday coverage:

  • Monday to Friday.
  • Coverage runs from approximately 7:30 AM Eastern Time to 9:00 PM Eastern Time.
  • Two staggered shifts will provide coverage, with a 30-minute overlap for handovers and continuity.

Sunday coverage:

  • Sundays, approximately 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time.
  • Sunday coverage will be supported through a dedicated representative and backup arrangements.

Important scheduling requirements:

  • Candidates must be comfortable working US-aligned shifts.
  • Sunday availability is required as part of the overall team coverage.
  • Flexibility during the December holiday period is important to ensure consistent service coverage.
  • No specific public holiday arrangements have been confirmed.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured against the following:

  • Speed of response to new incoming leads.
  • Number of calls and follow-up attempts completed.
  • Number of prospective families successfully contacted.
  • Quality of conversations and objection handling.
  • Number of qualified leads generated.
  • Completed intake forms and lead conversion rates.
  • Accuracy of CRM documentation and follow-up records.
  • Attendance, reliability and adherence to scheduled coverage.

Calls will be recorded and periodically reviewed for quality assurance, coaching and performance improvement.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Naturally persuasive and confident on the phone.
  • Empathetic and emotionally intelligent, particularly when speaking to parents seeking support for their children.
  • A strong communicator who knows how to guide a conversation without sounding scripted.
  • Resilient and comfortable handling objections or hesitant prospects.
  • Proactive and persistent with follow-ups.
  • Commercially minded and motivated by achieving measurable results.
  • Resourceful, independent and able to think beyond a script.
  • Highly organised when managing multiple clients and enquiries.
  • Reliable and comfortable working remotely with minimal day-to-day supervision.

We are looking for a sales-driven individual who understands that every enquiry is an opportunity to build trust, provide guidance and convert interest into action.

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Location:Remote - covering San Francisco

Medik8 is a UK-based clinical skincare company dedicated to delivering high-quality, results-driven products backed by scientific research and innovation. With a strong global presence and an exciting high-growth trajectory - particularly in the US - Medik8 continues to push boundaries in clinical skincare.

The Sales & Training Executive (STE) is the face of Medik8 within the retail space. You will be responsible for driving "sell-through" by educating premium beauty retailers on our CSA Philosophy (Vitamin C, Sunscreen, Vitamin A) and ensuring our brand presence is flawless. You will manage a territory of high-volume doors, building deep relationships with Store Leadership to ensure Medik8 is the #1 recommended clinical brand on the floor, while actively managing budget and team performance to meet strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Strategy & Commercial Growth

  • Own the sales performance of your territory, delivering target KPIs and achieving the overall Sales Plan.

  • In partnership with leadership, develop and execute the territory strategy and event door strategy to achieve retailer sales targets and provide Year-Over-Year growth, with a focus on maximizing ROI.

  • Analyze weekly sell-through reports to identify opportunities and gaps. Analyze sell-out trends and report monthly on sales KPIs.

  • Plan and execute high-impact "Event Days" and "Brand Takeovers" to drive traffic and conversion, ensuring sales targets and ROI benchmarks are achieved.

  • Strategically manage your calendar to prioritize Top doors and high-potential locations.

  • Define and manage the customer experience at the point of sale.

2. Education & Training (The "CSA" Expert)

  • Execute high-impact ESVs (Education & Sales Visits), "shoulder-to-shoulder" training on the sales floor, distilling Medik8’s complex science into digestible, sales-driven "hooks."

  • Lead "Cluster Trainings" and "Morning Briefings" to inspire premium beauty retail staff, where available.

  • Master the "Vitamin A Ladder"—educating staff on how to transition customers from Retinol to Retinaldehyde (Crystal Retinal).

  • Host in-store training sessions for sales teams and conduct new hire onboarding for store staff.

3. Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage, coach, and track the sales and training performance of any direct reports and/or freelance team members.

  • Recruit, interview, and onboard all new direct reports in partnership with leadership, HR, and Education team.

  • Provide consistent onboarding, training, and management for all direct reports and freelance in your territory.

  • Ensure achievement of key retail metrics like “sales per hour” and “items per transaction” goals for your team.

  • Manage and audit timekeeping/payroll procedures according to payroll timelines for all direct reports and freelancers.

4. Relationship Management & Advocacy

  • Build influential, collaborative partnerships with premium beauty retail District Managers, Store Managers, and Education Leads.

  • Execute regular business reviews with in-store retail partners to communicate trending business and negotiate elevated store training opportunities, merchandising placement, and event strategies to drive retail sales growth.

  • Manage the Gratis program at the store level, ensuring the "right" products get into the hands of the "right" influencers on the floor.

  • Act as the primary feedback loop between the stores and the Head of Sales, advocating retailer needs with internal cross-functional partners.

  • Diplomatically address and resolve any store-level challenges to maintain strong relationships and ensure solid brand integrity.

5. Visual Merchandising & Operations

  • Maintain the Medik8 Gondola and/or NBT Wall to global brand standards.

  • Oversee execution of merchandising, promotional, and launch calendars, ensuring all brand guidelines are upheld.

  • Monitor inventory levels in-store; alert the Commercial Planner of potential out-of-stocks or shipment delays.

  • Ensure all testers are hygienic, full, and presentable.

  • Negotiate with store personnel to gain space and improve locations for all product categories.

6. Reporting & Business Analysis

  • Adhere to budgetary spend commitments, inclusive of Travel and Expense and Freelance Resource Management.

  • Track and analyze competitive promotions for future planning and conduct competitive research.

  • Utilize internal reporting tools (e.g., Power Bi) to evaluate retail trends and assess shifts in resource management.

  • Maintain organization and manage administrative deadlines, including but not limited to: travel bookings, expense reports, weekly sales recaps, event recaps, and store visit schedules.

  • Provide quarterly recaps highlighting achievements and areas for improvement.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Strong field experience in prestige beauty (Skincare preferred).

  • Solid previous experience working within premium beauty retailer environments.

  • Proven track record of managing a multi-state or multi-province/multi-door territory.

  • Experience in a role with direct reports (highly preferred).

  • The "CSA" Passion: A deep interest in clinical skincare and the ability to explain "Retinal" vs. "Retinol" without blinking.

  • Entrepreneurial and results-oriented mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced retail pivots.

  • Exceptional time management, organizational skills, and attention to detail.

  • Language: Ability to speak both English and Spanish is highly desirable.

Travel & Logistics:

  • Ability to travel 80%+ of the time within the designated territory.

  • Reliable transportation required (Standard IRS reimbursement for mileage). Up to date driver’s license.

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule to meet business needs, including evenings, weekends, and some holidays. <20% dedicated time for Office/Administrative work.

  • Must be willing to do overnight travel when required.

About us

Medik8 is a UK-based clinical skincare company dedicated to delivering high-quality, results-driven products backed by scientific research and innovation. With a strong global presence and an exciting high-growth trajectory, particularly in the US, Medik8 continues to push boundaries in clinical skincare.


Culture & Benefits

We are fuelled by our commitment to sustainability, quality, efficiency, and an unwavering passion for our customers. Championing solutions-focused thinking, we possess a purpose-driven mentality and strive to work with integrity and agility, always. We are collaborative go-givers; our diverse talents work cross-functionally and we achieve more together. We are proud to do everything in-house, challenging the norm and pushing the boundaries of possibility. It’s just who we are!

Some of the perks of being part of the Medik8 team include:

  • Competitive salary

  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, holidays, health insurance and retirement plans

  • Car allowance & mileage reimbursement

  • Cell phone and wifi WFH stipend

  • Annual product discounts

  • Annual discretionary bonus based on performance

Want to do a little more research before you apply?Head over to our main careers page to find out more about the team and our values. You can also find out more about us on LinkedIn, Glassdoor & Instagram.

Our BCorp Commitment to JEDI (Justice, Equity, Diversity & Inclusion)

At Medik8, we are committed to cultivating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every individual feels respected, valued, and empowered. We believe a rich tapestry of backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives fuels the innovation behind our products.
Research shows many candidates only apply if they meet 100% of a job description, however, we use the "60% Rule": if you meet over 60% of the requirements and have the passion to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

Our Inclusive Hiring Standards:

  • Fair Chance Hiring: To support systemic justice, we do not request criminal record or credit checks during the application stage (unless legally required for the role).

  • Blind Recruiting: We use anonymised CV screening to focus purely on your talent and reduce bias.

  • Disability Confident: As a Level 2 employer, we guarantee an interview to disabled applicants who meet the minimum role criteria.

  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.

  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
