Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

JOB ROLE: Client Project Manager

LOCATION: Remote

HOURS: Monday - Friday 8am-5pm (UK hours)

SALARY: 26,000-34,000 ZAR per month + Bonus based on performance

About the role:

We’re looking for a commercially driven Client Project Manager who can win new clients, turn enquiries into confirmed work and grow long-term client relationships within property maintenance and refurbishment.

You’ll take ownership of your client portfolio—from identifying opportunities and preparing competitive quotes to negotiating with suppliers and subcontractors, overseeing delivery and ensuring payment. Success means winning profitable work, delivering on your promises and giving clients reasons to come back.

We’re building our own system with AI and automations to reduce routine administration and help our team work more effectively. This will give you more time to focus on sales, client relationships and commercial decisions.

We want someone who already uses tools such as ChatGPT, actively explores new AI capabilities and is keen to help improve how we work. You’ll also bring practical trade knowledge and a commitment to keep learning about property maintenance and refurbishment.

Key responsibilities:

Win work and grow client accounts

  • Proactively identify and win new clients through outbound sales, referrals and networking.
  • Convert inbound enquiries into booked work through responsive communication, persuasive proposals and consistent follow-up.
  • Build strong client relationships, understand their properties and priorities, and become their trusted point of contact.
  • Generate new quote opportunities by identifying maintenance and refurbishment needs within existing accounts.
  • Follow up confidently, handle objections and move opportunities towards a decision.
  • Take ownership of your sales pipeline, quote conversion and client revenue growth.

Build competitive, profitable quotes

  • Understand client requirements and coordinate engineers, subcontractors or suppliers for surveys and specialist input where needed.
  • Prepare clear, itemised quotes with accurate scope, pricing and exclusions.
  • Negotiate competitive prices, availability and terms with suppliers and subcontractors while maintaining quality and protecting profit margins.
  • Develop a reliable supply chain and build relationships that support competitive pricing and dependable delivery.
  • Use your trade knowledge to challenge costs, identify gaps and propose practical solutions.
  • Seek technical advice where needed before committing to a scope or price.

Own the client experience and project delivery

  • Act as the client’s main point of contact throughout the job lifecycle.
  • Coordinate engineers, subcontractors, materials and access so work runs smoothly.
  • Ensure work is allocated to the right trade, location and availability.
  • Provide clear work instructions and keep clients informed of progress.
  • Resolve issues proactively and escalate when necessary.
  • Verify completed work through photos, client feedback and completion checks.
  • Agree changes to scope and additional costs before extra work proceeds.

Manage invoicing, profitability and payments

  • Ensure jobs are invoiced within 24 hours of completion.
  • Follow up on outstanding payments and resolve billing queries promptly.
  • Monitor project profitability and identify where costs or scope changes affect margins.
  • Take responsibility for commercial outcomes, from the initial enquiry through to payment.

Use AI and automation to improve productivity

  • Use tools such as ChatGPT to support quote drafting, client communication, meeting preparation and sales follow-up.
  • Check AI-generated outputs for accuracy, particularly technical scope, costs and commitments to clients.
  • Learn and adopt our own system as its AI and automation capabilities develop.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work and improve speed, accuracy and the client experience.
  • Keep up with useful developments in AI, test practical applications and share improvements with the team.
  • Keep client, opportunity and job records accurate, and use approved tools responsibly.

Keep developing your trade knowledge

  • Continually build your understanding of maintenance and refurbishment trades, materials, labour requirements and pricing.
  • Learn from engineers, suppliers and completed projects to improve future quotes and decisions.
  • Ask practical questions, recognise gaps in your knowledge and seek specialist input when needed

How we measure success:

    • New clients won and quote opportunities generated.
    • Revenue and gross profit growth.
    • Quote conversion rates and turnaround times.
    • Repeat business and client retention.
    • Jobs booked and quality of project delivery.
    • Timely invoicing and payment collection.

Requirements

  • At least two years’ experience in property maintenance, refurbishment or a closely related trade services business.
  • A track record of winning work, converting quotes or growing client accounts.
  • Strong sales and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to approach new clients and develop repeat business.
  • Confident negotiation skills and a sound understanding of pricing, costs and profit margins.
  • Practical trade knowledge and a commitment to continually developing it.
  • Hands-on experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools, with examples of how they improve your productivity.
  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to keep learning and adapting as our systems evolve.
  • Experience coordinating clients, engineers, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Strong organisation, clear written and verbal communication, and reliable follow-through.
  • Confidence using CRM systems, job tracking software and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience working towards targets, participating in daily stand-ups and contributing to process improvements.
  • A proactive approach—you follow up, solve problems and take responsibility for results.
  • A degree in any field and occasional weekend availability are advantages.

Additional requirements for remote roles

You must have:

  • Your own well-specified computer: A reliable, modern computer capable of smoothly running multiple business applications, AI tools and video calls at the same time.
  • Two screens: A dual-screen setup suitable for managing quotes, client communications and job information efficiently.
  • A good-quality camera: A webcam that provides a clear, professional image for client and team video calls.
  • A good-quality headset: Headphones with a clear microphone, suitable for regular calls.
  • Fast, reliable internet: A stable connection that supports uninterrupted video calls and cloud-based systems.
  • A suitable home office: A dedicated, quiet and professional workspace where you can focus and take client calls without interruptions.
  • Availability aligned with UK operations: The ability to work agreed hours supporting our UK clients and delivery teams.

You must be comfortable working independently, staying accessible to colleagues and clients, and taking ownership of your targets and results.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped bonus scheme.
  • Profit-sharing scheme.
  • Career development opportunities as the business grows across the UK and Dubai.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a business building its own AI-powered systems and automations.
  • A collaborative, performance-driven culture with clear targets and ownership of results.

jobs.description:
Overview

Product Owner, Digital Sales Solutions

Location: UK-based role

Contract: Permanent, Full Time

Salary: Up to £60,000 (depending on skills and experience)

About The Role

This is a product owner role within Thumbprint, Avidity Group's data and analytics agency, working with our Head of Product. You'll own our Digital Sales Solutions products end to end, from an incentivised activation platform through to an AI-powered digital sales rep, turning strategy into a working, revenue-generating product and a roadmap the business is investing in.

This is a commercial role first. You'll own the P&L, agree terms with technology partners and support client pitches, rather than run a backlog for an in-house development team. You need to be as comfortable negotiating with a partner as you are explaining the product to a client.

The product won't sit still either. It starts as a rewards platform and evolves into one run by digital sales reps using AI. If you want one finished product to maintain, this isn't it. If you want to take a product from early stage to scale through that change, it is.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the Digital Sales Solutions roadmap, turning strategy into a sequenced set of product decisions and dependencies
  • Make the incentive activation platform commercially healthy, working with our partner and client leads on activation types, pricing and onboarding new clients
  • Own the requirements and success measures for our digital sales rep, and work with a partner to get an MVP live in proof of concept with named clients
  • Use those proofs of concept to build a proposition that scales, delivering ROI for clients and commercial value for Avidity
  • Own day-to-day partner relationships: commercial terms, service levels, and what we take from partners versus build ourselves
  • Own the P&L logic, including pricing, margin per line item and the volume assumptions behind the business case
  • Set and own the measurement standard: activation and redemption rates, cost per influenced outlet and incremental volume per pound, benchmarked against the cost of a physical call using EPOS data
  • Make sure data governance and consent handling meet the standard we and our clients expect
  • Coordinate internal teams and partners against the roadmap, keeping the Head of Product, client leads and the Exec updated without them needing to oversee every workstream
  • Support client pitches where product input strengthens the case
  • Share best practice across the business to speed up adoption

What We're Looking For

  • Product ownership experience taking an early-stage product through to commercial scale, ideally in a platform, marketplace or partner-dependent model
  • Comfortable owning a product P&L
  • Experience managing a third-party technology or data partner where the commercial and technical relationship matter equally
  • Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to get delivery resource that reports elsewhere moving at the pace the roadmap needs
  • Working knowledge of AI agent-based products and what changes when a workflow moves from human-run to agent-run
  • Decisive enough to close open decisions rather than let them drift
  • Experience in FMCG, retail or field marketing is desirable, ideally with exposure to convenience or on-trade
  • A background in incentive, loyalty or rewards platforms is desirable
  • Exposure to EPOS or outlet-level retail data is a bonus
  • Experience building a business case that compares a new digital channel against an existing physical one would be ideal

What's In It For You?

  • We champion equality & inclusivity and are passionate about creating a workplace that promotes and values diversity
  • 23 days holiday per annum & bank holidays, with the option to purchase up to 5 extra days
  • Family-friendly policies, including enhanced maternity, paternity, and smart working options
  • Flexible working to support work/life balance
  • Access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme
  • Annual pay reviews, early pay access, life assurance, enhanced sick pay, health cash plan, discounted private health care & more
  • Fantastic progression opportunities across the Avidity Group

Here at Avidity, we want to support you in your career. It's the performance and engagement of our people who make this an amazing place to work. Our employees are everything to us and that's why we make sure everyone enjoys continuous support, great perks and excellent career opportunities. We work really hard to create an open, honest, high performing & diverse culture. We think that's reflective in the results we deliver, which have enabled the strong partnerships we have with our clients.

Account Executive - Performance Marketing – Outside Sales

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: USA Remote with some travel

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential Visibility, recognition, and growth opportunities within a performance‑driven, enterprise sales environment Access to the full USA TODAY Network + additional partners—860+ markets, trusted media assets, and subscriber‑based audiences at scale True ownership of enterprise relationships with the autonomy to build and grow a national book of business Remote flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory with some travel Structured onboarding, coaching, and sales support to help you ramp quickly Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career. Backed by marketing expertise, post‑sale specialists, and industry‑leading tool

About LocaliQ:

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role:

This is an enterprise-level role focused on C-suite conversations rather than local business owners. PIQ is a performance-based marketing program that converts print advertising space into marketing opportunities on a revenue-share, cost-per-acquisition, or cost-per-lead model. The PIQ Account Executive tells an enterprise story about partnership relationships—not transactional relationships—leveraging USA TODAY’s entire asset base to partner with national and regional clients. The role aligns with national sales efforts and one-to-many programs, focusing on enterprise-level relationships that allow the company to leverage its full scale.

In your first 90 days, you’ll ramp into the PIQ enterprise story—gaining a deep understanding of our performance-based model, how we partner with C-suite leaders, and how our national scale creates value for enterprise clients. As you progress, you’ll begin building and advancing a strong enterprise pipeline while establishing core sales rhythms and collaborating closely with internal strategists. By the end of this period, you’ll be confidently owning enterprise opportunities and leading complex, high-impact deals with support from a seasoned cross-functional team.

What You Will Do:

Generate a sales pipeline through self-directed prospecting using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, attendance at vertical-specific expos, referrals from existing clients, and AI tools for finding leads and building outreach strategies. Qualify and pursue enterprise level opportunities—focus on prospects capable of $150,000+ deals selling to C-suite and marketing directors at regional, state, and national level. Deliver the PIQ value proposition—one-to-one exclusive leads to subscriber-based audience, with high frequency exposure through trusted USA TODAY content, and scale across 860 markets/publications. Collaborate with strategists on proposals for deals exceeding $150,000; quarterback internal resources to design, build, and deliver campaigns. Manage and grow existing accounts; maintain weekly client touchpoints to drive retention and expansion. Lead cross-functional delivery—delegate effectively, maintain quality control, run pod cadences, and own outcomes while leveraging specialist expertise Track performance data—monitor campaign metrics, set clear expectations, review performance regularly, address issues early, and resolve problems through appropriate specialists. Maintain client data in Salesforce—log activities, track pipeline, and forecast accurately.

Qualifications:

5+ years’ proven track record of success in B2B sales, with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles, selling to the C-suite or marketing director level on deals that exceed $150K+ Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close. Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach. Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity. Digital acumen—understanding of digital marketing landscape and performance-based marketing models. Data-minded, able to understand tracking, performance metrics for client campaigns and developing strategies from that data. Experience working with agencies and understanding agency operations and relationships. Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders. Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here:

You’ll thrive here as a self‑motivated, competitive, and consultative seller who owns a book of business, creates opportunities, and confidently leads complex deals. Top performers are data‑driven, resilient, and results‑focused—energized by real‑time performance metrics and rankings, motivated by commission upside, and accountable for outcomes. They consistently outperform peers, earn expanded roles or territories, and effectively quarterback internal teams to deliver measurable client impact.

Benefits:

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + uncapped commission opportunity 401(k) with company match Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders Flexibility and Autonomy: remote work environment Access to industry-leading tools, resources and marketing expertise Career development opportunities High-performance culture with recognition, incentives, and contests

If you’re energized by enterprise level selling, motivated by performance and ownership, and ready to build something meaningful at scale, this role was designed for you. Apply now to bring your expertise, ambition, and curiosity to PIQ—and be part of a high‑impact team shaping the future of performance marketing. The annualized base salary for this role will range between $65,000 and $75,000. $108,333-$125,000 OTE. Uncapped commission with accelerators. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, location, and union representation, if applicable.

About the Position:

The Director, Field Marketing is responsible for driving qualified pipeline growth and revenue outcomes across North America through integrated field, partner, alliance, and account-based marketing strategies. This leader serves as the connective tissue between Sales, Channel, Alliances, SDRs, Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Product Marketing, ensuring investments, programs, messaging, and resources are aligned to business priorities and measurable outcomes.


This role is accountable for optimizing the full revenue funnel, identifying opportunities to improve conversion and efficiency, and leveraging data, technology, and AI-driven insights to maximize impact. The Director leads a high-performing team while continuously evolving the go-to-market approach to drive scalable growth, operational excellence, predictable pipeline creation, and revenue acceleration.


Responsibilities

  • Own North America Field Marketing strategy and execution, aligning investments, campaigns, and programs to qualified pipeline, revenue, and growth objectives.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Channel, SDR, Alliance, Product Marketing, and Marketing Operations leadership to develop integrated territory, vertical, partner, and account-based growth plans.
  • Lead quarterly and annual planning processes, ensuring investments are allocated toward activities that produce measurable business outcomes and return on investment.
  • Establish a performance-driven operating model focused on MQL, SQL, Qualified Opportunity, Pipeline, and Revenue contribution rather than activity volume.
  • Drive accountability through data-driven decision making, identifying funnel friction, conversion gaps, and opportunities to improve performance across the buyer journey.
  • Develop scalable processes that leverage AI, automation, predictive analytics, and reporting to improve team productivity, campaign effectiveness, and decision quality.
  • Oversee field, partner, alliance, executive engagement, ABM, and regional growth programs with a focus on increasing buying-group penetration, pipeline progression, and revenue impact.
  • Continuously evaluate program effectiveness and investment allocation, making recommendations to increase funding for top-performing activities and reduce funding for underperforming tactics.
  • Establish closed-loop feedback mechanisms between the field and marketing teams to ensure campaigns, messaging, content, and sales plays are resonating with target audiences and driving business outcomes. Translate field insights, buyer feedback, and performance trends into data-driven recommendations that improve conversion rates, buying-group engagement, qualified pipeline creation, and revenue impact.
  • Serve as the voice of the field by helping Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Marketing understand what is and is not working in prospect and customer conversations, sales motions, partner engagements, and campaign execution.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team capable of operating strategically, using data to inform decisions, challenge assumptions, and influence business outcomes.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on pipeline creation, territory performance, marketing investment strategy, resource allocation, and growth opportunities.

Who You Are

  • You think in systems, not one-off campaigns.
  • You focus on revenue impact, not activity volume.
  • You continuously challenge how resources, investments, and people are deployed to maximize business outcomes.
  • You leverage data to make decisions and are comfortable challenging assumptions when the results don't support them.
  • You treat AI, automation, and technology as core capabilities that help teams scale and make smarter decisions.
  • You understand that marketing's role is not simply to generate leads, but to create qualified pipeline, accelerate revenue, and influence business outcomes.
  • You build strong partnerships across Sales, Channel, Alliances, SDRs, Product Marketing, and Revenue Marketing teams to achieve shared goals.
  • You push for ideas that stand out, create differentiation, and drive measurable business impact.
  • You effectively connect field insights to marketing strategy, helping shape content, campaigns, sales plays, and investment decisions based on what customers and sellers are actually experiencing.
  • You are equally comfortable discussing territory strategy, funnel conversion, pipeline performance, investment allocation, AI adoption, and team development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Field Marketing, Revenue Marketing, Demand Generation, Channel Marketing, or related B2B marketing disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience managing teams of four or more direct reports.
  • Proven experience driving qualified pipeline creation and revenue growth in partnership with Sales, SDR, and Channel organizations.
  • Experience leading regional, enterprise, ABM, partner, and alliance marketing strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to guide investment decisions, resource allocation, and business planning.
  • Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets and demonstrating measurable return on investment.
  • Familiarity with modern marketing technologies including CRM, marketing automation, intent platforms, ABM platforms, analytics tools, and AI-powered solutions.
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cybersecurity or high-growth SaaS experience a plus.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:


  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • 401(k) contribution and matching
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Base Salary

The base salary range for this job family is 135,200 to 246,400 USD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.

  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.

  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.

jobs.description:
Salary: £50,000 – £60,000 DOE
Location: Remote

We’re working with a fast-growing DTC subscription brand in the health and wellness space to appoint a CRM Manager who can take ownership of its customer lifecycle strategy and execution.

With approximately 90% of revenue coming through subscriptions, CRM and retention are fundamental to the continued growth of the business.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable interrogating customer data and developing a retention strategy as they are building complex journeys in Klaviyo.

You won’t be inheriting a finished test plan. You’ll be expected to find the opportunities, form a point of view, build the solution and measure the impact.

The Role

You’ll own the CRM lifecycle end to end, initially as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow into a CRM or Retention Lead role as the programme develops.

The role will remain hands-on. You’ll continue to build and optimise alongside taking greater strategic ownership and, over time, potentially leading a team.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the full customer lifecycle in Klaviyo, including welcome and onboarding, product education, replenishment, pre-billing, failed payment, save and skip, and winback journeys

  • Analyse flow, customer and cohort performance to identify where revenue and margin are being lost

  • Build and implement retention strategies based on why customers are cancelling or skipping, rather than relying on blanket save journeys

  • Develop strategies to convert high-intent one-time customers into subscribers

  • Own CRM activity across email, SMS and WhatsApp

  • Manage deliverability, database health and engagement

  • Develop and optimise loyalty programme mechanics, including earn, burn, tiers and redemption journeys

  • Work closely with creative teams to brief and iterate CRM assets based on performance

  • Lead A/B testing across journeys and campaigns, prioritising tests based on commercial impact

  • Develop clear reporting around CRM performance and incremental contribution

How Success Will Be Measured

You’ll have clear commercial ownership, with success focused on:

  • Increasing the contribution margin generated during a customer's first three months, relative to their initial order value.

  • Increasing the proportion of active customers ordering in any given month, capturing the impact of cancellations, skips and changes in purchase frequency.

  • Growing the incremental revenue and margin generated through CRM flows.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with genuine Klaviyo expertise, rather than someone who has simply used the platform to send campaigns.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Proven experience owning a CRM programme end to end

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Klaviyo, including complex conditional and branched journeys

  • A strong understanding of flow performance, attribution and incremental revenue

  • Experience working within a subscription-led business

  • Experience with Skio, Recharge or a similar subscription platform

  • A strong understanding of subscriber behaviour, churn and retention

  • A highly analytical approach, with the curiosity to investigate the data before being asked

  • The ability to turn insight into action and personally build and launch your recommendations

  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to prioritise across multiple opportunities and projects

  • Experience with a loyalty platform would be a strong advantage

  • An independent, structured and fast-moving approach

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a growing DTC business at a point where CRM has a genuine opportunity to shape commercial performance, rather than simply support it.

You’ll have significant ownership from day one, with the opportunity to build the CRM function, develop the retention strategy and grow into a broader leadership position as the business scales.

Our client is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. They believe that a diverse team makes for a stronger business and are committed to ensuring their recruitment process is fair and accessible to everyone.

Please note: Due to the volume of applications, only candidates shortlisted for the next stage will be contacted. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, unfortunately your application has not been successful on this occasion. We appreciate the time taken to apply and thank everyone for their interest.

jobs.description:
Company Overview
ImmunityBio is a vertically integrated commercial stage biotechnology company developing next-generation therapies that bolster the natural immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases. The Company’s range of immunotherapy and cell therapy platforms, alone and together, act to drive and sustain an immune response with the goal of creating durable and safe protection against disease. Designated an FDA Breakthrough Therapy, ANKTIVA is the first FDA-approved immunotherapy for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer CIS that activates NK cells, T cells, and memory T cells for a long-duration response. The Company is applying its science and platforms to treating cancers, including the development of potential cancer vaccines, as well as developing immunotherapies and cell therapies that we believe sharply reduce or eliminate the need for standard high-dose chemotherapy. These platforms and their associated product candidates are designed to be more effective, accessible, and easily administered than current standards of care in oncology and infectious diseases.

Why ImmunityBio?

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Migration Admin Assistant — Visa Applications & Case Management (Outlook, Excel, Migration Manager, Xero)

Remote | Philippines | Full-Time | Php 40,000/month, with a performance-based rate review after six months | 6:30 AM – 3:30 PM PHT, Mon–Fri (8:30 AM – 5:30 PM AEST) | Long-Term Remote Role

If you’re a high-performing admin or legal support professional who is detail-obsessed, speaks up with confidence, and is eager to learn a new industry on the job — and you want to work with a well-established Australian migration agency that values strategic impact over simple task completion — keep reading.

This isn’t a role for a “quiet task-taker” who waits to be told what to do next.

This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll take the administrative load off a team of Registered Migration Agents, so every visa application is lodged complete, accurate and on time.

Why This Is a Dream Job

You’ll be working directly with the migration team of an established Australian immigration agency who:

  • Trains You Properly: Teaches its systems and visa workflows through hands-on, collaborative training alongside experienced migration agents and case managers. You don’t need prior immigration experience.
  • Values Your Growth: Gives you a dedicated Success Manager (CSM), monthly scorecards and quarterly reviews, plus a planned rate review at six months based on your performance.
  • Respects Your Voice: Wants you to share your thinking, raise risks early and suggest better ways of working, including practical uses of AI tools.
  • Builds Stability: Offers a long-term, ongoing role (not project-based), with room to grow as the team scales, including helping onboard future teammates.
  • Gives You Daily Support Early On: Holds daily touchpoints with the Operations Leader in your first weeks before moving to a weekly check-in.

You’ll get career transformation, real exposure to the Australian immigration field, and the chance to grow from guided support to trusted case owner, without being stuck doing data entry with no path forward.

What You’ll Be Owning

This is a core operations support role covering application preparation, case management and client communication. You aren’t just filing documents; you’re the person who knows where every assigned case stands, catches gaps before an agent does, and keeps clients informed, while leaving all immigration advice and decisions to the authorised agents.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • Application Package Preparation: Preparing and pre-checking visa application packages in Migration Manager against the agent’s checklist, so every package is complete and ready for agent review before the internal deadline.
  • Case Control: Updating every case in Migration Manager and Microsoft Planner after each action, and making sure no case stalls without a logged next step.
  • Deadline & Visa Expiry Tracking: Owning visa expiry reminders and lodgement deadlines across your caseload, with zero misses.
  • Document & Payment Follow-ups: Chasing outstanding documents, information and payments without prompting, and keeping invoicing and service agreements current in Xero.
  • Inbox & Client Communication: Managing the shared inbox and calls, answering client, agency and embassy emails on time, actioning urgent requests the same day, and escalating advice-related questions to the supervising agent.
  • Drafting & Research: Drafting routine correspondence and supporting statements under agent supervision, and researching legislation and policy updates as directed.
  • Process Improvement: Finding and implementing better templates, checklists, AI-assisted drafting and workflow changes that cut repetitive manual work for the team.

Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Have Admin or Legal Support Experience: You’ve worked in paralegal, legal support or administrative support roles. This is an entry-level role suited to someone ready to be trained.
  • Already Know Outlook and Excel: You use both confidently from day one without basic training. Migration Manager, Planner and Xero will be taught.
  • Catch What Others Miss: You spot gaps and errors in documents and treat 100% accuracy as the standard, not a stretch goal.
  • Juggle Deadlines Calmly: You keep many cases moving at once and prioritise without losing track.
  • Speak Up and Take Initiative: You ask questions early, share your progress, and act without being asked.
  • Know the Line: You understand that administration and immigration advice are different, and you escalate anything advice-related to the supervising agent.
  • Handle Information with Discretion: You treat sensitive client details with strict confidentiality.
  • Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, meet deadlines, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.
  • Communicate with Confidence: You write and speak clear, professional English with clients, agencies, embassies and the team.
  • Can Commit to the Schedule: You’re comfortable working remotely on Australian business hours, Monday to Friday.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): Exposure to immigration law or Australian Department of Home Affairs processes; Xero or Migration Manager experience; using AI tools in everyday work.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • Training Signed Off: You’ve completed on-the-job training in Migration Manager, Planner, Xero and core visa workflows, and work independently on routine tasks.
  • Cases Keep Moving: Every assigned case is current in Migration Manager and Planner, follow-ups are tracked, and no case stalls without a next step.
  • Deadlines Are Never Missed: Visa expiry reminders and deadlines go out on schedule, and risks are flagged before they become urgent.
  • Clients Are Well Informed: The inbox is answered on time, urgent requests are handled the same day, and advice questions reach the right agent.
  • Trust Is Earned: You’ve proposed at least one concrete process improvement, and the agents rely on you to run routine case work with light supervision.

Final Word

If you’ve ever thought:

“I’m organised, detail-focused and ready to grow. I just want a team that will train me properly, listen to my ideas and give me real ownership.” This is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

This platform rests upon a robust enterprise foundation powered by our internal Big Data Platform (BDP), leveraging Databricks and Azure Data Lake for our Bronze and Silver data tiers. The CC Insights team owns the Gold layer (Synapse via Databricks) and the unified web application interface. In this role, you will collaborate closely with software and data engineers as well as our Data Platform Engineering (DPE) colleagues to architect resilient services, scale our multi-tenant cloud infrastructure, and help to ensure critical information flows with clarity.


Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to drive the architectural evolution of our cloud services and analytics web applications. In this role, you will steer development across our C# backend and Angular frontend, integrate embedded PowerBI experiences, and architect scalable, multi-tenant microservices. You will also guide the evaluation and migration of capabilities from legacy reporting products into our modern, unified interface.

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. Guided by our purpose of helping people be their best in the moments that matter, we foster an inclusive, people-first culture where curious minds innovate what's next and pursue their passion and potential. We value authentic collaboration, sophisticated engineering, and a dedication to crafting maintainable, elegant code. We recognize that impactful engineering backgrounds are diverse; candidates who bring equivalent practical experience alongside deep technical mastery are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Architecture & Foundation Engineering

  • Drive the design and development of the CC Insights web application using C#, .NET Core, and Angular, integrating embedded PowerBI reports and Priority Intelligence™ conversational workflows
  • Architect robust, multi-tenant data access patterns and layered microservices using Entity Framework Core and SQL Server while maintaining clean service boundaries
  • Migrate and modernize legacy reporting product capabilities into a cohesive web architecture through disciplined code analysis

DevOps, Platform Resiliency & Operational Excellence

  • Design, configure, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines from scratch utilizing GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps (ADO) to support continuous integration and reliable multi-environment deployments
  • Implement cross-cutting platform capabilities including authentication, tenant authorization, distributed tracing, structured logging, and resiliency policies
  • Oversee operational diagnostics across application, data, and cloud infrastructure layers to help resolve complex production issues collaboratively

Technical Leadership & Collaborative Innovation

  • Lead architectural evaluations, technical designs, and peer code reviews to promote maintainable, elegant engineering practices across distributed teams
  • Mentor engineering teammates across hybrid global locations in modern software patterns, testing strategies, and clean code principles
  • Partner cross-functionally with product managers, QA specialists, and the Data Platform Engineering (DPE) team to deliver enterprise analytics features


Basic Requirements

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a technical discipline
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in full stack application development

Technical Expertise

  • C# & .NET Core to design and develop scalable backend microservices, layered architectures, and RESTful APIs
  • Angular & TypeScript to construct modular web components and manage complex client-side application state using NgRx
  • Entity Framework Core & SQL Server to develop multi-tenant data access patterns, optimize queries, and maintain relational schemas
  • DevOps & CI/CD Automation to build and manage automated build, test, and release pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps (ADO)
  • Reliability & Observability Tooling to implement distributed system resiliency policies, structured logging, tracing, and operational health diagnostics
  • AI-Assisted Development Tools to leverage assistive technologies such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code to accelerate development cycles and support high code quality
  • English Language to communicate with clarity across global distributed engineering teams in written and verbal business settings at an advanced (C1) level

Professional Experience

  • System Architecture Stewardship to design layered and modular enterprise applications using dependency injection and interface-driven design
  • Multi-Tenant System Design to implement secure data isolation, tenant-aware authorization, and scalable cloud structures
  • Collaborative Problem Solving to partner with cross-functional stakeholders and conduct constructive technical code reviews
  • Automated Testing & Quality Practices to design and execute comprehensive unit test suites supporting overall software reliability

Preferred Qualifications (Optional)

  • Experience with React and its core fundamentals to support the evaluation and migration of legacy frontend capabilities
  • Familiarity with PySpark and data pipeline querying to collaborate effectively with Databricks and Synapse data engineers
  • Exposure to Large Language Model (LLM) integrations (such as Azure OpenAI or LangChain) to support conversational data interfaces and assisted workflows
  • Familiarity with advanced software paradigms such as Domain-Driven Design (DDD) or Event Sourcing

jobs.title: Manager, Native Plant Habitat Impact & Certifications
jobs.excerpt: Founded in 1936, the National Wildlife Federation has grown into America's largest and most trusted grassroots conservation organization with 52 state/territorial affiliates and more than six million members and supporters, including hunters, anglers, gardeners, birders, hikers, campers, paddlers, and outdoor enthusiasts of all ages and stripes.
jobs.description:
Founded in 1936, the National Wildlife Federation has grown into America's largest and most trusted grassroots conservation organization with 52 state/territorial affiliates and more than six million members and supporters, including hunters, anglers, gardeners, birders, hikers, campers, paddlers, and outdoor enthusiasts of all ages and stripes. The mission of the National Wildlife Federation is to unite all Americans to ensure wildlife thrive in our rapidly changing world. We advance this mission through programming focused on conserving wildlife, restoring habitats and waterways, expanding outdoor opportunities, connecting children with nature, advancing environmental justice, and addressing the causes and consequences of climate change.

To support our mission, we are seeking a Program Manager to join the Native Plant Habitat Impact & Certifications team in the Education and Engagement Department. Over more than fifty years, NWF’s education and engagement department has built a vast national network of community leaders, elected officials, educators, homeowners, and others who collectively create and steward natural habitat that helps local wildlife where people live, work, play, learn, and worship.

The Program Manager reports to the Head of Native Plant Habitat Impact & Certifications and works across teams to support large scale native tree, plant based habitat expansion with corporate and community partners, leveraging our national habitat program networks, including Trees for Wildlife partners, Community Wildlife Habitats, and Mayors Monarch Pledge sites. This position works closely with the Directors of Large-Scale Habitat and National Habitat Networks. This role is key to the overall success of the habitat programs, related campaigns and partnerships that align with NWF’s strategic plan and our commitment to equity and justice.

Principle Duties (major areas of responsibility):

This role provides strategic leadership for the development, implementation, and growth of habitat conservation initiatives, with a primary focus on the Trees for Wildlife program. Responsibilities include cultivating and managing strategic partnerships, securing and stewarding funding opportunities, overseeing program operations and impact measurement, and advancing community-based conservation through data-driven decision-making and stakeholder engagement. The position also supports organizational fundraising and communications objectives by developing compelling content, managing sponsor and partner deliverables, and fostering collaborative relationships that expand habitat restoration efforts and enhance program visibility and impact.

Advance Large-scale Habitat Impact and Revenue Growth Opportunities

  • Plan, support and collaborate around the strategic growth of specific habitat programs as desirable funding opportunities for corporate sponsorships, employee engagement and as a revenue campaign(s) to ultimately increase tree canopy and native plant habitat footprint to benefit wildlife and people.
    • Specifically, implement the Trees for Wildlife program by managing partnership process, conducting outreach to potential tree recipient partners, securing collaboration agreements and facilitating the reporting and invoice reimbursement processes.
    • Apply data to inform decisions to innovate and effectively manage program outcomes and audience-based messaging.
    • Refresh annual competitive analysis across national tree and urban forestry space to keep TFW program fresh, relevant and impactful. Contribute to re envisioning NWF’s TFW case for program success via a strategic business planning process.
    • Support fundraising efforts through strategic business planning, online research, budget development and proposal writing.
  • Support coordination with Community Wildlife Habitats, and Mayors Monarch Pledge networks.

Track Impact through Outreach and Habitat Metrics

  • Update program impact reporting requirements to align with participant and funder expectations
  • Improve processes for defining and collection metrics using dashboards, user-friendly feedback systems, etc.
  • Research and write best practice summaries and case studies.

Implement Deliverables for Corporate/ Institutional/Program Habitat Partners

  • Coordinate with leadership of Native Plant Habitats and Education and Philanthropy's teams to define sponsor packages scope and feasible deliverables.
  • Implement and manage an RFP, delivery and reporting structure for multi year, mini grant "pass-throughs", in line with funder expectations and to increase capacity and habitat footprint of NWF's national habitat networks.
  • Annually identify network and community partners to host and implement planting and educational events across funded partnerships and program annual tree bank dispersal, e.g. affiliates, community-based orgs, colleges, etc.
  • Coordinate logistics, reimbursements, materials deliveries for partner events with local leads.
  • Respond to program inbox and customer service inquiries.

Increase Outreach and Engagement to advance community-based conservation

  • Lead annual Trees for Wildlife Month Campaign coordination and annual appeals to generate to support the membership and program goals, and ultimately increases available trees in the TFW tree bank.
  • Support the NWF Native Plant Habitat programs by effectively communicating with program participants, partners, and community conservationists, team leaders, with compelling messaging for web, blogs, presentations and newsletters to support the overall success of the programs. Coordinate with the Native Plant Habitat Strategy team’s overall content management and communications processes and templates.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Natural Resources, Conservation, Nonprofit Management, Public Administration, Communications, Ecological Landscaping, Sustainability, Urban Forestry, Native Plant Ecosystems or a related field; advanced degree a bonus.
  • 5-8+ years of progressively responsible experience in program management, conservation, environmental nonprofit leadership, community engagement, or a related field. Specific knowledge of habitat conservation, urban forestry, native plant restoration, community-based conservation, or related environmental programs is ideal.
  • Commitment to conservation, environmental stewardship, and advancing equitable community engagement in support of organizational mission and impact.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing strategic partnerships with multiple stakeholders, e.g. corporate sponsors, nonprofits, community organizations, government agencies.
  • Proven success in project management, including overseeing multiple initiatives, timelines, budgets, contracts, and deliverables simultaneously.
  • Experience supporting fundraising efforts through grant writing, proposal development, sponsorship cultivation, budget preparation, and donor stewardship.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data, metrics, dashboards, and reporting tools to evaluate program performance and inform strategic decision-making.
  • Experience managing grant-funded programs, including reporting, compliance, reimbursement processes, and stakeholder communications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop reports, case studies, presentations, web content, and marketing materials for diverse audiences incorporating compelling use of metrics, scientific data to convey impact to funders and the general public.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams and organizational levels.
  • Experience planning and coordinating events, volunteer engagement activities, and community outreach campaigns.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify process improvements and implement systems that increase program effectiveness, efficiency, and measurable impact. Ability to pivot direction as needed building on strong problem-solving and strategic thinking skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM systems, project management tools, and data visualization or reporting platforms, e.g. Airtable, GIS mapping experience is preferred.

NWF Values:

Your actions are expected to reflect the staff values of the National Wildlife Federation: collaboration, mindfulness, empowerment, inclusivity, and mission focus.

Applicants are invited to learn more about National Wildlife Federation’s required equity competencies at .

Travel Requirements:

There will be some travel required in this role, approximately 5-8 times / year for community events or conferences.

Location and Work Mode:

This position is a fully remote position. The National Wildlife Federation is committed to a flexible and empowered work environment with an authentic community of care for all staff. In this position, the employee may work remotely to be decided jointly with their supervisor in the final stages of the interview process. For more information on Work Modes, please review the benefits section of our careers page:

Physical Requirements of the Job:

Remaining in a normal seated or standing position for extended periods; reaching and grasping by extending hand(s) or arm(s); dexterity to manipulate objects with fingers, for example, using a keyboard; communication skills using the spoken word; ability to see and hear within normal parameters; ability to move about the workspace. The position requires mobility, including moving materials weighing up to several pounds (such as a laptop computer or tablet).

Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this position with reasonable accommodation. Requests for reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis.

Please Note:

This job description sets forth the job’s principal duties, responsibilities, and requirements; it should not be construed as an exhaustive statement, however. Unless they begin with the word “may,” the Essential Duties and Responsibilities described above are “essential functions” of the job, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Compensation and Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $72,000 - $80,000, commensurate with experience.

We are proud of our designation by Mogul as a Top 100 Workplace with the Best Benefits, and by Forbes as one of America’s best small employers! We value work-life balance and a family-friendly atmosphere with flexible scheduling. We want you to be able to integrate work and personal life with attention to your self-care, so that your work schedule is not depleting. We offer benefits so you feel restored and fueled through the day and week.

We offer these supports to help manage your mental, emotional, and physical health:

  • Paid time off: Vacation that starts off at three weeks accrual based on a full-time schedule, unlimited wellbeing (this time can be used for physical, spiritual, emotional, cultural, religious or financial wellbeing for yourself, a partner, or family member – including pets), and 11 holidays
  • We close down for a paid winter break between December 25 to January 1 to recognize end of-year stress, and time for reflection, rejuvenation, and spending time with family.
  • Up to 16 weeks of fully paid Family and Medical Leave
  • Low-cost health, dental, and vision insurance options – all outpatient mental health is covered at in-network rates
  • Therapist available at no cost
  • Pet insurance and discount perk program
  • Annual wellbeing allowance

In addition to your salary, we offer the following supports to your personal finances:

  • Retirement plan with immediate match and vesting
  • Annual year end retirement contribution
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Adoption and Surrogacy assistance
  • Pet adoption stipend
  • Student Loan management
