jobs.description:
About the Role

As an Intermediate Accountant at VargasAndrews, you bring several years of experience and take on greater ownership of your work. You are no longer just executing tasks — you are thinking critically about the numbers, contributing to month-end close quality, and becoming a reliable point of contact for the clients and teams you support.

This role is ideal for accountants ready to take the next step: managing full-cycle accounting for assigned client accounts, ensuring quality, and growing toward a senior-level path. You will work closely with Senior Accountants and Fractional Controllers who will support your development.

Recruitment Process

We aim to complete the recruitment process within seven to ten calendar days. We look for professionals who demonstrate strong communication, confidence, AI-driven innovation, and leadership potential.

  • Initial Interview (30–45 min) I A conversation to get to know you, your background, and your motivation for joining VargasAndrews.
  • Behavioral Interview (60–90 min) I An in-depth discussion using real-life scenarios to assess communication, problem-solving, leadership, and your approach to innovation.
  • Technical Interview (60 min) I A detailed evaluation of your technical skills and your ability to leverage modern tools and AI in your work.
  • Pre-Engagement ﻿I Reference Check and IT Audit.

﻿Company Overview

VargasAndrews is an international professional services firm specializing in business transformations and turnarounds. We exist to transform lives — and we live that mission every single day, not just on a poster.

We believe in:

  • Teamwork & Camaraderie
  • Hiring & Developing the Best
  • Agility & Lean Thinking
  • Customer Obsession
  • Curiosity & Systemization
  • Ownership & Accountability

We are a why organization, not a what organization. It is not what we do, but why we do it that drives us every day. Our vision is to become an international market leader in business transformations.

Visit our website and connect with us on LinkedIn to learn more.

Why Join Us?

Working for VargasAndrews means joining a global workforce of passionate, motivated A-players. We believe in hiring driven individuals and supporting them with direction and resources. We work smart, not just hard.

  • Work with a Global Team of A-Players
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits
  • A Dynamic, Digital-First Workplace
  • U.S.-Facing Roles with Real Impact and Growth

Scope of Services

The following outlines the primary service areas and KPIs for the Intermediate Accountant I, as defined in our RCFO engagement framework:

Service / Area

Accounts Receivable

  • Prepare and submit monthly invoices to the Client's customers no later than the agreed deadline.
  • Ensure that payments of the Client's customers are recorded at most 1 day from receipt of payment.
  • Consistent monitoring and follow-through of payments, especially invoices more than 30 days past due.
  • Ensure that reimbursable expenses are billed on time.

Accounts Payable

  • Ensure all payments are properly approved and substantiated with supporting documents.
  • Ensure all Purchase Orders are duly approved by the Client.
  • Weekly monitoring of AP Aging and prompt reporting of any inconsistencies or new transactions to the Client's Financial Controller and/or other client representatives.

Bank Reconciliation

  • Daily checking of the bank statement and daily recording of bank transactions in the Client's accounting system.
  • Reconcile bank statement to book statement at most 2 days from the previous month-end.

General Accounts

  • Propose adjusting journal entries as needed.
  • Explore the government portal and access the tax filing of US and Australian entities.

Financial Statement Closing Process

  • Ensure the completeness of accruals at most 3 days following the month to be closed.
  • Aid in preparing data to compute and present margin analysis per customer and per department/activity monthly.
  • Review and reconcile balance sheet accounts on or before the 2nd Monday of the following month.

Policies & Procedures

  • Design and implement processes and procedures to improve the accounting processes of the Client and its related entities.

Other Required Tasks

  • Other related tasks that may be assigned by the reporting manager, SLT, Chief Financial Officer, and/or Financial Controller, which will be communicated to the Contractor.

Essential Functions

50% Core accounting execution — post and process journal entries, update AR and issue invoices, update AP and perform reconciliations, record accruals and prepayments, prepare and submit weekly/monthly reports, assist in financial statement preparation.

25% Data management and close support — update financial data in databases, assist Senior Accountants in monthly/yearly closings, and assist with other accounting projects.

15% Other accounting tasks — invoicing, billing, taxes, and compliance under the guidance of the Senior Accountant.

10% Accounting process improvement tasks in coordination with the Senior Accountant and Fractional Controller.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Accounting
  • CPA License: Preferred but not required. CPA holders may be considered for accelerated advancement or higher rate banding.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of accounting work experience
  • Analytical mind with strong conceptual and problem-solving skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail with superb organizational skills
  • Excellent report writing, communication, and computer application skills
  • Advanced competency in Microsoft Office and accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, and Excel
  • Critical thinker with high proficiency in mathematical reasoning
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • Familiarity with AI tools or process automation is a plus
  • Must be amenable to working on a U.S. Pacific Time schedule (see Working Schedule section)

Additional Role Requirements

Client Engagement I This role works directly with U.S.-based clients. It requires strong communication skills, professionalism, clarity, and the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships across borders.

Innovation & AI Focus I We seek individuals who are highly innovative and driven to leverage AI tools and technology to enhance processes, improve accuracy, and deliver value-added insights to clients.

Leadership Skills I Strong leadership potential is important. We seek professionals who take initiative, collaborate effectively, contribute ideas for continuous improvement, and are ready to grow toward a Senior role.

Service Fee & Benefits

  • $1,100 - $1,500 / month - All-In | Independent Contractor
  • Service-Break Credits (SBC) — Up to 120 Hours/Year: Use your SBC for personal time, rest days, or unplanned emergencies. These are yours to use at your discretion — because we believe rest is part of performing at your best.
  • U.S. Observance Day Credits — 13 Days/Year: You earn SBC credits on 13 recognized U.S. observance days. This gives you a built-in breathing room throughout the year without eating into your regular credits.
  • Health Allowance (From Month 7):After your 6th month of continuous engagement, you receive a monthly health allowance to support your personal wellness, preventive care, and peace of mind.
  • Dependent Health Allowance: After a period of continuous engagement, you unlock an annual dependent wellness allowance — because your family's wellbeing matters too.
  • Work From Anywhere in the Philippines: Fully remote. No commute. You choose where you work best — whether that's your home, a co-working space, or anywhere in the Philippines with a reliable internet connection.

Working Schedule & Time Zone

Important: U.S. Client Alignment

Our clients are based in the United States. Our standard operating window is 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) / Pacific Daylight Time (PDT). In practice, the majority of our team currently works a shift of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM Pacific Time, allowing for focused mornings before live client hours begin. jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We're assembling a small founding team to build something genuinely hard: high-throughput services that inspect live traffic, terminate and analyze TLS in the data path, and hold near-zero latency while doing it. This is real systems engineering — streaming, distributed, latency-obsessed — not another CRUD app behind a form.

You won't be starting cold. You inherit real infrastructure and real users, which means what you build reaches production in weeks, not years. The work is high-leverage from day one, and there's nowhere to hide — in the best way.

AI-native. Non-negotiable. You leverage AI to operate as a 10x engineer — demonstrable AI proficiency is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

What You'll Own

You take a capability from a rough idea all the way to production, and then you keep it alive and healthy there — meeting its latency and reliability targets, instrumented well enough to prove it, and hardened to survive real load and real failure. You own the outcome, not the ticket. You'll lead a functional area end to end: set its technical direction, make the calls that matter, and pull other engineers along with you.

Who You Are

  • You see what needs to exist and you go build it — you spot the gap, scope it yourself, and start, instead of waiting for someone to hand you a task or a spec.
  • You lead by taking the hardest, least-defined part of the problem and making it work, and others follow because your judgment and output earn it — not because of a title.
  • You own the entire arc — design, build, ship, operate — and you treat what happens in production as your responsibility, making sure the system behaves exactly within the parameters it's supposed to, not just that it passed in staging.
  • When you hit the edge of what you know — a protocol you've never touched, a failure mode you've never seen — curiosity and sheer grit carry you across it faster than most people expect.
  • "Good enough" makes you uncomfortable; you hold a high bar for yourself and ship work you're genuinely proud to put your name on.

What You Bring

  • Proven, demonstrable proficiency using AI as a force multiplier — you already operate as a 10x engineer, orchestrating AI tools and agents to design, build, and ship far beyond what you could alone, while keeping the judgment to know what "correct" actually looks like.
  • 5–7+ years building and operating production services and front ends, with real experience owning something end to end and carrying the weight of it once it's in front of real users.
  • Hands-on experience with TLS / MITM inspection and the security-sensitive edge cases that come with sitting in the middle of live traffic.
  • A real track record of taming latency in streaming and distributed systems — you've chased down p99 tail latency and know that "fast on my machine" means nothing until it's fast in production, under load, with observability to back it up.
  • Strong command of a modern backend language (Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node) and React/TypeScript on the front end, with a deep working grasp of HTTP, TLS, gRPC/REST, and async/streaming I/O.

Job Description:

The Sr. Staff Platform / Data Reliability Engineer is responsible for making Databricks a reliable, secure, scalable, and operationally mature platform for enterprise use. This role focuses on the platform itself rather than domain-specific business modeling, ensuring the lakehouse can support multiple domains, regulated data handling, and a growing set of production workloads without becoming fragile, expensive, or hard to govern.

This role partners closely with the Senior Staff Data Engineer, who focuses more heavily on ingestion and medallion implementation patterns, and with the existing Cloud & Infrastructure team, which owns cloud accounts, networking, and foundational infrastructure. The Platform / Data Reliability Engineer owns the Databricks operational layer that sits above that foundation: reliability, observability, deployment standards, compute and job policies, and platform enablement patterns for internal users.

What you'll do:

  • Own operational excellence for the Databricks platform, including monitoring, alerting, observability, incident response support, and production runbook patterns for data jobs and platform services.
  • Define and maintain CI/CD and promotion standards for Databricks assets, including workflows, jobs, notebooks, code packages, infrastructure configuration, and environment promotion from dev to prod.
  • Design and maintain platform standards for job orchestration, cluster and compute policies, service principal usage, environment isolation, and production execution reliability.
  • Establish reusable operational templates and enablement patterns for new domains onboarding to Databricks, including logging conventions, job tagging, metadata capture, and support handoff expectations.
  • Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure ingestion and medallion patterns are implemented in a way that is observable, recoverable, cost-aware, and secure in production.
  • Work with the cloud/infrastructure team to align Databricks configuration and usage patterns with broader enterprise cloud standards, especially where commercial and future government-hosted environments are involved.
  • Help enforce technical controls for data segregation, access boundaries, and operational compliance in a highly regulated environment.
  • Track and improve platform health metrics such as job success rates, incident trends, data pipeline reliability, cost efficiency, and environment drift.
  • Document platform standards, operational expectations, and support models so the Databricks platform can scale beyond a small founding team.
  • Mentor internal engineers who are growing into platform responsibilities, helping expand Databricks operational knowledge within the team.

Required qualifications:

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in data platform engineering, platform operations, site reliability engineering, or modern cloud data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks or a closely related cloud data platform in production environments.
  • Experience designing or operating CI/CD, environment promotion, version control, and deployment automation for data platforms and pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of platform operations concepts such as observability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  • Experience with compute policy design, workload isolation, service principals, and secure production execution patterns on cloud data platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively in a regulated or security-sensitive environment with strong expectations around access control, auditability, and operational discipline.
  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort partnering with cloud/infrastructure, security, data engineering, and analytics stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Databricks certification and/or strong demonstrated expertise with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows, and Databricks Asset Bundles.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and platform automation in enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting commercial and government or otherwise segregated environments with different compliance and access requirements.
  • Experience in defense, aerospace, federal, or another regulated industry.

Teach English Online!

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation

  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

Head of Engineering (.NET, AI/LLM & Distributed Systems) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Location: Remote — Pakistan, LATAM & Eastern Europe Preferred

About the Role

We’re hiring a highly technical, hands-on Head of Engineering to own the engineering function for a fast-growing SaaS platform.

This is not a purely managerial role. You’ll remain deeply involved in production engineering while leading a lean technical team and owning architecture, infrastructure, reliability, and engineering standards.

You’ll work across:

  • .NET / C# backend engineering
  • Distributed systems and microservices
  • AI & LLM infrastructure
  • Databases and data pipelines
  • DevOps, CI/CD and observability
  • Third-party API integrations
  • Engineering leadership and technical strategy

If you’re a senior engineering leader who still enjoys writing production code, solving difficult architecture problems, and owning systems end-to-end, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Backend Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using:
    • .NET 8.0
    • C#
    • ASP.NET Core
    • Entity Framework Core
  • Own architecture across 14+ independently deployed microservices
  • Apply Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles
  • Ship new product capabilities while improving existing systems
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks
  • Improve scalability, maintainability, and engineering standards
  • Make pragmatic architectural decisions that balance speed with long-term reliability

AI & LLM Systems

  • Design and operate production-grade AI/LLM pipelines
  • Manage workflows spanning multiple AI providers
  • Build scalable AI capabilities for:
    • Personalization
    • Segmentation
    • Automation
    • AI-assisted product features
  • Optimize:
    • Prompting
    • Orchestration
    • Provider routing
    • Failover logic
  • Monitor and improve:
    • Token usage
    • Rate limits
    • Latency
    • Reliability
    • AI infrastructure costs
  • Introduce effective AI-assisted development workflows across engineering

Databases & Data Infrastructure

  • Manage production environments using:
    • MySQL
    • Redis
    • MongoDB
  • Design and improve caching strategies
  • Support analytics pipelines and event-driven workflows
  • Manage high-volume and bulk data operations
  • Optimize database schemas, indexing, and queries
  • Maintain data consistency and performance across distributed services

Infrastructure, DevOps & Reliability

  • Own Linux-based production infrastructure
  • Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines
  • Oversee deployments and release reliability
  • Implement centralized:
    • Monitoring
    • Logging
    • Alerting
    • Observability
  • Identify infrastructure and scalability risks proactively
  • Improve uptime, incident response, and deployment stability
  • Strengthen engineering processes around production reliability

APIs, Integrations & Resilience

  • Own 25+ production third-party API integrations
  • Build resilient integration patterns including:
    • Retry logic
    • Provider failover
    • Graceful degradation
    • Fallback strategies
    • Error handling
  • Protect platform stability during third-party outages and degraded services
  • Improve fault tolerance across external dependencies and distributed workflows

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a lean engineering team
  • Conduct meaningful code reviews and architecture reviews
  • Remain hands-on with production code
  • Establish engineering standards for:
    • Code quality
    • Documentation
    • Testing
    • Deployment
    • Architecture
  • Guide developers through complex technical decisions
  • Collaborate directly with founders and leadership on:
    • Product roadmap
    • Technical priorities
    • Architecture
    • Scalability
    • Engineering investment
  • Build a culture centered on ownership, execution, and engineering quality

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’re a strong fit if you:

  • Are an experienced engineering leader who still codes
  • Have deep backend expertise in the Microsoft/.NET ecosystem
  • Have designed and operated distributed production systems
  • Understand how microservices behave under real-world scale and failure conditions
  • Have hands-on experience building AI/LLM systems in production
  • Can own infrastructure rather than treating DevOps as someone else’s responsibility
  • Think proactively about reliability, scalability, and technical debt
  • Can lead a small team without becoming disconnected from the codebase
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to founders and business leadership
  • Thrive in high-ownership startup environments

Required Experience & Skills

Core Engineering

  • Deep expertise with .NET 8.0, C#, ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework Core
  • Strong distributed systems and microservices architecture experience
  • Production experience with MySQL, Redis and MongoDB
  • Experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems
  • Strong API architecture and integration experience
  • Experience managing complex distributed workflows

AI Engineering

  • Proven experience building and operating AI/LLM systems in production
  • Experience integrating multiple AI/LLM providers
  • Understanding of:
    • Prompt orchestration
    • Rate limits
    • Failover
    • Latency
    • Cost optimization
    • Production reliability

DevOps & Reliability

  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Linux infrastructure
    • CI/CD
    • Production deployments
    • Monitoring
    • Logging
    • Observability
  • Strong understanding of system scalability and reliability engineering

Leadership

  • Experience leading and mentoring software engineers
  • Strong code-review and architecture-review capabilities
  • Ability to own technical priorities and engineering execution
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Ability to work closely with non-technical leadership

Nice to Have

  • Startup or high-growth SaaS experience
  • Experience scaling AI-powered SaaS or automation platforms
  • Kubernetes
  • Docker
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Event streaming and high-throughput architectures
  • Advanced asynchronous processing experience
  • AI inference and cost optimization experience
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted engineering workflows

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day could include:

  • Writing and reviewing production .NET/C# code
  • Making architectural decisions across microservices
  • Debugging a production performance or reliability issue
  • Reviewing AI pipeline latency, cost, or provider performance
  • Helping an engineer work through a complex implementation
  • Reviewing database or caching performance
  • Improving monitoring and deployment workflows
  • Meeting with founders on product and engineering priorities
  • Designing the architecture for an upcoming platform capability

In short: you own the technical foundation of the platform while keeping the engineering organization moving quickly and reliably.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Platform uptime and system reliability
  • Backend performance and scalability
  • AI pipeline stability, latency, and cost efficiency
  • Deployment success and engineering velocity
  • Reduction in production incidents
  • Code quality and technical debt management
  • Reliability of third-party integrations
  • Team delivery consistency
  • Infrastructure stability and observability

Why This Role Stands Out

  • True technical ownership of a growing SaaS platform
  • Hands-on leadership rather than management-only work
  • Direct influence over architecture and engineering strategy
  • Production exposure to AI/LLM systems at scale
  • Ownership across backend, infrastructure, data, integrations, and reliability
  • Direct collaboration with founders and leadership
  • Fully remote environment
  • Opportunity to shape the engineering organization as the platform scales

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Technical Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Technical & Architecture Interview with Client
  4. Final Leadership Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video completed on your own time and is the final step needed to complete your application.

Instead of repeating your background across multiple screening calls, you get to introduce yourself once and give the hiring team a better sense of your experience and communication before the first interview.

Don’t overthink it. You can record your responses multiple times, and discarded takes are not shared.

  • Have deep .NET/C# backend engineering expertise
  • Have built and scaled distributed systems and microservices
  • Have real production experience with AI/LLM infrastructure
  • Enjoy remaining hands-on while leading engineers
  • Want end-to-end ownership of a growing SaaS platform

jobs.excerpt: OverviewSince 1972, Covenant House has served and advocated for youth and young families experiencing homelessness, human trafficking, and exploitation.
jobs.description:
Overview

Since 1972, Covenant House has served and advocated for youth and young families experiencing homelessness, human trafficking, and exploitation. Our overarching goal is to end homelessness among youth and young families by helping them achieve housing stability, heal from trauma, tap into their innate resilience, and hone their interests and skills to forge new pathways to independence. This work is carried out across Covenant House sites in 34 cities in the US, Canada, Mexico, Guatemala, and Honduras.

About the Role

The Director of State and Local Advocacy is responsible for strengthening advocacy capability across our domestic sites in the United States to help advance policy solutions that prevent and end youth homelessness, combat human trafficking, and address the social determinants of health that impact young people’s access to a bright, healthy, safe future.

This role is designed for an emerging mid-career policy leader who combines strong cross-cutting legislative and regulatory knowledge with a practical, implementation-oriented approach. The director will serve as a hands-on contributor who develops tools, analyzes policy landscapes, supports advocacy campaigns, builds partnerships, and translates policy opportunities into action; as well as a trusted advisor and coach to site leaders as staff.

The ideal candidate is someone who can independently lead projects, build trust across diverse stakeholders, cultivate strategic partnerships, navigate complex political environments, and help local leaders become more powerful and successful advocates. They are motivated by effectiveness rather than ideology, comfortable working across political perspectives, and committed to building durable bipartisan support for policies that improve outcomes for America’s most vulnerable young people.

In this role, you will report directly to the Senior Vice President of Advocacy and Strategic Partnerships. There are no direct reports to this role at this time. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of youth homelessness advocacy across the United States within an international federation of sites. In this role, you won't just analyze policy. You will help turn it into action, working across state and local systems in partnership with leaders, public officials, community providers, and young people. You'll have the autonomy to lead meaningful projects, the mentorship and visibility that come with partnering directly with senior leadership, and the opportunity to build a national reputation as an emerging public policy leader. If you are energized by solving complex problems, thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy translating strategy into execution, and want your work to have a tangible impact on the lives of vulnerable young people, this role offers a rare blend of mission, influence, growth, and purpose for a policy professional looking to take the next step in their career.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Policy Analysis and Strategy Development (45%)

  • Monitor state and local legislative, regulatory, and administrative developments affecting youth homelessness, housing, child welfare, trafficking, education, workforce development, behavioral health, and related social determinants of health

  • Conduct policy landscape analyses and identify opportunities for systems change in partnership with site leadership, frontline staff, community partners, and young people with lived experience and expertise

  • Produce policy briefs, issue papers, legislative summaries, talking points, fact sheets, and other advocacy materials

  • Translate complex policy developments into actionable guidance for nonprofit leaders, program staff with frontline experience and expertise, and youth with lived experience and expertise

  • Support the development of CHI's broader domestic advocacy agenda in partnership with the SVP of Advocacy & Strategic Partnerships

State and Local Advocacy Capacity Building (25%)

  • Design and implement capacity- and capability building strategies across CHI's sites in the United States

  • Partner with site leaders and key staff to develop, execute, and enhance state and local advocacy plans through continuous quality improvement

  • Develop practical advocacy tools, guidance documents, training curricula, and implementation resources for CH sites and partners

  • Provide technical assistance on legislative, regulatory, budget, and administrative advocacy strategies at the state and local levels in coordination with federal / national advocacy priorities and strategies

  • Build systems and processes that enable sites to engage effectively with policymakers, partners, and community stakeholders

Systems Change and Implementation Support (15%)

  • Help sites navigate state and local implementation of federal funding and policy initiatives in partnership with SVP of advocacy and strategic partnerships

  • Support sites in understanding how federal, state, and local systems interact and influence outcomes for young people

  • Identify best practices and emerging models that can be adapted across the federation

  • Assist in scaling effective advocacy approaches, disseminating lessons learned publicly, and cross-pollinating innovations and best practices across the federation

Internal Leadership and Collaboration (10%)

  • Serve as a thought partner to the SVP while exercising significant independent judgment and ownership at the project / workstream level

  • Collaborate closely with colleagues in strategy office and across CHI departments, U.S. site leaders, and external partners

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that advance CHI's prevention, advocacy, and partnership priorities

  • Support organizational efforts to strengthen data-informed advocacy and policy storytelling

Coalition and Partnership Development (5%)

  • Cultivate relationships with nonprofit partners, advocacy organizations, research institutions, government agencies, and philanthropy

  • Represent CHI in coalitions, working groups, and policy collaboratives as assigned

  • Identify opportunities for collective impact and cross-sector collaboration

  • Support implementation of CHI's strategic partnerships framework at the site and community levels

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Project management excellence — ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and consistently deliver high quality outputs on deadlines

  • Political judgment — knows how to effectively assess risk, timing, and stakeholder interests to provide discerning recommendations to SVP of advocacy and strategic partnerships

  • Change management — experience helping organizations, teams, and individual contributors adopt and sustain new practices and approaches

  • Relationship management across levels — comfortable engaging CEOs, frontline staff, youth leaders, government officials, and community partners

  • Facilitation and convening expertise — capable of leading workshops, strategy sessions, peer-learning cohorts, and planning processes

  • Data literacy — ability to interpret and communicate data for advocacy, policy analysis, and decision-making

  • Resource development and grant knowledge — familiarity with public funding systems and how policy influences nonprofit financing

  • Cultural humility and intergenerational leadership — experience working effectively with youth, emerging leaders, and senior executives alike

  • Comfort with ambiguity and entrepreneurial environments — able to build systems, iterate for improvement, rapidly apply learning, pivot rapidly, and effectively prioritize

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, Zoom, and project management tools

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of progressively responsible experience in public policy, advocacy, systems change, government affairs, coalition leadership, technical assistance, consulting, or related fields

  • Demonstrated experience supporting policy implementation and/or advocacy initiatives at state and local levels

  • Significant knowledge of at least one major social determinant of health policy domain, such as housing, behavioral health, workforce development, education, child welfare, poverty reduction, public benefits, violence prevention, or juvenile justice

  • Familiarity with federal legislative and regulatory processes and their interaction with state and local systems

  • Experience working with nonprofit organizations, public agencies, coalitions, or cross-sector partnerships

  • Experience navigating politically diverse environments and building bipartisan relationships

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in public policy, social work, public administration, public health, political science, law, or related field

  • Proficiency with Asana, Smartsheet and Quorum

  • Capacity building and adult learning expertise

  • Coaching and facilitation skills

  • Exceptional policy writing and communication abilities

  • Landscape analysis and environmental scanning experience

  • Systems-thinking and systems-change orientation

  • Coalition-building and stakeholder engagement expertise

  • Ability to translate strategy into operational plans and deliverables

Travel Requirements

  • Ability to travel once per year to New York City in early October for our annual in-person traditions

  • Travel nationally up to 25% for direct technical assistance, meetings with the Advocacy Team or Strategy Office, and conferences/ meetings

  • Outside of above travel, this position is 100% remote

Our Community

Our critical mission demands that we have all voices at the table. A team of diverse people, perspectives, and experiences is smarter, stronger, and more effective for our young people. At Covenant House, every team member is valued, respected, heard, and supported, and we welcome honest and courageous self-reflection on any aspects of our work that are based on biased or outdated viewpoints. We deliberately create opportunities for our staff to grow and thrive.

Ready to do work that actually excites you?
The Lighting Design Engineer is responsible for developing practical, compliant and commercially appropriate lighting solutions for new and existing retail stores. The role combines lighting design, technical engineering, product selection and documentation to ensure each solution supports the client brief, brand environment, buildability, energy performance and applicable Australian requirements. Working closely with project, estimating, construction, procurement, client and external consultant teams, the role will take lighting concepts through calculation, coordination, documentation, review and project support.
What You'll Do
You'll be the kind of person who:
  • Develop lighting concepts and design options for retail stores, shopfronts, back-of-house areas and associated spaces.
  • Prepare lighting layouts, luminaire schedules, reflected ceiling coordination information, control intent and design notes.
  • Complete or coordinate lighting calculations, including illumination, uniformity and glare considerations appropriate to the space and task.
  • Engineer lighting solutions for compliance with applicable Australian Standards, National Construction Code requirements, electrical design criteria and client specifications.
  • Confirm product suitability, photometric performance, electrical characteristics, mounting constraints, maintenance access and compatibility with lighting controls.
  • Coordinate lighting requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire, signage, joinery and ceiling documentation.
  • Provide technically sound, value-conscious alternatives while protecting design intent, safety, quality and compliance.
  • Review shop drawings, technical submissions, samples and substitutions, and clearly document comments, assumptions and outstanding information.
  • Provide technical support during estimating, procurement, construction, commissioning and defects close out.
  • Maintain accurate design records, calculations, approvals, product data and revision-controlled documentation.
ACCOUNTABILITY / EXPECTED OUTCOME AND BENCHMARK MEASURES
Lighting design deliveryAccurate, coordinated lighting designs are produced to agreed program and brief.
  • Design options reflect the retail environment, visual tasks, brand intent, constructability and budget.
  • Layouts, calculations, schedules, assumptions and revisions are complete and traceable.
  • Design information is issued in accordance with project milestones.
Engineering & compliance Lightingsolutions are technically suitable and address applicable project requirements.
  • Applicable standards, code requirements and client criteria are identified for each project.
  • Calculations and technical selections are checked and documented before issue.
  • Items requiring specialist certification, electrical sign-off or external consultant input are escalated promptly.
Coordination & constructabilityLighting integrates with the full store design and can be installed and maintained safely.
  • Clashes and interface risks are identified early.
  • Architectural, services, joinery, signage and ceiling information is reviewed and coordinated.
  • Site constraints and installation access are considered in design decisions.
Product selection & valueSpecified products are fit for purpose, available and commercially appropriate
  • Luminaire performance, controls compatibility, warranty, lead time and maintenance implications are assessed.
  • Alternatives and substitutions are evaluated against documented technical and design criteria.
  • Cost-saving options are presented without compromising compliance, safety or approved design intent
Stakeholder communicationClear, timely technical advice supports project decisions
  • Project teams receive concise status updates, design clarifications and records of decisions.
  • Queries from clients, consultants, suppliers and site teams are responded to within agreed project timeframes.
  • Risks, assumptions and outstanding information are visible and actively managed.

Project support & close-out Design intent is supported through construction, commissioning and handover
  • Technical submissions and shop drawings are reviewed in a timely manner.
  • Site issues, defects and commissioning outcomes are documented and resolved with the relevant parties.
  • Lessons learned and proven design details are captured for future stores.
Systems & continuous improvementLighting design tools, templates and technical libraries remain accurate and useful.
  • Product data, standard details, calculation templates and approved selections are maintained.
  • Design processes are reviewed for quality, efficiency and repeatability.
  • Reporting is prepared as required.
Health, safety & complianceActivities are completed with a safety-first and accountable mindset.
  • Design decisions consider safe installation, operation, maintenance and access.
  • Work is performed in accordance with company policies, legal obligations and project governance.
  • Potential safety, quality or compliance issues are raised immediately.

Requirements

What You Bring

We're looking for someone who:
  • Tertiary qualification in electrical engineering, lighting design, architectural engineering, building services or a closely related discipline. Equivalent demonstrated experience may be considered.
  • Experience designing lighting solutions for retail, commercial interiors, hospitality, workplace or other customer-facing environments.
  • Working knowledge of lighting calculations, photometric files, luminaire performance, colour quality, controls and energy efficiency principles.
  • Ability to interpret architectural, reflected ceiling, electrical and services drawings.
  • Experience with lighting calculation and design software such as DIALux, Relux or equivalent, together with CAD/BIM and Microsoft 365 tools.
  • Knowledge of relevant Australian regulatory and standards frameworks. The successful candidate must be able to identify and apply the current requirements relevant to each project.
  • Experience in retail rollout, shopfitting or multi-site project delivery will be highly regarded.
OTHER SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & PERSONAL QUALITIES
  • Strong technical judgement, attention to detail and disciplined document control.
  • Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Commercial awareness and a practical understanding of construction sequencing, lead times and site constraints.
  • Collaborative approach with the confidence to challenge unsuitable products, incomplete information or non-compliant proposals.
  • Ability to manage multiple store designs and priorities while meeting project deadlines.
  • Initiative, curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here
  • HMO, Dental, and Life Insurance for you and one free dependent from day one (with the option to enroll additional dependents)
  • Paid Leaves: Birthday, Vacation, Medical, and Maternity (up to 6 Vacation Leaves are convertible to cash on your anniversary)
  • Employee Engagement Activities: Year-End Party, Family Day, Team Building, and more!
Let's Talk

Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a highly organised, detail-oriented Medical Scheduler to join a growing healthcare services team.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised, detail-oriented Medical Scheduler to join a growing healthcare services team.

Our client, Legadel, is a school-based therapy provider supporting approximately 130 children through a range of services, including Applied Behaviour Analysis (ABA), occupational therapy, physical therapy, speech therapy and psychology.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating therapy schedules, matching service providers with children's therapy requirements, communicating schedule arrangements and maintaining accurate scheduling records.

You will work closely with an in-house supervisor who will provide training, guidance and approval during your onboarding. You do not need previous ABA or healthcare experience to succeed in this position. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, follow instructions, work accurately and manage scheduling details.This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys structured administrative work, problem-solving and coordinating multiple moving parts.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Scheduling & Coordination

  • Build and maintain therapy schedules based on children's requirements, therapist availability and provider caseloads.
  • Match Behaviour Technicians (BTs) with children while making the best use of available provider hours.
  • Coordinate schedules across different therapy requirements and classroom timetables.
  • Prepare proposed schedules for review and approval by the in-house supervisor.
  • Identify scheduling gaps, clashes and potential conflicts before schedules are finalised.

2. Provider Communication

  • Contact Behaviour Technicians via phone or email to communicate and confirm their schedules.
  • Follow up with providers regarding availability, scheduling changes and outstanding confirmations.
  • Handle routine scheduling queries professionally and efficiently.
  • Escalate provider objections, availability changes and unusual scheduling conflicts to the supervisor.

3. Scheduling Administration & Systems

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date scheduling records.
  • Enter approved schedules into the Chorus scheduling system once trained and authorised.
  • Assist with ongoing schedule adjustments and updates.
  • Process additional scheduling entries resulting from therapy reauthorisations.
  • Ensure recurring therapy sessions are correctly adjusted to account for relevant Jewish holidays.

4. Ongoing Scheduling Support

  • Assist with maintaining daily classroom schedules.
  • Support annual scheduling preparation ahead of each new school year.
  • Help manage increased scheduling activity during the summer preparation period.
  • Ensure schedule changes are communicated and recorded accurately.

Minimum Requirements

  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good problem-solving and logical thinking abilities.
  • Comfortable working with schedules, spreadsheets and multiple pieces of information.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Confident communicating with different people over the phone and via email.
  • Ability to follow structured instructions and established processes.
  • Able to work independently, manage priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Comfortable learning new software systems and administrative processes.

Advantageous Experience

The following would be beneficial but are not essential:

  • A college or university qualification.
  • Previous scheduling, coordination or administrative experience.
  • Exposure to healthcare, education, therapy or medical administration.
  • Experience coordinating staff shifts, appointments or service schedules.
  • Familiarity with scheduling software, databases or CRM systems.
  • Previous exposure to ABA therapy or working with Behaviour Technicians.

Important: We are open to training someone from scratch. Previous ABA experience is not a requirement.

Software & Systems

  • Chorus / Autism Care (full training will be provided).
  • Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Email and scheduling platforms.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Naturally organised and enjoys bringing structure to moving parts.
  • Intelligent, quick to learn and able to understand new processes.
  • Patient and comfortable with repetitive but important administrative tasks.
  • Meticulous about details and unlikely to overlook small scheduling errors.
  • Proactive about identifying potential scheduling problems.
  • Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear.
  • Reliable, consistent and able to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

We value ability, attitude and attention to detail over industry experience. If you are a smart, organised individual who enjoys coordination and administration, we would love to hear from you

jobs.description:
Principal || Data Scientist

What you will be doing:

This position will lead independent and collaborative research programs in biostatistics and health outcomes research, in partnership with public health government agencies, hospitals and health systems, and academic institutions. Apply advanced statistical and epidemiologic methods to real-world evidence (RWE) datasets, including electronic health record, administrative billing, and post-adjudicated claims data, to design observational studies, answer clinically and operationally relevant questions, and produce high-impact peer-reviewed publications. Lead the development of statistical analysis plans and research protocols, and translate study findings into new products, services, and features that support quality improvement, population health management, and policy.


A doctoral degree and considerable research experience are required. A clinical or public health background is desired, along with an understanding of how clinicians wish to deploy analytics in support of quality improvement and population health management applications.


This level is recognized as expert in their field, knowledgeable of emerging trends and industry practices. Works without supervision with complete latitude for independent judgment. May mentor less experienced peers and display leadership as needed.

  • Biostatistics and Epidemiology
  • Real-World Evidence and Observational Research
  • Partner engagement: public health agencies, health systems, and academia

Key Responsibilities


Research Leadership and Collaboration – 25%

  • Lead research projects in collaboration with public health government agencies, hospitals and health systems, and academic institutions
  • Translate research findings into new products, services, and features with product and engineering teams, and provide scientific leadership for large scale implementation
  • Design, conduct, and evaluate observational studies (e.g., cohort and cross-sectional) using RWE datasets, including administrative and EHR data
  • Work with internal and external SMEs to identify research questions that improve quality, safety, and efficiency across the healthcare system

Study Design and Statistical Methodology – 25%

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in biostatistics and epidemiology across business domains (Cost, Clinical, MDM, etc.)
  • Develop statistical analysis plans and research protocols for studies and strategic initiatives
  • Apply advanced statistical methods, including GLMs, GLMMs, GAMs, ZIPs, hypothesis testing, propensity score matching, and IPW, and causal inference methods (e.g., mediation analysis, structural equation modeling) where appropriate, to produce valid and reproducible results
  • Generate and test hypotheses and interpret study results for clinical, operational, and policy audiences

Stakeholder Engagement and Research Partnerships – 15%

  • Facilitate & lead meetings with public health agencies, health system and hospital partners, academic collaborators, and internal teams to define research questions and requirements
  • Analyze partner needs, procedures and problems, design research approaches and make recommendations
  • Use clinical, public health, or technical background to interpret partner needs and translate them into clinically meaningful research and products
  • Translate research findings into features and requirements that feed product backlogs

Publishing and Presentations – 20%

  • Generate peer reviewed publications in high-impact journals as first or lead author, highlighting Premier’s research and innovative methodologies
  • Create patent submissions to protect Premier’s intellectual property
  • Publicly present innovative work at conferences and symposiums to demonstrate Premier’s thought

Knowledge Sharing - Operations – 10%

  • Provide statistical and research methodology advice, demonstrations and presentations to colleagues, client, and management
  • Provide mentoring and training

Research Operations – 10%

  • On your own or indirectly supervising research teams to:
  • Develop project estimates, research timelines, and work plans
  • Identify develop, review, and evolve best practices, standards, and processes for rigorous, reproducible research
  • Participate in the review of team member analyses and deliverables

​Required Qualifications

Work Experience:

Years of Applicable Experience - 10 or more years

Education:

Doctorate (Required)

Preferred Qualifications

Skills:

  • Strong business/healthcare analytics, statistics, simulation and advanced mathematics, data search, and matching experience
  • Leading collaborative research with government, health system, and academic partners
  • Excellent writing and speaking skills
  • Technical: R (Tidyverse), Python, and SQL; data modeling

Experience:

  • Considerable post-doctoral research experience leading observational studies in healthcare, public health, or epidemiology
  • Biostatistics, epidemiology, and health outcomes research; machine learning experience a plus
  • Strong knowledge of real-world evidence (RWE) datasets, including administrative and EHR data
  • Strong track record of applied statistics, including GLMs, GLMMs, GAMs, ZIPs, hypothesis testing, propensity score matching, and inverse probability weighting (IPW)
  • Development of statistical analysis plans and leading research projects
  • Proven track record publishing in high-impact peer-reviewed journals as first or lead author, with observational study designs (e.g., cohort and cross-sectional), and experience submitting patent applications
  • Experience with customer engagement, collaboration, and conflict management

As our firm continues to grow, we are seeking a Managing Attorney to lead our legal team and set the standard of excellence across every department. This attorney will hold the firm's highest legal position — providing legal strategy guidance across our immigration practice, supervising and mentoring attorneys and staff, and partnering with firm leadership on recruitment, training, and performance across the firm. The ideal candidate is a seasoned immigration attorney and natural leader who communicates directly, gives specific and constructive feedback, and is comfortable being both a strategic resource for the team and a trusted point of contact for clients navigating complex cases.

  • Provide specific, documented feedback to attorneys and staff — identifying correct approach, training needed, as well as issues from process, training, or software/systems limitations.
  • Build and maintain trust-based relationships with clients on complex or sensitive matters; step in directly with clients when needed, including addressing concerns or dissatisfaction with clear, disciplined communication about strategy and risk.
  • Identify recurring issues or trends across the firm's caseload (e.g., denials, drafting or evidentiary weaknesses) and help translate them into practice-wide improvements and training.
  • Hold regular, consistently scheduled meetings with attorneys and department leads to share case- and judge-specific knowledge across the firm, and collaborate directly and proactively with other department leaders on cross-team issues.
  • Oversee attorneys in satellite offices and remote roles, and act as a back-up to any legal department lead attorney when needed.
  • Look for gaps in legal processes and firm operations to identify opportunities for improvement, and stay current on changes in immigration law and policy, advising the broader attorney team accordingly.
  • Participate in executive meetings and prepare quarterly and annual reports on legal department analytics; report to the Chief Executive Officer and collaborate with the Chief Operations Officer.

About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Position Summary

The Director of Compliance provides strategic leadership for the organization's hospice compliance program. This role focuses on regulatory oversight, risk management, audit program governance, policy governance, and corrective action management. The Director serves as the operational leader of the Clinical Compliance and Audit sub-team, translating organizational compliance strategy into day-to-day execution while partnering with the VP of Compliance and Quality on enterprise-level initiatives.

Essential Functions

Compliance Strategy and Regulatory Oversight

• Partner with the VP of Compliance and Quality to develop and execute the organization's hospice compliance strategy.

• Monitor federal and state regulatory changes across all operating markets and assess organizational impact.

• Ensure organizational compliance with Medicare Conditions of Participation (CoPs), state licensing requirements, and accreditation standards.

• Serve as a subject matter resource on hospice regulatory requirements for operational and clinical leadership.

Audit Program Governance

• Provide direct oversight of the Clinical Compliance and Audit sub-team, managing both clinical and technical audit functions.

• Design and maintain the internal audit plan, including scope, frequency, and focus areas informed by regulatory risk and external audit trends (TPE, CERT, UPIC).

• Review and analyze audit findings, identifying patterns and systemic issues that require corrective action or clinical education.

• Collaborate with the Clinical Nurse Educator team to translate audit findings into targeted education initiatives for clinical staff.

Corrective Action Plan (CAP) Management

• Own the corrective action lifecycle from root cause analysis through resolution and re-monitoring, in strategic partnership with the VP of Compliance and Quality.

• Develop, track, and close corrective action plans resulting from internal audits, external audits, survey findings, and incident investigations.

• Monitor CAP effectiveness and report on closure timelines and outcomes.

Policy Governance

• Own the policy management lifecycle including development, scheduled review cycles, regulatory alignment, and approval workflows.

• Ensure policies remain current with CMS requirements, state regulations, and accreditation standards across all operating markets.

• Coordinate with the Associate Director of Regulatory Compliance and Quality on policy administrative infrastructure (version control, distribution, acknowledgment tracking).

Investigations

• Conduct internal compliance investigations in partnership with the VP of Compliance and Quality, including documentation of findings, root cause identification, and recommended corrective actions.

• Share investigative responsibilities with the VP based on complexity, scope, and regulatory implications.

• Escalate matters requiring external or legal investigation to the VP of Compliance and Quality.

• Maintain investigation documentation in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

Incident, Complaint, and Grievance Oversight

• Provide operational oversight of the incident, complaint, and grievance process, with administrative management performed by the Associate Director of Regulatory Compliance and Quality.

• Review trends in incident and grievance data and recommend process improvements.

• Report on incident and grievance trends to the VP of Compliance and Quality for executive-level reporting.

External Audit Response

• Coordinate the organization's response to external audits including TPE, CERT, and UPIC reviews.

• Prepare documentation and manage timelines for audit responses and appeals.

• Track external audit outcomes and incorporate lessons learned into the internal audit plan and education priorities.

Qualifications

• Active RN license required.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on PostgreSQL DBA to help manage database services across our on-premises infrastructure and GCP. The role combines production operations with project work, including migration from Community PostgreSQL to EDB Postgres, high-availability standardization, database consolidation, and operational automation.

You will work closely with DBAs, SRE, infrastructure, application, and security teams. We need someone who can assess the current environment, identify risks and improvements, recommend practical solutions, and follow them through to stable production operations.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  • PostgreSQL and EDB administration. Administer the full database lifecycle, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, capacity planning, security, monitoring, incident response, and decommissioning.
  • High availability with EFM. Configure, operate, monitor, and troubleshoot EDB Failover Manager clusters; perform planned switchovers and failover tests; validate application connectivity; and safely reintegrate failed or former primary nodes.
  • Backup and recovery with Barman. Configure and monitor base backups and WAL archiving or streaming, manage retention, execute point-in-time recovery, and conduct documented restore and disaster-recovery tests against agreed RPO and RTO targets.
  • Monitoring and alerting with PEM. Register and manage servers and agents, configure meaningful metrics and alert thresholds, investigate alerts and performance trends using graphs, and maintain notification and escalation integrations.
  • Automation and version control. Use TPA and Ansible/Spacelift to build repeatable PostgreSQL/EDB environments and maintain playbooks and configuration in Git and GitHub using branches, pull requests, and peer review.
  • Replication and recovery. Configure and troubleshoot physical streaming and logical replication, replication slots, WAL retention, lag, and timeline issues; use pg_rewind when appropriate to resynchronize a node after timelines diverge.
  • Performance engineering. Analyze execution plans and wait or lock behavior, tune SQL and indexes, and optimize PostgreSQL and operating-system settings, including autovacuum, memory, storage, and checkpoint or WAL behavior.
  • Connectivity and security. Operate PgBouncer and manage roles, privileges, authentication, pg_hba.conf, TLS, secrets, and least-privilege access in line with organizational standards.
  • Migrations and consolidation. Plan and execute major and minor version upgrades, Community PostgreSQL-to-EDB migrations, and database consolidation with validated rollback, testing, and minimal downtime.
  • Operational ownership. Create runbooks and architecture documentation, participate in change and incident processes, collaborate with engineering teams, and join an on-call rotation for production emergencies.
  • Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

This is a full-time and remote position based in the U.K. The target compensation package for this role is between GBP 50,000 and 54,000, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, technology, or a related field is strongly preferred. In lieu of degree, 2+ years of relevant and/or equivalent experience is acceptable.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration in production environments, including both routine operations and complex troubleshooting is required.
  • Hands-on production experience with EDB Postgres, EFM, Barman, PEM, and TPA, along with PostgreSQL monitoring using Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Strong understanding of PostgreSQL HA design, streaming replication, failure detection, switchovers, failovers, quorum or witness concepts, split-brain prevention, and node rejoin procedures.
  • Demonstrated experience with backup validation, WAL archiving, retention management, point-in-time recovery, and full restore or disaster-recovery testing.
  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL internals, including WAL, MVCC, vacuum and autovacuum, checkpoints, memory management, locking, and transaction behavior.
  • Strong SQL performance-tuning skills, including EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), index design, query-plan analysis, and diagnosis of blocking or resource contention.
  • Solid Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including CPU, memory, filesystem, storage I/O, systemd services, networking, and shell scripting.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Ansible, Git, and GitHub, including playbooks, inventories, pull requests, peer review, conflict resolution, and version-controlled TPA configuration.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting PgBouncer.
  • Experience with GCP and/or AWS, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity and access management, and cloud monitoring.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, disciplined documentation, sound production judgment, and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation.

Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with comparable PostgreSQL tools such as Patroni, repmgr, pgBackRest, or pgWatch.
  • Experience with Terraform and automation using Bash or Python.
  • Previous involvement in large PostgreSQL migrations, major-version upgrades, database consolidation, or hybrid on-premises/cloud environments.
  • Experience administering MariaDB or MySQL.
  • You are a practical, accountable DBA who balances availability and data protection with delivery needs. You investigate carefully, communicate risk clearly, automate repeatable work, test recovery procedures rather than assuming they work, and remain calm during production incidents.

Job Title: Directeur adjoint, Solutions et pres associée, Stratégie des solutions et

Job Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Aperçu du poste

À titre de Directeur adjoint, Solutions et prestation (SDL), vous agirez comme leader stratégique, scientifique et opérationnel au sein du groupe Solutions de données probantes en contexte réel (Real World Evidence - RWE). Vous serez responsable de l’élaboration des stratégies clients, de la croissance des revenus et de l’excellence de la prestation dans le cadre de mandats complexes de RWE comportant plusieurs offres de services. Vous agirez également comme expert de contenu et conseiller de confiance auprès des clients, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes internes afin de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre des solutions de données probantes adaptées et à forte valeur ajoutée.

Principales responsabilités

  • Diriger la stratégie, le développement commercial et la supervision de la prestation des solutions RWE pour les mandats liés aux données probantes en contexte réel.
  • Favoriser la croissance des ventes et des revenus RWE au sein des comptes stratégiques en identifiant et en faisant progresser les occasions de vente croisée et de vente complémentaire.
  • Établir et maintenir des relations avec des clients de niveau supérieur, généralement au siège social, au-delà des mandats actifs afin de soutenir le positionnement précoce et le développement du pipeline d’opportunités pour les actifs prioritaires.
  • Assurer la réalisation de projets clients de grande qualité et rentables tout en renforçant la confiance à long terme des clients grâce à une gestion rigoureuse de la prestation.
  • Mettre à profit une connaissance approfondie du portefeuille RWE d’IQVIA afin de concevoir des solutions intégrées et personnalisées répondant aux besoins en génération de données probantes des clients.
  • Mobiliser le réseau d’experts d’IQVIA afin d’offrir des solutions et une exécution de calibre mondial dans divers domaines thérapeutiques et méthodologiques.
  • Diriger l’élaboration de propositions personnalisées alignées sur les besoins des clients en matière de génération de données probantes et sur leurs priorités décisionnelles.
  • Agir à titre de principal réviseur scientifique et stratégique pour les occasions d’affaires RWE en veillant à la rigueur scientifique, à la viabilité commerciale et à la faisabilité de la prestation.

Compétences clés

  • Excellente capacité à mobiliser les parties prenantes, particulièrement dans les domaines des Affaires médicales, des Données probantes en contexte réel (RWE), de l’Économie de la santé et de la recherche sur les résultats (HEOR), de l’Épidémiologie, de la Pharmacovigilance, de l’Accès au marché et des fonctions commerciales.
  • Esprit stratégique démontré avec la capacité d’anticiper les risques, de cerner les occasions et d’élaborer des stratégies de génération de données probantes alignées sur les objectifs médicaux et commerciaux.
  • Style de leadership collaboratif fondé sur une approche-conseil centrée sur le client et une forte capacité d’influence auprès des équipes internes.
  • Capacité démontrée à transformer efficacement les stratégies en résultats concrets grâce à des équipes multidisciplinaires.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat, maîtrise ou doctorat dans une discipline scientifique telle que les sciences de la vie, l’épidémiologie, la santé publique, la biostatistique ou un domaine connexe.
  • Expérience significative dans les domaines des Données probantes en contexte réel (RWE), de la Génération de données probantes ou du Conseil en santé, idéalement au sein d’une organisation mondiale ou matricielle.
  • Ce poste exige une collaboration directe avec des services, équipes, fonctions de soutien et parties prenantes d’IQVIA situés partout au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale. Par conséquent, une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, est nécessaire pour accomplir les responsabilités liées à ce poste.

Admissibilité

Pour être admissible à ce poste, vous devez résider dans le pays où le poste est situé.

Role Overview

The Associate Director, Solution and Delivery Lead (SDL) serves as a strategic, scientific, and delivery leader within Real World Evidence (RWE) Solutions. This role is accountable for shaping client strategy, driving revenue growth, and ensuring high-quality delivery across complex, multi-offering RWE engagements. The associate SDL acts as a subject-matter expert and trusted advisor to clients, partnering closely with internal teams to design and deliver impactful, tailored evidence solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead RWE solution strategy, selling, and delivery oversight for RWE engagements.
  • Drive RWE sales and revenue growth within key accounts, identifying and advancing cross-selling and upselling opportunities.
  • Build and sustain senior-level (typically HQ-level) client relationships beyond active engagements to support early positioning and pipeline development for priority assets.
  • Ensure high-quality, profitable delivery of client projects, leveraging delivery ownership to build long-term client trust.
  • Apply deep knowledge of the IQVIA RWE portfolio to design integrated, client-specific solutions aligned with evidence needs.
  • Mobilize the IQVIA expert network to deliver best-in-class solutioning and execution across therapeutic areas and methodologies.
  • Lead development of customized proposals aligned to client evidence-generation needs and decision-making priorities.
  • Act as a senior “green-pen holder” for RWE opportunities, ensuring scientific rigor, commercial viability, and delivery feasibility.

Core Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder engagement, particularly across Medical Affairs, RWE, HEOR, Epidemiology, Safety, Market Access, and Commercial functions.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to anticipate risks, identify opportunities, and shape evidence strategies aligned with medical and commercial goals.
  • Collaborative leadership style with a consultative, client-centric approach and strong internal influence.
  • Proven execution focus, translating strategy into successful delivery through cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in a scientific discipline (e.g., life sciences, epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, or related field).
  • Significant experience in Real World Evidence, Evidence Generation, or Healthcare Consulting, ideally within a global or matrixed organization.
  • You will be required to work directly with IQVIA departments, teams, support functions and stakeholders located across Canada and around the world therefore, a functional knowledge of English, both written and spoken, is necessary to perform the duties of this position.
  • To be eligible for this position, you must reside in the same country where the job is located.

At Virtualitics, you’ll join a high-performance team of scientists, strategists, and servicemembers building AI that operates in the world’s most demanding environments. The problems we solve matter — and so does the opportunity to grow while solving them.
