Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. jobs.description:
Job Title: Development Enablement Specialist

Location: Remote

About the Role

Horace Mann is building a structured framework for how software gets developed across the organization, inside IT, across business units, and increasingly with the help of AI. This role stands it up. You'll own the training program, the governance processes, and the day-to-day technical support that lets developers at every level build with confidence and in compliance.

This is a builder role in the truest sense: you'll start with a blank page and end with a functioning program: curriculum, documentation, intake workflows, and a support practice that developers actually want to use.

What You'll Do

In the first six months, you'll primarily be building:

  • Design and develop the tiered developer training program: four cumulative builder tiers (Personal Productivity through Enterprise Solution Lead) plus trigger-based add-on modules covering AI/LLM use, sensitive data handling, privileged access, third-party integrations, and business ownership
  • Document the risk overlay framework: clear, practitioner-facing guidance on what each overlay means, when it applies, and what a developer needs to do differently as a result
  • Build the solution intake and classification process: the workflow that takes a new solution from idea to assigned tier, applied overlays, and approved build path
  • Establish the ongoing compliance model: how training completion is tracked, how access is gated, and how attestations are renewed over time
  • Document development tooling standards and permitted integration catalogs so builders have a single reference for approved tools, registries, and external connections

On an ongoing basis:

  • Provide technical assistance to developers across IT and the business: helping with technical issues both hands-on and through coordination with subject matter experts.
  • Serve as the first point of contact when a developer hits a process or tooling question: triage, resolve, or route to the right team
  • Conduct training sessions, maintain training content as the framework evolves, and track completion against access requirements
  • Execute and maintain intake and compliance processes: solution intake, developer tools, approved packages, and attestations
  • Work with Security, Architecture, Governance, and Data teams to keep overlay documentation and intake processes current as policies and tools change
  • Identify patterns in support requests and use them to improve training content, documentation, and tooling defaults

What You'll Bring

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices: Git, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred), package management, secrets management, and deployment fundamentals
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to audiences with varying levels of experience, from seasoned engineers to first-time business builders
  • Experience designing or delivering technical training, documentation, or enablement programs
  • Comfort working across teams — you'll partner with Security, Architecture, Governance, and business stakeholders regularly
  • Familiarity with AI development tools and platforms (experience with Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar is a plus)
  • Strong organizational instincts — you'll be managing curriculum, process documentation, a support queue, and compliance tracking simultaneously

Why This Role Matters

Development is no longer confined to IT. AI assistants, low-code tools, and automation platforms have made builders out of people who wouldn't have called themselves developers two years ago. This role exists to make sure that expansion goes well, that the people building solutions have the skills and support they need, that the guardrails are clear and accessible rather than buried in policy documents, and that IT can say “yes” to more development, faster, because the foundation is solid.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical training, instructional design, software development, or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Familiarity with modern software development practices and technologies, including the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Git, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experience developing and delivering technical training or enablement content.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with management, business partners, technical teams, associates, and external resources.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and document issues, risks, and dependencies.

Salary Range: $76,600.00 - $106,450.00

  • Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow. And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth: We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs. We help educators identify their financial goals and develop plans to achieve them. This includes insurance to protect what they have today and financial products to help them prepare for their future. Our tailored offerings include special rates and benefits for educators.

We are a diverse, collaborative group with an unwavering commitment to craftsmanship and delight in everything we create. With Life360’s rapid growth and strong business momentum, we have a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at global scale. At the heart of our mission is a dedication to helping families feel safe, connected, and cared for through the transformative power of design.

The Growth Revenue Experimentation team (within the Product Design team) is the engine behind Life360's subscription revenue growth: we turn ideas about pricing, packaging, and the paywall funnel into fast, validated experiments. We run a high volume of tests across the entire subscription funnel - driving free users to start a trial, trial to paid conversion & churn prevention. Additionally, optimizing the top-performing features to drive further conversion, SKU and pricing routing, external billing, and churn and win-back, partnering closely with the Revenue ML team to personalize offers and target the right SKU to the right user. We set and hold the bar for experiment quality and methodology across the program, using tools like Statsig to run and govern testing at scale, and we ground every decision in research and data, validating or killing assumptions before they become a build. We are also an AI-native team: AI tooling is already speeding up how we generate hypotheses, build, and measure results, and we expect that velocity to keep climbing as our own workflows get faster too.

About the Job

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer II to join our Revenue Experimentation team and help drive Life360's growth through fast, high-quality design experimentation. This role sits at the intersection of product design, growth strategy, and data-informed decision-making, you'll design, test, and iterate on experiences across our subscription and monetization surfaces to uncover new ways to grow revenue and deliver value to families. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Content to turn loosely defined ideas into well-scoped tests, and well-scoped tests into learnings that shape our roadmap. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast without sacrificing craft, and wants their design decisions to directly and measurably impact the business.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $152k to $223k USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $176k to $207k CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and run a high volume of experiments across Life360's revenue and monetization surfaces, from trial conversion, trial-to-paid conversion to pricing, SKU routing, and churn/win-back.
  • Turn loosely defined experiment briefs into well-scoped, testable hypotheses, using research and data to validate or challenge the underlying assumptions.
  • Lead design for experiments that originate from your own ideas, and act as a critical, PM-partnering voice on ideas that originate elsewhere.
  • Partner with Data Science and Analytics to define success metrics, interpret experiment results, and translate learnings into follow-on hypotheses.
  • Present experiment concepts, in-flight learnings, and results to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of product design experience, ideally with exposure to growth, experimentation, or subscription/monetization design.
  • A track record of shipping and iterating on A/B or multivariate experiments in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, able to take a loosely defined brief and turn it into a well-scoped, testable hypothesis using research or data.
  • A proactive, ideas-first mindset: someone who brings concepts to the table rather than waiting to be handed a fully-formed brief.
  • Strong collaboration skills, able to both lead from your own ideas and constructively pressure-test others', as a true creative and strategic partner to PMs.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers, content, and data science across the full experiment lifecycle, from concept to bug bash to results.
  • Excellent organizational habits: clean, well-documented Figma files and clear, traceable rationale for design decisions.
  • Fluency in Figma; familiarity with experimentation and analytics tooling (e.g., Optimizely, Amplitude, Statsig, or similar) is a plus.
  • Comfort using AI tools to accelerate design and production work.
  • Strong visual design craft, with hands-on animation skills.
  • A portfolio that showcases experimentation work, problem framing, hypotheses, iteration, and measurable impact, not just polished final screens.

Ways of Working

  • Operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, balancing multiple experiments at once.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Experiment briefs often start loosely defined, and it's the designer's job to validate the underlying problem (through research or data) and refine it into something well-scoped enough to actually test, confirming or challenging the original assumptions along the way.
  • Contributes ideas proactively, including in regular ideation sessions focused on a specific theme, bringing forward experiment concepts, not just executing others'.
  • Partners with PMs as a true collaborator: leads projects that originate from their own ideas, and acts as a critical partner on PM-originated ideas, pressure-testing them for UX soundness and product fit rather than simply executing.
  • Collaborates across design and other departments when an experiment touches product areas outside their own, to keep the experience consistent and aligned.
  • Keeps work organized and traceable: clean file structure, documented hypotheses and rationale, and clean, well-organized Figma files so anyone can see what's being tested, what's been done, and why.
  • Involves engineers early in the design process to surface technical questions and constraints before they become blockers.
  • Participates in bug bashes, testing experiments before launch to confirm the experience matches intent.
  • Uses AI as a creative and productivity partner, leveraging skills, automation, and AI-generated illustrations or animations where it makes sense, to move faster and free up more time for craft.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use: You embed AI in all your workflows and use it for real, substantive tasks, including research, analysis, drafting, prototyping, analytics and experimentation.
  • Review and accountability for AI output: AI-generated outputs get the same level of care of as any of your deliverables. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior practitioners who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage: doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.excerpt: About FrontierFrontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints.
jobs.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through assessments and interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

Please note: To ensure we find the best technical fit, our process begins with a practical skills assessment prior to interviews.

About Oak Hill Bio

Oak Hill Bio is a clinical-stage, rare disease therapeutics company focused on developing life-changing treatments for patients with urgent unmet needs. We are passionate about translating cutting-edge science into meaningful therapies and building a collaborative culture that drives innovation and impact.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager / FP&A Lead to join our growing finance team and play a key role across our US and UK operations.

This is a hands-on role that combines FP&A, financial reporting, accounting, and month/quarter-end close responsibilities. The successful candidate will work closely with the US and UK Controllers and have the opportunity to support a complex, multi-group biotech organization.

The role will report directly to the Finance leadership team and will be responsible for helping ensure the accurate, timely, and high-quality delivery of financial reporting and close processes, while also providing meaningful financial analysis and insight to support business decisions.

We are particularly interested in candidates with biotech or life sciences experience, strong technical accounting knowledge, and experience working across US and UK reporting environments.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Lead and support FP&A activities, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and variance analysis.

  • Provide meaningful analysis and insights into financial performance, trends, and business drivers.

  • Partner with business and finance stakeholders to develop financial plans and forecasts.

  • Translate financial data into clear insights and recommendations for leadership.

  • Support scenario analysis and longer-term financial planning.

Financial Reporting & Close

  • Support the accurate and timely completion of monthly and quarterly close processes across US and UK entities.

  • Work closely with the US and UK Controllers to ensure completeness and accuracy of financial information.

  • Review financial results, investigate variances, and identify potential accounting or reporting issues.

  • Support preparation and review of management and financial reporting.

  • Assist with US/SEC reporting requirements and related financial information.

  • Help ensure consistent accounting and reporting practices across the group.

Accounting & Technical Finance

  • Apply strong knowledge of US GAAP and UK GAAP across a multi-entity environment.

  • Support technical accounting matters and ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions.

  • Work closely with Controllers and other finance stakeholders on accounting issues and reporting requirements.

  • Develop a detailed understanding of the group's operations, entities, and financial activities.

  • Be willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the detail when required rather than operating solely at a high-level FP&A or management-reporting level.

Business Partnership

  • Partner closely with finance and operational teams across the US and UK.

  • Build strong working relationships with Controllers and other key stakeholders.

  • Help improve financial processes, reporting, controls, and systems.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline and improve the efficiency and accuracy of finance processes.

  • Support ad hoc financial analysis and projects as the business evolves.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Qualified accountant (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent).

  • Significant experience in finance, FP&A, financial reporting, or a combination of these areas.

  • Strong biotech or life sciences industry experience is essential.

  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and familiarity with UK GAAP.

  • Experience with US/SEC reporting and related financial reporting requirements.

  • Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close processes.

  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and analytical capabilities.

  • Experience working within a multi-entity or multi-group organization.

  • Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles.

  • Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately under deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across US and UK finance teams.

  • Experience in a public company or SEC reporting environment.

  • Experience with biotech, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another highly regulated industry.

  • Experience with ERP systems and financial reporting tools.

  • Experience improving finance processes and controls.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical accounting expertise with commercial and analytical thinking.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable moving between high-level FP&A work and detailed accounting analysis. They will be naturally curious, hands-on, highly analytical, and able to understand how different entities and business activities connect within a complex group structure.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on the finance function while working closely with experienced Controllers and senior finance leadership.

jobs.title: Director, Social Media
jobs.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Director, Social Media, you'll lead GitLab's global social media strategy and help people understand how GitLab is co-creating the future of software development. The role shapes how GitLab shows up across social channels, connecting our company, product, and employer stories, to build meaningful engagement with customers, users, contributors, candidates, and industry audiences. Expect to set clear priorities, guide execution, and use insights to strengthen GitLab's voice and business impact. You'll own the outcomes of GitLab's social function — strategy, budget, team development, tooling, and results — and serve as GitLab's senior-most voice on social strategy with executive stakeholders.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy and stay close enough to the work to write, build, and ship alongside the team. Two Social Media Managers report to the head of corporate communication and work with you on a dotted-line basis. You'll set their strategic direction, raise the editorial and craft bar, and develop them as practitioners, including goal-setting, feedback, and career development in partnership with their manager. Influence matters in this role, which is why it calls for someone who has already led and grown social practitioners.

What you’ll do

  • Own the performance of GitLab's social function and its contribution to marketing and business goals.
  • Lead GitLab's global organic social media strategy, channel plans, and editorial priorities.
  • Own GitLab's YouTube strategy end to end — channel architecture, programming and series development, long- and short-form video, packaging (titles, thumbnails, metadata), search and recommendation optimization, and subscriber and watch-time growth.
  • Partner with Growth Marketing on paid social, including briefing creative, aligning organic and paid on shared audiences and messaging, informing boosting and amplification decisions, and connecting paid performance back to organic strategy.
  • Develop clear, audience-focused campaigns that support company, product, brand, and talent goals.
  • Guide content planning and publishing across social channels while maintaining a consistent GitLab voice.
  • Own the social media budget, tooling stack, and agency, freelance, and production partner relationships.
  • Partner with teams across Marketing, Communications, Product, Sales, Talent Acquisition, and other functions to plan and deliver social programs.
  • Build processes that support effective collaboration in GitLab's all-remote, asynchronous environment.
  • Use social listening, audience insights, and performance data to improve content and inform broader marketing decisions.
  • Lead the measurement framework for social — KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence — and report performance and learnings to marketing and executive leadership.
  • Partner with DevRel on community engagement to help GitLab participate in relevant industry conversations with a clear, useful point of view.
  • Build and run creator, influencer, and advocacy programs, including developer creators, GitLab community contributors, and team member advocacy.
  • Own GitLab's employee advocacy program — grow participation across Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and Talent, equip team members with content worth sharing, and measure reach, engagement, and contribution to brand and talent goals. Partner with Communications and Talent Acquisition on enablement, and manage the advocacy platform and its adoption.
  • Support executive and expert social presence, partnering with Communications to help GitLab leaders and technical experts show up credibly on social, including constructive conversations with C-suite executives about proposed content.
  • Apply AI tools thoughtfully across the social workflow to help GitLab model what an AI-native marketing team looks like.
  • Prepare for and guide responses to sensitive or fast-moving issues in partnership with the appropriate teams.

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years in social media, including at least 5 years leading social strategy for a global brand at the senior manager level or above, and accountable for the function's results.
  • Experience owning a social function end to end, including strategy, budget, headcount, tooling, and results as the accountable leader.
  • Experience leading teams, agencies, and cross-functional programs, with clear ownership of and accountability for outcomes.
  • Depth in YouTube strategy, including owning and growing a brand or business channel, and can speak to programming decisions, video formats, packaging, and the metrics that actually move a channel.
  • Hands-on experience growing LinkedIn and X as primary channels, with judgment about what content, format, and cadence work on each.
  • Experience with paid social programs and how organic and paid social reinforce each other, including creative for paid, audience strategy, and interpreting paid performance data.
  • Experience connecting social media programs to broader brand, communications, product, or business priorities.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to turn complex topics into clear, engaging content.
  • Fluency with short-form and long-form video as core social formats, including working with production partners and creators.
  • Experience defining a measurement framework for social, including KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence, and presenting performance, learnings, and recommendations to executive leadership on a standing basis.
  • Experience building or scaling an employee advocacy program, including driving adoption across multiple functions, sustaining participation beyond launch, and reporting attributed reach and business contribution
  • Fluency with an enterprise social stack for publishing, listening, and advocacy. Ours is Sprout Social, Meltwater, and EveryoneSocial.
  • Experience running social programs across multiple regions and languages, and judgment about what to localize versus centralize.
  • Skill in managing multiple priorities and making sound decisions in fast-moving situations.
  • A collaborative, inclusive approach and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, asynchronous environment.
  • Passion about GitLab's mission and the future of software development, open source, artificial intelligence, and DevSecOps.

About the team

This role is part of GitLab's Marketing organization and works across teams to present a clear, consistent company voice on social media. The team collaborates asynchronously with partners across regions and functions, balancing planned campaigns with timely engagement. Together, you'll help audiences understand GitLab's platform, mission, values, and impact.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$139,200—$235,200 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

jobs.excerpt: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development.
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow,Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do Daily:

  • Generate new leads and opportunities within an assigned territory, leading to closing business enabling you to exceed your revenue targets quarterly and yearly.
  • Manage prospecting sales efforts to target key accounts and work with the channel partners to generate a pipeline in your territory.
  • Use multi-channel strategy to engage with your prospects (Linked-In, email, videos, cold calls, meetings, etc.) and execute them to convert identified prospects into new logos.
  • Take ownership of your book of business: document the buying criteria, the buying process, the next steps and owners, and ensure pipeline accuracy based on evidence.
  • Size and quote customer software license needs.
  • Interact with prospects over phone, email, video conference, and on-site meetings when necessary.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Healthcare organizations are under more compliance pressure than ever, and most are managing it the wrong way: scattered tools, manual tracking, and fragmented records that leave teams exposed and exhausted.
jobs.description:
Healthcare organizations are under more compliance pressure than ever, and most are managing it the wrong way: scattered tools, manual tracking, and fragmented records that leave teams exposed and exhausted. Compliance has become someone's second job, not a program anyone is proud to stand behind.

Compliancy Group exists to change that. We are the platform for healthcare compliance programs, consolidating every element of a complete program into one connected system, so organizations can simplify requirements, gain real visibility into where risk lives, operate with confidence, and be genuinely defensible when it matters most. We do not sell a tool and walk away. We build the program with you, combining purpose-built software, proprietary conformance scoring, and ongoing access to compliance advisors, until your organization has the structure, the evidence, and the expertise to lead compliance instead of just survive it. If you are the kind of person who wants to work on something that actually protects patients and providers, you are in the right place.

We're growing our Solutions Engineering team to support one of the most important initiatives on our roadmap: managing migrations from legacy platforms to the go-forward software we’re standardizing our product roadmap and engineering efforts around. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll be the technical voice in the room for prospects and customers navigating this transition, running deep-dive demos, building sandboxes, and helping technical buyers see exactly how our future compliance program management solutions solve their problems.

Following our acquisition of Healthicity, our sales organization now brings together two strong, established platforms - Compliance Manager and Guard - that solve similar problems for customers in very different ways. As we bring these solutions together under one roof, customers are increasingly asking which platform is the right fit for their goals, and we need deep technical expertise to help them find the right answer.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll be the technical voice in the room for prospects and customers as they evaluate their current use of compliance solutions, their pain points today and how those pain points are addressed by our future roadmap. You’ll be running deep-dive demos, building sandboxes, and helping buyers understand how each platform fits their needs, including migrating across platforms where that's the right move. You'll need to build genuine depth on both platforms, understanding not just what each one does, but why a customer might choose one over the other.

We're looking for someone who can go deep on the technical details and tell a compelling story about why it matters. If you love getting your hands dirty in a product, translating complexity into clarity, and being a trusted partner to both customers and your internal team, we'd love to talk.

What You'll Do

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for customers evaluating or migrating across platforms. Understand their environment and design a migration path that fits their infrastructure. Please note this is a multi-year effort kicking off in late 2026 and expected to be a focus through the end of 2028
  • Own technical discovery, deep-dive demos, and sandboxes for prospects and customers, tailored to where they are in their migration journey.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success to help customers migrate smoothly and realize value quickly post-migration.
  • Support configuration and deliver minor technical changes needed to get prospects and customers successfully implemented.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, migration guides, and talk tracks that streamline both pre-sales conversations and post-sales onboarding.
  • Translate technical capabilities into business value. You're as comfortable with a technical buyer as you are with an economic buyer.
  • Feed prospect and customer feedback directly into Product and Engineering, helping shape product roadmaps and surfacing migration friction early.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or in a similar technical pre-sales role.
  • Strong technical depth. You can credibly demo complex products, speak to configuration and implementation details, and answer tough technical questions on the fly.
  • A track record of managing relationships with large, complex organizations, ideally with a deeply technical enterprise product.
  • An understanding of, and comfort navigating, security, compliance, and IT processes at large enterprises. This maps directly to the migrations you'll be supporting.
  • A knack for storytelling and positioning. You can connect technical detail to the “why it matters” for the customer.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting one-on-one, in small groups, and at larger venues.
  • Comfort working with ambiguity. This program is evolving, and we're building the playbook together.
  • A collaborative, low-ego, self-starter approach. You're as excited to help a teammate nail their demo as you are to run your own, and you find creative ways to get things over the finish line.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience with healthcare compliance, governance, risk, or security products.
  • Experience supporting a product migration or platform transition.
  • Experience working with distributed or offshore teams.
  • Comfort operating in a small, fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being written.

Location: Remote for a US-based company; our team is evaluating qualified candidates onshore and offshore for this opportunity.

Lastly, through business effectiveness, OPITO will implement targeted and measurable continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring operational excellence across all aspects of its operations.

Each year, more than 500,000 people are trained to OPITO standards through one of over 250 OPITO approved centres operating across 50 countries globally.

At OPITO, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, dynamic, and engaging workplace where individuals can bring their authentic selves to work. jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Some of Apollo's biggest growth won't come from our own sales team. It'll come from other people selling or embedding Apollo under their own brand. That's the charter for Data & Distribution Partnerships, a newly created function with three mandates: scaling our data reseller business by hiring and leading a team of data reseller AEs, identifying data partnership opportunities with large platforms and crafting the bespoke commercial arrangements to support them, and uncovering new, innovative distribution partnerships beyond either of those two motions. Across all three, this is more invention than management. You're building commercial models that don't exist yet, not running relationships someone else already defined.

This is a great fit for someone who thrives in 0-to-1 environments: scrappy enough to build the strategy themselves (demand gen, pricing and packaging, marketing, sales process) and execute it personally, but experienced enough to then build and lead the team that takes it from 1 to 10. We're hiring the first Director to build and run it.

What you'll do:

1. Scale the Data Reseller Business

  • Own the volume data-resale P&L end to end: a published SKU with repeatable paper, carried by AEs
  • Hire, coach, and manage the AEs who carry the resale quota
  • Partner with Partner Marketing to fund demand generation behind the reseller business, and find the growth levers that haven't been pulled yet
  • Build a clear point of view on what increased demand gen unlocks and where the upmarket bespoke-deal opportunity is biggest

2. Identify Data Partnerships with Large Platforms and Craft the Bespoke Arrangements

  • Structure and close bespoke data agreements: one-off commercial arrangements with named, high-value counterparties, heavy up front, light after, and built as reusable templates rather than one-offs
  • Build and run discovery marketplace distribution: surfaces where a buyer is already shopping, from data-cloud marketplaces to MCP registries and platform marketplaces
  • Run new, complex BD deals personally, you're expected to be in the room for anything that doesn't fit the existing playbook

3. Uncover New, Innovative Distribution Partnerships

  • Build and run point-of-formation distribution: platforms that sit with a company from the week it's formed, think formation platforms, website builders, and the regional CPA and business-advisory networks that touch companies at inception
  • Within your first six months, arrive at several new distribution "big swings" that are prioritized, sized, and shaped for a resourcing decision
  • This is a build-from-scratch mandate: you'll define the shape of the function, not inherit one

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years in business development, partnerships, or channel roles, with meaningful experience originating and closing complex, first-of-their-kind commercial agreements — not just running an existing partner program
  • Experience managing or coaching a quota-carrying team (AEs, BDRs, or partner managers) while personally closing the deals your team can't yet handle alone
  • Comfortable operating in both modes this role requires: high-volume, SKU-based commercial structures (published pricing, repeatable paper) and heavy, bespoke one-off negotiations with named counterparties
  • A track record of building something that didn't exist before — a new channel, commercial model, or category of partner — rather than optimizing an established motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data licensing, API/data-reseller businesses, or platform marketplaces (Snowflake, Databricks, or similar data-cloud ecosystems)
  • Experience with point-of-formation or embedded distribution models (legal tech, business-formation platforms, fintech, or similar)
  • Background scaling a partner or channel P&L from early-stage

We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping customers use the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve business-critical outcomes.

About the Role

As a Senior Solutions Engineer specializing in Cloudflare One, you will partner with account teams and customers to design, demonstrate, and validate integrated solutions across Zero Trust, enterprise WAN, and emerging AI technologies. You will lead the technical path for complex opportunities, translating customer risks, operational requirements, and business priorities into architectures that give stakeholders confidence to adopt Cloudflare.

Zero Trust is the primary focus of this role, with enterprise WAN and AI as the next priorities. Successful candidates will bring meaningful customer-facing Zero Trust experience and practical enterprise WAN experience. Email Security experience is welcome but not required. You do not need to be an expert in every part of the portfolio, but you must be able to connect these technologies into a coherent customer strategy and continue developing your expertise as the market evolves.

This is a Senior-level individual-contributor role for a curious, commercially aware technical leader who can guide customer evaluations, collaborate across teams, and improve the effectiveness of the broader field organization.

  • Create reusable architectures, demonstration and proof-of-value patterns, technical guidance, and lightweight automation, and coach peers and partners to execute more effectively.
  • Capture customer feedback, market trends, and product gaps, translating them into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Sureify we’re helping a large and critical industry -- life insurance -- modernize and innovate.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Sureify we’re helping a large and critical industry -- life insurance -- modernize and innovate. We have built a platform, enabling a core suite of digital solutions for some of the world’s leading insurance companies. We’re passionate about enhancing customer experiences and driving growth through cutting-edge technology.

Position Summary

We are seeking a client-facing Technical Solution Lead to join our Professional Services organization. This role serves as the day-to-day technical solution owner for enterprise SaaS implementations, partnering closely with clients to translate business objectives into implementation-ready solutions.

The Technical Solution Lead works alongside a Project Delivery Lead and is supported by Senior Architects, Business Analysts, and Technical Business Analysts. While Senior Architects provide architectural governance and make complex design decisions, the Technical Solution Lead owns the day-to-day technical solutioning effort throughout the implementation lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical analysis and client-facing consulting skills who aspires to become a Solution Architect.

What You'll Do

Client Solution Leadership

  • Serve as the primary, day-to-day technical leader for a client implementation. This role is dedicated to one client at a time, allowing you to focus 100%.
  • Facilitate technical discovery and solution design working sessions with client stakeholders.
  • Partner with the client's architects, business analysts, and technology teams to define implementation approaches. You'll be able to collaborate with a Sureify Senior Architect as needed.
  • Review and approve agile stories produced by Business Analysts and Technical Business Analysts to ensure business requirements are accurately translated for the engineering team.

Solution Design & Analysis

  • Decompose business requirements into implementation-ready user stories.
  • Define API integrations, data mappings, validation rules, and business processes.
  • Identify technical risks, assumptions, and dependencies early in the project lifecycle.
  • Produce high-quality solution documentation and implementation guidance.

Delivery Partnership

  • Partner closely with the Project Delivery Lead to ensure solution readiness throughout delivery.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and Technical Business Analysts to refine requirements.
  • Support engineering teams by clarifying functional and technical requirements.
  • Escalate complex architectural decisions to Senior Architects while independently driving day-to-day solution definition.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage consistent solution design standards for your implementation by consulting with Senior Architects on patterns established at other clients.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve documentation, requirements decomposition, and solution quality.
  • Contribute to Sureify’s best practices in the form of lessons learned and reusable delivery assets.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • 4–6 years of experience in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, technical business analysis, or solution architecture.
  • Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, data integration, and SQL.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Comfortable with facilitating working sessions with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working directly with software engineering teams.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience working in Agile software delivery environments.
  • Bachelor's degree.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the Life & Annuity insurance industry.
  • Experience working in Fintech, Insurtech, technology consulting, or at an insurance carrier or financial services firm.
  • Familiarity with policy administration systems, identity providers, data middleware, and digital servicing portals.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve solution design or delivery processes.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will:

  • Be the day-to-day technical leader for a major new enterprise client.
  • Build trusted relationships with the client's technical and program management staff.
  • Produce implementation-ready solution designs with minimal oversight.
  • Partner with a Senior Architect to focus on architectural governance and complex technical decisions.
  • Improve delivery quality through better requirements decomposition and solution clarity.
  • Help scale our delivery organization through consistent, repeatable leadership.

What Makes This Role Unique

Unlike a traditional Business Analyst or Solution Architect, the Technical Solution Lead owns the day-to-day technical solutioning effort throughout an implementation.

You will spend much of your time collaborating directly with clients—leading working sessions, solving technical challenges, defining APIs and client-side integrations, overseeing data mappings, and ensuring our engineering teams have everything they need to build successfully.

If you enjoy solving complex business problems, working closely with customers, and aspire to become a Solution Architect, this role provides an exceptional career path.

Base annual salary
$135,000—$170,000 USD

Our Guiding Principles

Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles, instead, we honor effort and intelligence. The best idea wins no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us.

Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

If you are a California resident, please be aware Sureify collects personal information from you during the application process, which may include your name, contact details, employment history, and educational background, in accordance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). We use this information solely to evaluate your candidacy for employment and may share it with internal hiring personnel as needed.

PURPOSE

Account & Portfolio Governance

  • Oversee Client Solutions account performance, including labor tracking, billing accuracy, risk management, and scope adherence.

  • Ensure scopes, deliverables, and services remain aligned with business objectives.

  • Conduct impact analyses for scope changes and recommend next steps.

  • Develop understanding of client scopes of work, cost outs, contracts and billing requirements – and manage to those goals

  • Facilitate retrospectives, document lessons learned, and refine portfolio management processes.

Project Management Support

  • Proactively maximize bandwidth by balancing core responsibilities with supplemental client and/or internal engagements, bridging resource gaps and support for PMO leadership.

  • Offer peer coverage and assist with overflow workloads when needed.

Resource & Staffing Coordination

  • Contribute to the understanding of company capacity and individual capabilities through tracking what available personnel are working on now and in the future and identify any gaps

  • Partner with Resource Management to resolve resource conflicts, determine workloads, and optimize utilization across accounts.

  • Support Group Directors in resource allocation, tracking, and prioritization.

  • Track project/retainer actuals against SOW hours, deliverables, or project counts.

Project Workflow & Operations

  • Lead effort to achieve project objectives

  • Work with team to accurately scope out length and difficulty of tasks and projects

  • Responsible for ensuring agreed-upon project tasks are completed within scope, time, budget and quality constraints

  • Support end-to-end account workflow including time management, scope delivery, and risk prioritization.

  • Risk Planning – anticipate problems and roadblocks, engage in contingency planning and recommend solutions or alternative methods to negate risks

  • Maintain process documentation, operational policies, production calendars, timelines, and reports.

  • Schedule internal and client meetings; maintain documentation, file structure, and naming conventions.

  • Manage team schedules, deadlines, reporting workflows, and client reporting calendar

  • Seek opportunities to engage others in procedural improvements

  • Engage in client business to larger degree, establishing strong ties with your Client Solutions leads and attending as many client meetings as possible

  • Measure performance against goals

Business & Financial Management

  • Partner with Group Directors and Client Services on SOWs and staffing plans.

  • Create and review project/retainer cost-outs and track actuals against budget.

  • Review burn reports, monitor contribution margins, and recommend adjustments to maintain financial alignment.

  • Maintain detailed record of scope changes

  • Manage financial milestones in APR systems and coordinate payment reconciliation with finance.

  • Participate in monthly finance and billing reviews.

Departmental Contribution

  • Collaborate, share knowledge, and support a culture of consistency, compliance, and operational excellence across teams—including global teams.

  • Support the development, improvement and use of all company collaboration, archival and financial tools and systems to improve process and get work done efficiently

ABOUT YOU

  • 6-8 years experience as a Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, or similar in advertising/marketing industry

  • PMP Certification (Project Management Professional) or actively working to obtain certification desired

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace

  • Experience with Deltek Workbook or Deltek products is a plus.

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable.

  • Calm and focused under pressure; assertive conflict-resolution and problem-solving skills.

  • Effective decision-maker, even under tight deadlines.

  • Demonstrates confidence, professionalism, and diplomacy.

  • Capable of establishing strong relationships and gaining trust from peers.

  • Positive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented.

  • Embraces technology advancements and process changes.

  • Future-focused and technologically adept.

  • Good listener, takes feedback well, and addresses problems.

  • Lead, motivate and inspire with compassion and vision

We invite an experienced Technical Lead to join our ALM Domain for collaborating within Scrum teams. ALM Domain teams build platform-level tools and capabilities that support the full Application Lifecycle of Creatio applications. This includes development and packaging frameworks, versioning, configuration management, delivery pipelines, testing, monitoring and alerting, building and integrating CI/CD tools, and lifecycle automation for internal teams and external customers/partners.   • Collaborate closely with product managers, stakeholders, and leadership to align technical vision with business goals.
  • Conduct technical interviews, mentor developers, and facilitate onboarding and professional growth.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 6 years of software development experience with full-stack expertise in .NET and Angular.
  • At least 1 year in a technical lead or team lead role, guiding teams successfully.
  • Strong mastery of object-oriented programming and solid application of KISS, SOLID, and DRY principles.
  • Proficient in C# and modern .NET runtime environments (.NET 6+), including ASP.NET MVC, Core, and Web API development.

  • Deep knowledge of Angular 15+ with ability to build new components and optimize existing ones in a monorepo using RXJS and pipeline operators.

  • Strong unit testing background including NUnit, mocking frameworks, and API testing with Postman.
  • English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate level or above, both spoken and written.

jobs.description:
Hiring: Full-Time AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration) - Remote

🚀 About the Client 🚀

🤖 AI voice employees for the trades– Delivers 24/7 AI voice agents that answer calls and texts, capture qualified leads, and book jobs for home-service contractors.

🔧 Built for HVAC, plumbing & electrical businesses– Solves the daily pain points trade owners know too well: missed calls, empty trucks, and slow seasons.

🛠️ By operators, for operators– Practical AI and automation designed around how contractors actually work, not generic enterprise tech.

📈 Backed by 20+ years of HVAC industry relationships– With major preferred-vendor partnerships rolling out in 2027, the growth runway is real.

⚡ Lean, high-trust, fast-moving team– A founder-led company where your work ships fast and your ideas shape the product.

🌱 A ground-floor opportunity– Join as the first in-house technical hire and help build the foundation for everything that comes next.

🌟 About WeAssist 💡

🌍 Led by a Founder Who Cares– Reef Colman built WeAssist to empower individuals and create meaningful opportunities that support families.

⚡ Fast & Purposeful Recruiting– We move quickly but prioritize long-term fit, stability, and growth over just filling roles.

🌎 Connecting Global Talent– With 100+ outsourced professionals and growing, we link top talent worldwide with thriving US businesses.

❤️ Giving Back Matters– From building schools to feeding the homeless, we believe true success means making a difference.

🤝 An Inclusive & Thriving Culture– Your skills and unique gifts matter. We create an environment where outsourced professionals don't just work—they grow.

⚒️ Key Responsibilities of the AI Automation Engineer 📝

🔌 Middleware & Field Service Platform Integrations

🎙️ Voice AI Agent Engineering & Tuning

⚙️ Omnichannel & Back-Office Automation

🤝 Client Onboarding & Technical Support

📋 Internal Operations, Process Automation & SOPs

🔐 Data Security & Credential Management

Additional Information:

Review this Doc first!

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -

📢 Why Are They Hiring an AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration)? 🏢

Our client is hiring an AI Automation Engineer to bring all technical development, deployment, and fulfillment fully in-house, replacing a third-party agency that currently handles it. You'll build and own the custom middleware that connects AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to field service management systems like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro, so live phone conversations turn into accurate, booked jobs on a contractor's dispatch board. Beyond the build, your mission is reliability: proactively testing and monitoring voice agents so contractors get zero downtime and high booking accuracy, documenting the systems in clear SOPs, and laying the technical groundwork for upcoming enterprise industry partnerships in 2027. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you'll work directly with the founder and grow into technical leadership as the team expands.

If you're a proactive, code-first engineer who loves building voice agents and integrations that actually work in the real world, and you take pride in systems that never miss a call—this role could be a great fit for you. ✨

✅ Qualifications:

Must-Haves:

  • 🎙️ Voice AI Agent Experience– Hands-on experience building and deploying production voice agents with Vapi, Retell, Assistable, and/or ElevenLabs, including prompt tuning, latency optimization, and knowledge base design.
  • 💻 Real Coding Skills– Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript; you write, review, and debug your own code (no "vibe coding"). Comfort reading .NET / C# / C++ environments is a big plus.
  • 🔌 APIs, Middleware & Integrations– Proven experience building middleware and integrations using REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and SDKs.
  • ⚙️ GoHighLevel Expertise– Solid experience building workflows, automations, and sub-account setups in GoHighLevel (GHL).
  • 🤖 Automation & Agent Frameworks– Experience with n8n, Hermes Agents, Composio, OpenClaw, or similar automation and agentic AI platforms.
  • 🔐 Security-Minded– Solid grasp of API security, data privacy, credential vaults, VPNs, and VPS hosting.
  • 💬 Clear Communication & Ownership– Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable supporting clients directly, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • 🏠 Field Service Management Experience– Direct experience with ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro, or with home service trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical).
  • 🧠 Advanced AI Concepts– Familiarity with RAG, MCP, and vector databases.
  • 🌐 Web & Marketing Tech– Website builders, hosting, landing pages, Google Business Profile, and AEO/SEO automation.
  • 🧑‍💻 Software Engineering Background– Software engineers or full-stack developers who have moved into AI automation and voice agents are an ideal match.

Responsibilities of the AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration):

Your responsibilities include:

  • 🔌 Middleware & Field Service Platform Integrations
  • Build and maintain custom middleware connecting AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to Field Service Management (FSM) systems
  • Integrate with platforms like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro using REST APIs and OAuth
  • Write integration logic that interfaces with .NET / C# / C++ backend environments
  • Program and verify end-to-end booking workflows that move live voice conversations straight into contractor dispatch schedules
  • Monitor, diagnose, and resolve sync issues such as duplicate bookings, dropped data payloads, or failed scheduling attempts
  • Code, review, and debug custom application logic in JavaScript and/or TypeScript
  • 🎙️ Voice AI Agent Engineering & Tuning
  • Build, configure, and maintain production-grade voice agents using Vapi, Retell, Assistable, and ElevenLabs
  • Fine-tune latency, test prompt frameworks, design agent harnesses, and curate dynamic knowledge bases
  • Architect multi-step decision trees and parent-child logic (e.g., distinguishing a tenant from a commercial property manager during an emergency call)
  • Run automated tests on conversational accuracy, speech recognition, and intent categorization to catch bugs before clients do
  • Keep after-hours call answering and emergency dispatch agents running reliably
  • ⚙️ Omnichannel & Back-Office Automation
  • Build and manage GoHighLevel workflows across SMS, email, appointment reminders, and estimate follow-up campaigns
  • Implement automations using platforms such as Hermes, OpenClaw, Composio, and n8n
  • Build AI agents that securely log into third-party portals to complete repetitive contractor admin tasks
  • Help build, test, and deploy company-wide automation packages for beta client accounts
  • 🤝 Client Onboarding & Technical Support
  • Join technical onboarding calls with new clients to gather system requirements, parameters, and integration details
  • Execute full client setup and integration during a typical two-month implementation window
  • Connect client information to their respective GoHighLevel sub-accounts
  • Proactively verify that client systems, credentials, and automations stay active, secure, and up to date
  • Handle technical support and troubleshooting when clients report issues
  • Escalate and resolve platform bugs directly with SaaS vendor support teams (including GoHighLevel)
  • Build client-facing and internal dashboards tracking voice minutes, booking volume, and system activity
  • 📋 Internal Operations, Process Automation & SOPs
  • Configure internal GoHighLevel automations (e.g., sending service agreements after payment, kicking off projects when documents are signed)
  • Document technical architectures and create SOPs for internal team execution
  • Recommend technical solutions and collaborate with the founder on system design
  • Work alongside the current fulfillment agency during a short overlap period to absorb existing workflows and system logic before taking full ownership
  • 🔐 Data Security & Credential Management
  • Enforce data privacy, API security, and protection protocols for client records and backend integrations
  • Manage and share sensitive credentials securely using tools like LastPass, NordPass, or One-Time Secret
  • Work through designated secure environments and VPN platforms
  • 🌐 Secondary Technical & Marketing Projects (Nice-to-Have)
  • Assist with website setup, landing pages, and hosting configurations as needed
  • Implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and automated AI content workflows
  • Support Google Business Profile connections and local marketing automations

🏡 Want to Know More About the Client?

Our client is an AI solutions company that provides specialized AI voice employees and business automation for home-service contractors—HVAC, plumbing, and electrical businesses that can't afford to miss a call. Their 24/7 voice agents answer inbound calls and texts, qualify leads, and book work straight onto the schedule, while automated follow-up systems make sure contractors never lose a job just because they're out on site. They also support field-tech operations, automated hiring assistance, and recurring-revenue workflows.

What sets them apart is where they come from. The company was built by operators, for operators—grounded in more than 20 years of HVAC industry relationships and a deep understanding of what keeps trade business owners up at night. With significant preferred-vendor partnerships rolling out in 2027, they're building an in-house technical team to deliver at scale, and you'll be at the very center of it. 🌟

Culture and Core Values:

This is a lean, high-trust team that moves fast, solves problems together, and genuinely cares about the contractors it serves. The guiding belief: "People don't care how much you know until they know how much you care."

  • 🏆 Extreme Ownership & Pride in Craftsmanship– Take deep pride in system quality and the real impact your work has on clients.
  • 🔭 Proactivity– Anticipate client needs and check systems before anyone has to report an issue.
  • 🤝 Mutual Trust & Integrity– Build trust through transparency, honesty, and reliable follow-through.
  • 🌱 Collaborative Growth– Learn together, experiment boldly, and build foundations that last.
  • 🔥 Care About the Outcome– Show up for the work and the client, especially when it matters most.

Here, flexibility goes both ways: the founder supports your personal life, and you show up when the systems and clients need you. 💯

What's in it for you? 😏

Joining this client means not just filling a role but embarking on a personal development journey. The growth potential is substantial, with opportunities to:

  • 🚀 Foundational Team Member– Be the first in-house technical hire and help build the company's technical foundation from the ground up.
  • 📈 Path to Technical Leadership– Grow into a leadership role and mentor future hires as the team expands.
  • 🔥 High-Growth Pipeline– Work on a product backed by deep industry relationships and major 2027 partnerships.
  • 💸 Performance Rewards– Strong potential for expanded responsibilities and performance-based compensation as the company grows.
  • 🧠 Real Technical Influence– Your recommendations shape architecture decisions directly with the founder.
  • ⚖️ Reciprocal Flexibility– Room for personal commitments and appointments, balanced with responsiveness during critical moments.

Your next big opportunity starts here—ready to take the leap? 🚀

(Not your average Recruiting Firm…)

Started by Reef Colman just seven years ago, is not your typical staffing agency...

We are a dynamic recruiting firm focused on creating fair opportunities in the business world. We have a team of over 100 people. We help US businesses find skilled remote workers and connect these workers with good employers.
